decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.comul_gen_mem
decls.doc:
The comultiplication of the generating relation `xᵖ` lands in `(xᵖ) ⊗ R[x] + R[x] ⊗ (xᵖ)`:
by the freshman's dream in characteristic `p`, `Δ(xᵖ) = xᵖ ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ xᵖ`
(`TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.comul_ι_pow`).
decls.statement:
theorem comul_gen_mem :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (ι R R 1 ^ p) ∈
      HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R)
          (Ideal.span {(ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p}) ⊔
        HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R)
          (Ideal.span {(ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p})

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.counit_gen
decls.doc: The counit vanishes on `xᵖ`, since `ε x = 0`.
decls.statement:
theorem counit_gen :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.antipode_gen_mem
decls.doc: The antipode preserves the ideal `(xᵖ)`, since `S(xᵖ) = (-x)ᵖ = (-1)ᵖ xᵖ`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.hopfIdeal
decls.doc:
**The Hopf ideal `(xᵖ)` of the additive group.** For `R` of prime characteristic `p`, the
principal ideal generated by `xᵖ` in the coordinate Hopf algebra `R[x]` of `𝔾ₐ` is a Hopf
ideal: its comultiplication lands in `(xᵖ) ⊗ R[x] + R[x] ⊗ (xᵖ)`, its counit vanishes, and it is
antipode-stable. Its quotient is the coordinate ring of the Frobenius kernel group scheme
`αₚ`.
decls.title: The Hopf ideal `(xᵖ)` of the additive group
decls.statement: def hopfIdeal : HopfIdeal R (SymmetricAlgebra R R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.hopfIdeal_toIdeal
decls.statement:
theorem hopfIdeal_toIdeal :
    (hopfIdeal (R := R) p).toIdeal = Ideal.span {(ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.CoordinateRing
decls.doc:
**The coordinate Hopf algebra of `αₚ`**, the quotient `R[x] / (xᵖ)`. It carries a Hopf
algebra structure through the bridge instances of `TauCeti.Algebra.HopfAlgebra.HopfIdeal.Basic`.
decls.title: The coordinate Hopf algebra of `αₚ`
decls.statement: abbrev CoordinateRing : Type u

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.mk_ι_pow_eq_zero
decls.doc:
The class of `x` in the coordinate ring of `αₚ` is `p`-nilpotent: its `p`-th power is `0`.

The left-hand side is stated over `Ideal.span {x ^ p}` rather than `(hopfIdeal p).toIdeal` so that
it is in `simp` normal form: `hopfIdeal_toIdeal` is itself `@[simp]`, so a statement phrased over
`.toIdeal` would be rewritten out from under this lemma and it could never fire. The two ideals are
definitionally equal (`hopfIdeal_toIdeal` is `rfl`), so this still applies to goals phrased either
way. In this form the statement needs neither primality of `p` nor `CharP R p`.
decls.statement:
theorem mk_ι_pow_eq_zero :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p})
        (ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R)) ^ p = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.mk_ι_ne_zero
decls.doc:
The class of `x` in the coordinate ring of `αₚ` is nonzero over a nontrivial base: the
dual-number test algebra `R[ε]` receives `x ↦ ε`, sending the relation `xᵖ` to `εᵖ = 0` (as
`p ≥ 2`) but not `x` itself. So `xᵖ` does not divide `x` in `R[x]`.
decls.statement:
theorem mk_ι_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (hopfIdeal (R := R) p).toIdeal (ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.coordinateRing_not_isReduced
decls.doc:
**The coordinate ring of `αₚ` is not reduced.** Over a nontrivial base of characteristic `p`,
the class of `x` is a nonzero nilpotent (`x̄ᵖ = 0`), so `R[x] / (xᵖ)` is non-reduced. This is the
additive companion of the non-reduced `μ_p` example.
decls.title: The coordinate ring of `αₚ` is not reduced
decls.statement:
theorem coordinateRing_not_isReduced [Nontrivial R] :
    ¬ IsReduced (CoordinateRing (R := R) p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom
decls.doc:
**The functor of points of `αₚ`, as a subgroup of the additive group.** Pre-composition of a
point of `αₚ` with the quotient map `R[x] → R[x] / (xᵖ)` gives a point of `𝔾ₐ`, read off as an
element of `Multiplicative A` by `TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv`.
decls.title: The functor of points of `αₚ`, as a subgroup of the additive group
decls.statement:
def pointsHom :
    WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A) →* Multiplicative A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.toAdd_pointsHom
decls.doc:
A point of `αₚ` is sent to the value at `x` of its underlying `R[x]`-point: the element
`F(x̄)` of `A`, where `x̄` is the class of `x` in the coordinate ring.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsHom (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsHom p F) =
      F.ofConv (Ideal.Quotient.mk (hopfIdeal (R := R) p).toIdeal
        (ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom_injective
decls.doc:
The points homomorphism of `αₚ` is injective, because the quotient map `R[x] → R[x] / (xᵖ)`
is surjective, so pre-composition with it is injective on algebra homomorphisms.
decls.statement: theorem pointsHom_injective : Function.Injective (pointsHom (R := R) p (A := A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.mem_range_pointsHom_iff
decls.doc:
**The functor of points of `αₚ` is the `p`-nilpotent elements of the additive group.** An
element `a` of `A` is the value of a point of `αₚ` iff `aᵖ = 0`.
decls.title: The functor of points of `αₚ` is the `p`-nilpotent elements of the additive group
decls.statement:
theorem mem_range_pointsHom_iff (a : Multiplicative A) :
    a ∈ (pointsHom (R := R) p (A := A)).range ↔ (Multiplicative.toAdd a) ^ p = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pNilpotent
decls.doc:
**The `p`-nilpotent subgroup of the additive group.** For a commutative `R`-algebra `A`, the
elements `a : A` with `aᵖ = 0` form a subgroup of the additive group `Multiplicative A`: they are
exactly the image of the points homomorphism of `αₚ`, hence closed under the group operations.
decls.title: The `p`-nilpotent subgroup of the additive group
decls.statement: def pNilpotent : Subgroup (Multiplicative A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.mem_pNilpotent_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the `p`-nilpotent subgroup is the relation `aᵖ = 0`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pNilpotent_iff (a : Multiplicative A) :
    a ∈ pNilpotent (R := R) p ↔ Multiplicative.toAdd a ^ p = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
**The functor of points of `αₚ` as the `p`-nilpotent subgroup.** The points homomorphism
corestricts to a group isomorphism from the convolution group of points of `αₚ` onto the
`p`-nilpotent subgroup of the additive group, so `αₚ(A)` *is* the group of `p`-nilpotent elements
of `A`.
decls.title: The functor of points of `αₚ` as the `p`-nilpotent subgroup
decls.statement:
def pointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A) ≃* pNilpotent (R := R) p (A := A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.coe_pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc: The points isomorphism of `αₚ` agrees with the points homomorphism on underlying elements.
decls.statement:
theorem coe_pointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) p F : Multiplicative A) = pointsHom p F

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom_pointsMulEquiv_symm
decls.doc: The inverse of the points isomorphism of `αₚ` is a section of the points homomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsHom_pointsMulEquiv_symm (a : pNilpotent (R := R) p (A := A)) :
    pointsHom p ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) p).symm a) = (a : Multiplicative A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.inclusion
decls.doc:
**The inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` on the functor of points.** It is the homomorphism of convolution
groups of points induced (contravariantly) by the quotient bialgebra map `R[x] ↠ R[x]/(xᵖ)`, i.e.
pre-composition of a point of `αₚ` with the quotient map. It agrees with the underlying-element map
`TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom` through `TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv`.
decls.title: The inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` on the functor of points

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.gaPointsMulEquiv_inclusion
decls.doc:
Reading an included `αₚ`-point off as an element of the additive group is the underlying-element
map `TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom`: both pre-compose the point with the quotient map `R[x] ↠ R[x]/(xᵖ)`
and evaluate at the generator.
decls.statement:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_inclusion (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv (inclusion p F) = pointsHom p F

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.inclusion_injective
decls.doc:
**The inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` is injective on the functor of points.** It agrees through
`TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv` with the injective underlying-element map
`TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom`, so distinct `αₚ`-points include to distinct `𝔾ₐ`-points.
decls.title: The inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` is injective on the functor of points
decls.statement: theorem inclusion_injective : Function.Injective (inclusion (R := R) (A := A) p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.mapValue_inclusion
decls.doc:
**Naturality in the value algebra.** The inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` commutes with the value-algebra
functoriality `AlgHom.mapValue`.
decls.title: Naturality in the value algebra
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_inclusion (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (inclusion (R := R) (A := B) p).comp
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := CoordinateRing (R := R) p) χ) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) χ).comp (inclusion (R := R) (A := A) p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.frobeniusEnd_comp_inclusion
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius endomorphism annihilates `αₚ`.** Composing the Frobenius endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ`
after the inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` is the trivial homomorphism of group functors: every `αₚ`-point maps
to a `p`-nilpotent element, whose `p`-th power is `0`.
decls.title: The Frobenius endomorphism annihilates `αₚ`
decls.statement:
theorem frobeniusEnd_comp_inclusion :
    (AdditiveGroup.frobeniusEnd R p (A := A)).comp (inclusion p) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.frobeniusEnd_inclusion
decls.doc: The Frobenius endomorphism annihilates every `αₚ`-point, in element form.
decls.statement:
theorem frobeniusEnd_inclusion (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AdditiveGroup.frobeniusEnd R p (inclusion p F) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.mem_range_inclusion_iff
decls.doc:
**Membership in the image of `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ`.** A `𝔾ₐ`-point lies in the image of the `αₚ` inclusion
exactly when the Frobenius endomorphism kills it: `g` comes from `αₚ` iff `gᵖ = 0` in the additive
group of points.
decls.title: Membership in the image of `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ`
decls.statement:
theorem mem_range_inclusion_iff {g : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)} :
    g ∈ MonoidHom.range (inclusion (R := R) (A := A) p) ↔
      AdditiveGroup.frobeniusEnd R p g = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.range_inclusion
decls.doc:
**`αₚ` is the kernel of the Frobenius endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ`.** As subgroups of the group of
`𝔾ₐ`-points, the image of the inclusion `αₚ ↪ 𝔾ₐ` equals the kernel of the Frobenius endomorphism:
a `𝔾ₐ`-point comes from `αₚ` exactly when its `p`-th power is trivial. This realizes
`αₚ = ker(𝔾ₐ --a ↦ aᵖ--> 𝔾ₐ)` on the functor of points.
decls.title: `αₚ` is the kernel of the Frobenius endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ`
decls.statement:
theorem range_inclusion :
    MonoidHom.range (inclusion (R := R) (A := A) p) =
      MonoidHom.ker (AdditiveGroup.frobeniusEnd R p (A := A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.coe_eq_one_of_isReduced
decls.doc:
An element of the `p`-nilpotent subgroup of a reduced algebra is the identity of the
ambient additive group.
decls.statement:
theorem coe_eq_one_of_isReduced [IsReduced A]
    (a : pNilpotent (R := R) p (A := A)) : (a : Multiplicative A) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pNilpotent_eq_bot_of_isReduced
decls.doc: Over a reduced algebra, the subgroup of `p`-nilpotent elements is the trivial subgroup.
decls.statement:
theorem pNilpotent_eq_bot_of_isReduced [IsReduced A] :
    pNilpotent (R := R) p (A := A) = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.pointsHom_eq_one_of_isReduced
decls.doc:
Every point of `αₚ` over a reduced algebra maps to the identity element of the additive
group under the canonical inclusion.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsHom_eq_one_of_isReduced [IsReduced A]
    (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) : pointsHom p F = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.points_eq_one_of_isReduced
decls.doc: Every point of `αₚ` over a reduced algebra is the identity for convolution.
decls.statement:
theorem points_eq_one_of_isReduced [IsReduced A]
    (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) : F = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.instUniquePointsOfIsReduced
decls.doc: The convolution group of `αₚ`-points over a reduced algebra has a unique element.
decls.statement:
instance instUniquePointsOfIsReduced [IsReduced A] :
    Unique (WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit
decls.doc:
Over a reduced algebra, the functor of points of `αₚ` is canonically isomorphic to the
trivial group.
decls.statement:
def reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit [IsReduced A] :
    WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A) ≃* PUnit

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit_apply
decls.statement:
theorem reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit_apply [IsReduced A]
    (F : WithConv (CoordinateRing (R := R) p →ₐ[R] A)) :
    reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit p F = PUnit.unit

decls.name: TauCeti.AlphaP.reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit_symm_apply
decls.statement:
theorem reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit_symm_apply [IsReduced A] (x : PUnit) :
    (reducedPointsMulEquivPUnit (R := R) (A := A) p).symm x = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The `A`-points of the base change `K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M` of the vector group on
`M` are the additive monoid of `k`-linear maps `M →ₗ[k] A`.

The source is the convolution monoid of `K`-algebra maps out of the base-changed bialgebra;
the target is written multiplicatively as `Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)` to match `≃*`.
decls.statement:
def baseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M →ₐ[K] A) ≃* Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The base-changed vector-group points equivalence reads a point by evaluating it on the
base-changed generator `1 ⊗ ι(m)`.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (F : WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M →ₐ[K] A)) (m : M) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (baseChangePointsMulEquiv F) m =
      F.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_ι
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed vector-group points equivalence evaluates scalar multiples of
base-changed generators by scalar multiplication of the corresponding linear-map value.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_ι
    (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)) (s : K) (m : M) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (M := M)).symm φ).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) =
      s • (Multiplicative.toAdd φ m)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed vector-group points equivalence takes the generator indexed by
`m` to the value of the chosen linear map at `m`.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
    (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)) (m : M) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (M := M)).symm φ).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd φ m

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The base-changed one-dimensional additive group `𝔾ₐ` has `A`-points the additive monoid
of the value algebra `A`.
decls.statement:
def gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k k →ₐ[K] A) ≃* Multiplicative A

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The base-changed `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence reads a point by evaluating it on
`1 ⊗ ι(1)`.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
    (F : WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k k →ₐ[K] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv F) =
      F.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k k 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence takes the generator `1 ⊗ ι(1)` to the
chosen value.
decls.statement:
theorem gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι (a : Multiplicative A) :
    ((gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A)).symm a).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k k 1) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd a

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
**The convolution monoid of points of a vector group.** For a commutative `R`-algebra `A`,
the convolution monoid of `R`-algebra maps out of `SymmetricAlgebra R M` is the additive monoid
of `R`-linear maps `M →ₗ[R] A`: a point `F` corresponds to the linear map `x ↦ F (ι x)`, and
convolution of points corresponds to addition of linear maps.
decls.title: The convolution monoid of points of a vector group
decls.statement:
def pointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A) ≃* Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc: A point of the additive group, as a linear map, is `x ↦ F (ι x)`.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) = SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm F.ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The linear map underlying a point evaluates as `x ↦ F (ι x)`.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_apply (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) (x : M) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) x = F.ofConv (ι R M x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse equivalence sends a linear map to the corresponding algebra map.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)).symm φ =
      toConv (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Multiplicative.toAdd φ))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc:
Reading a vector-group point as a linear map is natural in the value algebra:
post-composing the point with an `R`-algebra map post-composes the corresponding linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)
          (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ F)) =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The vector-group points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ F) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: Naturality of the inverse vector-group points equivalence in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (ψ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)).symm ψ) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)).symm
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd ψ)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_inv
decls.doc:
Over commutative rings, `pointsMulEquiv` identifies the convolution inverse of a point with
negation of the corresponding linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹) = (pointsMulEquiv F)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_inv
decls.doc:
In additive notation, the convolution inverse of a point corresponds to negating its linear
map of generator values.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹)) = -Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
**The one-dimensional additive monoid of points** for `𝔾ₐ = Spec (SymmetricAlgebra R R)`.
Specializing the vector group to `M = R`, the convolution monoid of `A`-valued points over `R`
is the additive monoid `(A, +)`.
decls.title: The one-dimensional additive monoid of points
decls.statement:
def gaPointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A) ≃* Multiplicative A

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
A point of `𝔾ₐ` is the additive group element obtained by evaluating it at the generator
`ι 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) = F.ofConv (ι R R 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
decls.doc:
The inverse equivalence sends an element of the value algebra to the corresponding
`A`-valued point of `𝔾ₐ`.
decls.statement:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι (a : Multiplicative A) :
    ((gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm a).ofConv (ι R R 1) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd a

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc:
Reading a `𝔾ₐ`-point as an element of the value algebra is natural in the value algebra:
post-composing the point with an `R`-algebra map applies that map to the corresponding
element.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
          (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F)) =
      φ (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: Naturality of the inverse `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (a : Multiplicative A) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ
        ((gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm a) =
      (gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)).symm
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ (Multiplicative.toAdd a)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_inv
decls.doc:
Over commutative rings, `gaPointsMulEquiv` identifies the convolution inverse of a
`𝔾ₐ`-point with negation in the value ring.
decls.statement:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹) = (gaPointsMulEquiv F)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_inv
decls.doc:
In additive notation, the convolution inverse of a `𝔾ₐ`-point is the negative of its value
on the generator `ι 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹)) = -Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusAlgHom
decls.doc:
The coordinate `R`-algebra endomorphism of `R[x] = SymmetricAlgebra R R` sending the generator
`x = ι R R 1` to `xᵖ`. It underlies the Frobenius endomorphism of the additive group `𝔾ₐ`.
decls.statement:
def frobeniusAlgHom :
    SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusAlgHom_ι
decls.statement:
theorem frobeniusAlgHom_ι (r : R) :
    frobeniusAlgHom R p (ι R R r) = r • (ι R R 1) ^ p

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusAlgHom_ι_one
decls.statement:
theorem frobeniusAlgHom_ι_one :
    frobeniusAlgHom R p (ι R R 1) = (ι R R 1) ^ p

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.expChar_tensorSquare
decls.doc:
The tensor-square ring of the additive-group bialgebra has the same exponential
characteristic `p` as `R`: the structure map `R → R[x] ⊗ R[x]` is a section of the counit, hence
injective.
decls.statement:
theorem expChar_tensorSquare :
    ExpChar (SymmetricAlgebra R R ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R) p

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.comul_ι_pow
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius power `xᵖ` is primitive.** In exponential characteristic `p` the
comultiplication of `xᵖ` is `xᵖ ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ xᵖ`, by the freshman's dream applied to the primitive
generator `x`.
decls.title: The Frobenius power `xᵖ` is primitive
decls.statement:
theorem comul_ι_pow :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p) =
      ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p) ⊗ₜ[R] 1 +
        1 ⊗ₜ[R] ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusBialgHom
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius bialgebra endomorphism `x ↦ xᵖ` of the coordinate bialgebra of `𝔾ₐ`.** In
exponential characteristic `p` the generator `x` is primitive, hence so is `xᵖ`
(`Δ(xᵖ) = xᵖ ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ xᵖ` by the freshman's dream), and the counit still vanishes on `xᵖ`, so
the algebra endomorphism `x ↦ xᵖ` is a bialgebra endomorphism. It induces the Frobenius
endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ` on the functor of points.
decls.title: The Frobenius bialgebra endomorphism `x ↦ xᵖ` of the coordinate bialgebra of `𝔾ₐ`
decls.statement:
def frobeniusBialgHom :
    SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐc[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusBialgHom_ι
decls.statement:
theorem frobeniusBialgHom_ι (r : R) :
    frobeniusBialgHom R p (ι R R r) = r • (ι R R 1) ^ p

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusBialgHom_ι_one
decls.statement:
theorem frobeniusBialgHom_ι_one :
    frobeniusBialgHom R p (ι R R 1) = (ι R R 1) ^ p

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusEnd
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ`, on the functor of points.** For every commutative
`R`-algebra `A` it is the homomorphism of the convolution monoid of points induced
(contravariantly) by the Frobenius bialgebra endomorphism `x ↦ xᵖ`; on points it raises a point to
its `p`-th power, `a ↦ aᵖ`.
decls.title: The Frobenius endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ`, on the functor of points
decls.statement:
def frobeniusEnd :
    WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_frobeniusEnd
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius endomorphism acts as `a ↦ aᵖ` on points.** Reading a `𝔾ₐ`-point off on the
generator `x = ι 1`, the Frobenius endomorphism raises the resulting element of `A` to its `p`-th
power.

This is not a `simp` lemma: the `@[simp]` lemma `toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv` already rewrites the
left-hand side `Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv ..)`, so the statement is not in
simp-normal form.
decls.title: The Frobenius endomorphism acts as `a ↦ aᵖ` on points
decls.statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_frobeniusEnd (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv (frobeniusEnd R p F)) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) ^ p

decls.name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_frobeniusEnd
decls.doc:
**Naturality in the value algebra.** The Frobenius endomorphism of `𝔾ₐ` commutes with the
value-algebra functoriality `AlgHom.mapValue`.
decls.title: Naturality in the value algebra
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_frobeniusEnd (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (frobeniusEnd R p (A := B)).comp (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) χ) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) χ).comp (frobeniusEnd R p (A := A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.liftEquiv_map_mul
decls.statement:
lemma liftEquiv_map_mul
    (f g : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R
      (WithConv.ofConv (f * g)) =
    WithConv.ofConv
      ((WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R f.ofConv) *
        WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R g.ofConv)) :
          WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
Base change of bialgebra points is a monoid isomorphism for the convolution product.

The forward direction sends `f : A →ₐ[k] R` to `s ⊗ a ↦ s • f a`; the inverse restricts a
`K`-algebra map `K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R` along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a`.
decls.statement:
def baseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R) ≃* WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_ofConv
decls.doc: The base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism sends `f` to `s ⊗ a ↦ s • f a`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_ofConv (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f).ofConv =
      AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R f.ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv
decls.doc:
The inverse base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism is restriction along
`A → K ⊗[k] A`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f).ofConv =
      (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R).symm f.ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_tmul
decls.doc: The base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism sends `f` to `s ⊗ a ↦ s • f a`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_tmul (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) (s : K) (a : A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s • f.ofConv a

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse of the base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism restricts along
`a ↦ 1 ⊗ a`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) (a : A) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f).ofConv a =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] a)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_inv_apply_tmul
decls.doc:
Pointwise inverse formula after base change: on a pure tensor `s ⊗ a`, the convolution
inverse of a base-changed point has value `s • f (S a)`.

The `≃*` `AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv` is automatically a group isomorphism here, since
`A` is a Hopf algebra; this records the value of an inverse point on pure tensors.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_inv_apply_tmul (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) (s : K) (a : A) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f)⁻¹ (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s • f.ofConv (antipode k a)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_inv_apply
decls.doc:
Pointwise inverse formula after restricting a base-changed point along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a`:
the inverse of `(e.symm f)` has value `f (1 ⊗ S a)` at `a`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_inv_apply (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) (a : A) :
    (((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f)⁻¹).ofConv a =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] antipode k a)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
Base change of points is natural in the value algebra.

Post-composing an `R`-valued point by a `K`-algebra homomorphism `φ : R →ₐ[K] S` and then
base-changing agrees with first base-changing the point and then post-composing by `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapValue_baseChangePointsMulEquiv (φ : R →ₐ[K] S)
    (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    mapValue (H := K ⊗[k] A) φ
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f) =
      baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := S)
        (mapValue (H := A) (φ.restrictScalars k) f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue
decls.doc:
The inverse direction of base change is natural in the value algebra.

Restricting a post-composed base-changed point along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a` agrees with
post-composing the restricted point.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue (φ : R →ₐ[K] S)
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := S)).symm
        (mapValue (H := K ⊗[k] A) φ f) =
      mapValue (H := A) (φ.restrictScalars k)
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
decls.doc:
Base change of points is natural in the coordinate bialgebra.

Pre-composing a `B`-point by a bialgebra morphism `φ : A →ₐc[k] B` and then base-changing
agrees with first base-changing the point and then pre-composing by the scalar extension
`K ⊗[k] A →ₐc[K] K ⊗[k] B`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (B →ₐ[k] R)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)
        (mapDomain (A := R) φ f) =
      mapDomain (A := R)
        (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ)
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := B) (R := R) f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain_apply_tmul
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain` on pure tensors.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain_apply_tmul (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (B →ₐ[k] R)) (s : K) (a : A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)
        (mapDomain (A := R) φ f) (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s • f.ofConv (φ a)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain
decls.doc:
The inverse direction of base change is natural in the coordinate bialgebra.

Restricting along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a` after pre-composing with the scalar extension of `φ` agrees
with first restricting and then pre-composing by `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] B →ₐ[K] R)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm
        (mapDomain (A := R)
          (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ) f) =
      mapDomain (A := R) φ
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := B) (R := R)).symm f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain_apply (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] B →ₐ[K] R)) (a : A) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm
        (mapDomain (A := R)
          (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ) f)).ofConv a =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] φ a)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.zpowersHom_ofAdd_comp
decls.doc:
Composing the generator-`Multiplicative.ofAdd b` power homomorphism after the
generator-`Multiplicative.ofAdd a` one multiplies exponents.
decls.statement:
theorem zpowersHom_ofAdd_comp (a b : ℤ) :
    (zpowersHom (Multiplicative ℤ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd b)).comp
        (zpowersHom (Multiplicative ℤ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)) =
      zpowersHom (Multiplicative ℤ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd (a * b))

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charPoints
decls.doc:
**The character of `D(M)` attached to an element `m : M`, on points.** As a homomorphism of
group functors `D(M) → 𝔾ₘ`, it is induced (contravariantly) by the generator homomorphism
`zpowersHom M m : Multiplicative ℤ →* M`, `Multiplicative.ofAdd 1 ↦ m`.
decls.title: The character of `D(M)` attached to an element `m : M`, on points

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_charPoints
decls.doc:
**A character acts on points by evaluation.** Reading the resulting `𝔾ₘ`-point on the
generator gives the value of the original character `χ : M →* Aˣ` at `m`.
decls.title: A character acts on points by evaluation
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_charPoints (m : M) (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (charPoints (R := R) (A := A) m f) (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) =
      pointsMulEquiv f m

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.cocharPoints
decls.doc:
**The cocharacter of `D(M)` attached to a homomorphism `ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ`, on
points.** As a homomorphism of group functors `𝔾ₘ → D(M)`, it is induced (contravariantly) by
`ψ`.

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_cocharPoints
decls.doc:
**A cocharacter acts on points by a power character.** The `𝔾ₘ`-point with generator value
`u` is sent to the character `m ↦ u ^ (ψ m).toAdd`.
decls.title: A cocharacter acts on points by a power character
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_cocharPoints (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)) (m : M) :
    pointsMulEquiv (cocharPoints (R := R) (A := A) ψ f) m =
      pointsMulEquiv f (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) ^ (ψ m).toAdd

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_ext
decls.doc:
**Extensionality for `𝔾ₘ = D(Multiplicative ℤ)` points.** Two points are equal once they read
off the same unit on the group-algebra generator `Multiplicative.ofAdd 1`: a character of
`Multiplicative ℤ` is determined by its value at the generator (`MonoidHom.ext_mint`), and points
are equivalent to characters.
decls.title: Extensionality for `𝔾ₘ = D(Multiplicative ℤ)` points
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_ext {f g : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)}
    (h : pointsMulEquiv f (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)) =
        pointsMulEquiv g (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ))) :
    f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd
decls.doc:
**The `n`-th power endomorphism of `𝔾ₘ`, on points.** Because `𝔾ₘ = D(Multiplicative ℤ)`,
this is exactly the character of `𝔾ₘ` at the generator power `Multiplicative.ofAdd n`
(`charPoints (Multiplicative.ofAdd n)`, recorded by `powEnd_eq_charPoints`); on points it acts as
`u ↦ u ^ n`.
decls.title: The `n`-th power endomorphism of `𝔾ₘ`, on points

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_eq_charPoints
decls.doc: The `n`-th power endomorphism of `𝔾ₘ` is the character of `𝔾ₘ` at `Multiplicative.ofAdd n`.
decls.statement:
theorem powEnd_eq_charPoints (n : ℤ) :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) n = charPoints (Multiplicative.ofAdd n)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_powEnd
decls.doc: **The power endomorphism acts as `u ↦ u ^ n` on points.**
decls.title: The power endomorphism acts as `u ↦ u ^ n` on points
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_powEnd (n : ℤ)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (powEnd (R := R) (A := A) n f) (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) =
      pointsMulEquiv f (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_one
decls.doc: The first power endomorphism is the identity.
decls.statement: theorem powEnd_one : powEnd (R := R) (A := A) 1 = MonoidHom.id _

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_comp
decls.doc:
**Power endomorphisms compose by multiplying exponents:** `powEnd a ∘ powEnd b = powEnd (a*b)`.
This is the multiplication of the endomorphism ring `End(𝔾ₘ) ≅ ℤ` on power maps.
decls.title: Power endomorphisms compose by multiplying exponents
decls.statement:
theorem powEnd_comp (a b : ℤ) :
    (powEnd (R := R) (A := A) a).comp (powEnd b) = powEnd (a * b)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing
decls.doc:
**The character–cocharacter pairing `⟨m, ψ⟩ : ℤ`** of a character `m : M` of `D(M)` with a
cocharacter `ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ`.
decls.title: The character–cocharacter pairing `⟨m, ψ⟩ : ℤ`
decls.statement: def pairing (m : M) (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing_def
decls.doc: The pairing `⟨m, ψ⟩` is the integer `(ψ m).toAdd`.
decls.statement: theorem pairing_def (m : M) (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) : pairing m ψ = (ψ m).toAdd

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing_mul_left
decls.doc: The pairing is additive in the character: `⟨m * m', ψ⟩ = ⟨m, ψ⟩ + ⟨m', ψ⟩`.
decls.statement:
theorem pairing_mul_left (m m' : M) (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) :
    pairing (m * m') ψ = pairing m ψ + pairing m' ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing_one_left
decls.doc: The pairing vanishes on the identity character: `⟨1, ψ⟩ = 0`.
decls.statement: theorem pairing_one_left (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) : pairing (1 : M) ψ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing_mul_right
decls.doc: The pairing is additive in the cocharacter: `⟨m, ψ * ψ'⟩ = ⟨m, ψ⟩ + ⟨m, ψ'⟩`.
decls.statement:
theorem pairing_mul_right (m : M) (ψ ψ' : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) :
    pairing m (ψ * ψ') = pairing m ψ + pairing m ψ'

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing_one_right
decls.doc: The pairing vanishes on the identity cocharacter: `⟨m, 1⟩ = 0`.
decls.statement: theorem pairing_one_right (m : M) : pairing m (1 : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charPoints_comp_cocharPoints
decls.doc:
**The pairing is realized as a power endomorphism of `𝔾ₘ`.** Composing the character `m`
after the cocharacter `ψ` is the `⟨m, ψ⟩`-power endomorphism of `𝔾ₘ`, so on points it is
`u ↦ u ^ ⟨m, ψ⟩`. This realizes the character–cocharacter pairing
`X*(D(M)) × X_*(D(M)) → End(𝔾ₘ)`, valued in the power endomorphisms (the ring `End(𝔾ₘ) ≅ ℤ`
on the level of power maps).
decls.title: The pairing is realized as a power endomorphism of `𝔾ₘ`
decls.statement:
theorem charPoints_comp_cocharPoints (m : M) (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ) :
    (charPoints (R := R) (A := A) m).comp (cocharPoints ψ) = powEnd (pairing m ψ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_charPoints_cocharPoints
decls.doc:
The pairing evaluated through `charPoints_comp_cocharPoints`: on points, the composite of
the cocharacter `ψ` and the character `m` raises a unit to the `⟨m, ψ⟩` power.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_charPoints_cocharPoints (m : M) (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (charPoints (R := R) (A := A) m (cocharPoints ψ f))
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) =
      pointsMulEquiv f (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) ^ pairing m ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pairing_ofAdd
decls.doc:
**The rank-`1` pairing is multiplication.** For `𝔾ₘ = D(Multiplicative ℤ)`, with character
lattice `X*(𝔾ₘ) = ℤ` (via `Multiplicative.ofAdd`) and cocharacter lattice `X_*(𝔾ₘ) = ℤ` (via
`ψ ↦ (ψ (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1)).toAdd`), the pairing is the product of the two integers.
decls.title: The rank-`1` pairing is multiplication
decls.statement:
theorem pairing_ofAdd (a : ℤ) (ψ : Multiplicative ℤ →* Multiplicative ℤ) :
    pairing (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) ψ = a * (ψ (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1)).toAdd

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChange
decls.doc:
Base change of a commutative Hopf algebra along `k → K`.

The underlying coordinate Hopf algebra is `K ⊗[k] H`, with the tensor-product Hopf algebra
structure over `K`.
decls.statement:
abbrev baseChange (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) :
    _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap
decls.doc: Scalar extension of a morphism of commutative Hopf algebras.
decls.statement:
abbrev baseChangeMap {H L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) : baseChange (K := K) H ⟶ baseChange (K := K) L

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_baseChangeMap
decls.doc:
The underlying bialgebra hom of `baseChangeMap` is tensoring the morphism with
the identity on the new base.
decls.statement:
lemma hom_baseChangeMap {H L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) :
    (baseChangeMap (K := K) φ).hom =
      _root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_apply_tmul
decls.doc: On pure tensors, `baseChangeMap` applies the original morphism to the second factor.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor
decls.doc: Base change is functorial on commutative Hopf algebras.
decls.statement:
abbrev baseChangeFunctor :
    _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k ⥤ _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor_obj
decls.doc: The object part of `baseChangeFunctor` is the bundled base-change object.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_obj (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) :
    (baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).obj H = baseChange (K := K) H

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor_map
decls.doc: The morphism part of `baseChangeFunctor` is scalar extension of coordinate morphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_map {H L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k} (φ : H ⟶ L) :
    (baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).map φ = baseChangeMap (K := K) φ

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The points of the base-changed Hopf algebra are the original points evaluated
on the same algebra, with scalars restricted from `K` to `k`.
decls.statement:
def baseChangePointsMulEquiv (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) :
    HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A ≃*
      HopfAlgebra.points (R := k) (H := H)
        (_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_apply
decls.doc: Applying the base-change points equivalence restricts a `K`-point along `h ↦ 1 ⊗ h`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A) (h : H) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H f).ofConv h = f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] h)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
decls.doc:
The inverse base-change points equivalence sends a restricted point to
`s ⊗ h ↦ s • f h`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := k) (H := H)
      (_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A))
    (s : K) (h : H) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H).symm f).ofConv (s ⊗ₜ[k] h) = s • f.ofConv h

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The base-change points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
    {B : CommAlgCat.{x} K} (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k)
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) B H (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := baseChange (K := K) H) χ f) =
      HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H)
        ((_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap k K)).map χ)
      (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H f)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
decls.doc: The base-change points equivalence is natural in the coordinate Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain {H L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) L) A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A) ((baseChangeMap (K := K) φ).hom) f) =
      AlgHom.mapDomain
        (A := _root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A)
        φ.hom
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A L f)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor
decls.doc:
A morphism of coordinate commutative Hopf algebras induces a natural transformation
between their group-valued points functors, contravariantly in the coordinate algebra.

At a commutative `R`-algebra `A`, this sends an `A`-valued point `f : K →ₐ[R] A` to
`f ∘ φ : H →ₐ[R] A`.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_app_apply
decls.doc: On points, `mapPointsFunctor φ` is pre-composition with `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_app_apply {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) :
    (mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f =
      toConv (f.ofConv.comp (φ.hom : H →ₐ[R] K))

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_app_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `mapPointsFunctor_app_apply`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_app_apply_apply {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) (h : H) :
    (((mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f).ofConv) h = f.ofConv (φ.hom h)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_naturality_apply
decls.doc: Naturality of the point map induced by a coordinate morphism, applied to a point.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_naturality_apply {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K)
    {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) :
    HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ ((mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f) =
      (mapPointsFunctor φ).app B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := K) χ f)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_app_injective_of_surjective
decls.doc: Pre-composition with a surjective coordinate morphism is injective on points.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_id
decls.doc:
`mapPointsFunctor` sends the identity coordinate morphism to the identity natural
transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_id (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    mapPointsFunctor (𝟙 H) =
      𝟙 (HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H) :
        CommAlgCat.{w} R ⥤ GrpCat.{max v w})

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_comp
decls.doc:
`mapPointsFunctor` sends coordinate-algebra composition to reverse composition of natural
transformations.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_comp {H K L : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) (ψ : K ⟶ L) :
    mapPointsFunctor (φ ≫ ψ) =
      mapPointsFunctor ψ ≫ mapPointsFunctor φ

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor
decls.doc:
The contravariant functor assigning to a commutative Hopf algebra its group-valued
functor of points.

A coordinate Hopf algebra `H` is sent to the functor `A ↦ WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)`. A morphism
`φ : H ⟶ K` is sent contravariantly to the natural transformation that pre-composes
`K`-points by `φ`.
decls.statement:
def pointsFunctor :
    (CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommAlgCat.{w} R ⥤ GrpCat.{max v w}

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_obj
decls.doc:
The object part of `pointsFunctor` is the points functor of the underlying commutative
Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_obj (H : (CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ) :
    (pointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H =
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H.unop)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_map
decls.doc:
The morphism part of `pointsFunctor` is pre-composition in the coordinate commutative
Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_map {H K : (CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (pointsFunctor (R := R)).map φ =
      mapPointsFunctor φ.unop

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of the morphism part of `pointsFunctor`.
decls.statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply {H K : (CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H.unop) A) (h : K.unop) :
    ((((pointsFunctor (R := R)).map φ).app A f).ofConv) h =
      f.ofConv (φ.unop.hom h)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat
decls.doc: Deprecated: the Tau Ceti-local category alias forwards to Mathlib's bundled `CommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement: abbrev CommHopfAlgCat.{u', v'} (R : Type u') [CommRing R] : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commRing
decls.doc:
Deprecated. The underlying ring of an object of `CommHopfAlgCat R` is commutative; this is
now provided directly by Mathlib's bundled `CommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement: abbrev commRing (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) : CommRing H

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hopfAlgebra
decls.doc:
Deprecated. The underlying type of an object of `CommHopfAlgCat R` is a Hopf algebra; this
is now provided directly by Mathlib's bundled `CommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement: abbrev hopfAlgebra (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) : _root_.HopfAlgebra R H

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom
decls.doc:
Deprecated: use `φ.hom`. Turn a morphism in `CommHopfAlgCat` back into a bialgebra
morphism; this is Mathlib's `CommHopfAlgCat.Hom.hom`.
decls.statement: abbrev toBialgHom {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) : H →ₐc[R] K

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.of
decls.doc:
Deprecated: use `CommHopfAlgCat.of`. Build a bundled commutative Hopf algebra from the
usual unbundled typeclasses.
decls.statement: abbrev of (H : Type v) [CommRing H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom
decls.doc:
Deprecated: use `CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom`. Typecheck a bialgebra morphism as a morphism in
`CommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement:
abbrev ofHom {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K] (φ : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    of R H ⟶ of R K

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_id
decls.doc: Deprecated: `toBialgHom (𝟙 H) = BialgHom.id R H`; use `CommHopfAlgCat.hom_id`.
decls.statement:
lemma toBialgHom_id {H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} :
    toBialgHom (𝟙 H : H ⟶ H) = BialgHom.id R H

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_comp
decls.doc:
Deprecated: `toBialgHom (φ ≫ ψ) = (toBialgHom ψ).comp (toBialgHom φ)`; use
`CommHopfAlgCat.hom_comp`.
decls.statement:
lemma toBialgHom_comp {H K L : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) (ψ : K ⟶ L) :
    toBialgHom (φ ≫ ψ) = (toBialgHom ψ).comp (toBialgHom φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom_toBialgHom
decls.doc: Deprecated: `ofHom (toBialgHom φ) = φ`; use `CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom_hom`.
decls.statement:
lemma ofHom_toBialgHom {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (toBialgHom φ) = φ

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_ofHom
decls.doc: Deprecated: `toBialgHom (ofHom φ) = φ`; use `CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ofHom`.
decls.statement:
lemma toBialgHom_ofHom {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K] (φ : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    toBialgHom (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (R := R) φ) = φ

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext
decls.doc:
Deprecated: use `CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext`. Two morphisms of commutative Hopf algebras are
equal when their underlying bialgebra morphisms are equal.
decls.statement:
lemma hom_ext {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} {φ ψ : H ⟶ K}
    (h : φ.hom = ψ.hom) : φ = ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hasForgetToCommBialgCat
decls.doc:
Deprecated: use `CommHopfAlgCat.hasForgetToCommBialgCat`. The forgetful functor from
commutative Hopf algebras to commutative bialgebras.
decls.statement:
abbrev hasForgetToCommBialgCat :
    HasForget₂ (CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (CommBialgCat.{v} R)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commBialgCat_obj
decls.doc: Deprecated: use `CommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commBialgCat_obj`.
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commBialgCat_obj (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (forget₂ (CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (CommBialgCat.{v} R)).obj H = CommBialgCat.of R H

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commBialgCat_map
decls.doc: Deprecated: use `CommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commBialgCat_map`.
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commBialgCat_map {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (forget₂ (CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (CommBialgCat.{v} R)).map φ = CommBialgCat.ofHom φ.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The `A`-points of the base change `K ⊗[k] k[G]` of the diagonalizable group `D(G)` are
the character group `G →* Aˣ`.

The source is the convolution group of `K`-algebra maps out of the base-changed Hopf algebra.
The target is the ordinary pointwise-multiplication group of characters.
decls.statement:
def baseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐ[K] A) ≃* (G →* Aˣ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
Applying `baseChangePointsMulEquiv` first restricts a base-changed point along
`g ↦ 1 ⊗ single g 1`, then reads off its character.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐ[K] A)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv f =
      charOfPoint
        (((AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K)
          (A := MonoidAlgebra k G) (R := A)).symm f).ofConv)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The base-changed diagonalizable-points equivalence reads a point by evaluating it on the
base-changed group-like element `1 ⊗ single g 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_coe
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐ[K] A)) (g : G) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv f g : A) =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k))

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_single
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed diagonalizable-points equivalence extends a character after
base change. On a pure tensor it sends `s ⊗ single g r` to `s • (r • χ g)`.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_single (χ : G →* Aˣ) (s : K)
    (g : G) (r : k) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)).symm χ).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single g r) =
      s • (r • (χ g : A))

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_single_one
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed diagonalizable-points equivalence takes `1 ⊗ single g 1` to the
value of the character at `g`.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_single_one (χ : G →* Aˣ) (g : G) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)).symm χ).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k)) =
      (χ g : A)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
decls.doc:
Under base change, the points map induced contravariantly by `φ : G →* G'` is
precomposition of characters by `φ`.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain (φ : G →* G')
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G' →ₐ[K] A)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
          (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K)
            (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k φ)) f) =
      (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G') f).comp φ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.mapDomain_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
Mapping the base-changed point attached to a character is precomposition of that character
by the homomorphism of character groups.
decls.statement:
theorem mapDomain_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : G →* G') (χ : G' →* Aˣ) :
    AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
        (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K)
          (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k φ))
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G')).symm χ) =
      (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)).symm (χ.comp φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.point
decls.doc:
The `R[G]`-point of the diagonalizable group `D(G)` corresponding to a character of `G`.
It is the algebra map extending `χ` via the universal property of the group algebra; it sends
`single g r` to `r • χ g`.
decls.statement: def point (χ : G →* Aˣ) : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.point_single
decls.doc: The point associated to a character sends `single g r` to `r • χ g`.
decls.statement:
theorem point_single (χ : G →* Aˣ) (g : G) (r : R) :
    point (R := R) χ (MonoidAlgebra.single g r) = r • (χ g : A)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.point_single_one
decls.doc: The point associated to a character sends the group-like `single g 1` to `χ g`.
decls.statement:
theorem point_single_one (χ : G →* Aˣ) (g : G) :
    point (R := R) χ (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1) = (χ g : A)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint
decls.doc:
The character of `G` read off from an `R[G]`-point: it sends `g` to the unit
`f (single g 1)` of `A`, whose inverse is `f (single g⁻¹ 1)`. It is the monoid hom
`(MonoidAlgebra.lift R A G).symm f : G →* A` made unit-valued through `MonoidHom.toHomUnits`,
using that `G` is a group.
decls.statement: def charOfPoint (f : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) : G →* Aˣ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_apply_coe
decls.doc: The character read off from a point sends `g` to the value of the point on `single g 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem charOfPoint_apply_coe (f : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) (g : G) :
    (charOfPoint f g : A) = f (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_apply_inv_coe
decls.doc: The inverse of the unit `charOfPoint f g` is the value of the point on `single g⁻¹ 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem charOfPoint_apply_inv_coe (f : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) (g : G) :
    (↑(charOfPoint f g)⁻¹ : A) = f (MonoidAlgebra.single g⁻¹ 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_point
decls.doc: Reading off the character of the point of `χ` recovers `χ`.
decls.statement:
theorem charOfPoint_point (χ : G →* Aˣ) :
    charOfPoint (point (R := R) χ) = χ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.point_charOfPoint
decls.doc: The point of the character read off from `f` recovers `f`.
decls.statement:
theorem point_charOfPoint (f : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) :
    point (R := R) (charOfPoint f) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointEquiv
decls.doc: Algebra maps out of `R[G]` are the same as characters `G →* Aˣ` of `G`.
decls.statement: def pointEquiv : (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) ≃ (G →* Aˣ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The equivalence sends a point to the character read off from it.
decls.statement:
theorem pointEquiv_apply (f : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) :
    pointEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G) f = charOfPoint f

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse equivalence sends a character to the point extending it.
decls.statement:
theorem pointEquiv_symm_apply (χ : G →* Aˣ) :
    (pointEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G)).symm χ = point χ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.comul_single_one
decls.doc: The comultiplication of `R[G]` on a group-like element: `single g 1` is group-like.
decls.statement:
theorem comul_single_one (g : G) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : R)) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single g 1 ⊗ₜ[R] MonoidAlgebra.single g 1

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.convMul_ofConv_single_one
decls.doc:
A convolution product of points, evaluated on the group-like `single x 1`, is the product
of the two values: convolution restricted to group-like elements is pointwise multiplication.
This is the reusable fact behind `charOfPoint_convMul`.
decls.statement:
theorem convMul_ofConv_single_one (f g : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) (x : G) :
    (f * g).ofConv (MonoidAlgebra.single x 1) =
      f.ofConv (MonoidAlgebra.single x 1) * g.ofConv (MonoidAlgebra.single x 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_convMul
decls.doc:
Reading off characters turns the convolution product of points into the pointwise
product of characters.
decls.statement:
theorem charOfPoint_convMul (f g : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) :
    charOfPoint ((f * g).ofConv) = charOfPoint f.ofConv * charOfPoint g.ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_mapValue
decls.doc:
Reading off characters is natural in the value algebra: post-composing a point with an
`R`-algebra map sends the associated character through the induced map on units.
decls.statement:
theorem charOfPoint_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) :
    charOfPoint ((AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G) φ f).ofConv) =
      (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom).comp (charOfPoint f.ofConv)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The functor of points of the diagonalizable group `D(G)` is the character group `G →* Aˣ`.

The source is the convolution group of `R`-algebra maps out of `R[G]`; the target is the
group of characters of `G` valued in the units of `A`, under pointwise multiplication.
decls.statement: def pointsMulEquiv : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) ≃* (G →* Aˣ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The multiplicative equivalence sends a convolution point to the character read off from it.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_apply (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G) f = charOfPoint f.ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The multiplicative point equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B) (G := G)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G) φ f) =
      (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom).comp
        (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G) f)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse multiplicative equivalence sends a character to the point extending it.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (χ : G →* Aˣ) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G)).symm χ = toConv (point χ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv_T
decls.doc:
Evaluating `AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv` on the Laurent generator `T n`:
it sends `T n` to the group-like `single (ofAdd n) 1` of `R[Multiplicative ℤ]`.
decls.statement:
theorem toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv_T (n : ℤ) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv (R := R) R ℤ (LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) 1

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.multiplicativeGroup_pointEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The group-algebra presentation of `D(Multiplicative ℤ)` agrees with the
Laurent-polynomial multiplicative group `𝔾ₘ` of `TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup`: reading a point
on the generator `single (ofAdd 1) 1` gives the same unit as first precomposing it with
`AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv` and then using the canonical
`TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointEquiv`.
decls.statement:
theorem multiplicativeGroup_pointEquiv_apply
    (f : MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A) :
    charOfPoint f (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) =
      MultiplicativeGroup.pointEquiv
        (f.comp (AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv R ℤ).toAlgHom)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing
decls.doc:
The coordinate Hopf algebra `R[G]` of the diagonalizable group `D(G)`, bundled as a
finite-type commutative Hopf algebra when `G` is finitely generated.
decls.statement:
abbrev coordinateRing (G : FGCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, max u v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateMap
decls.doc:
A homomorphism `G → G'` induces the coordinate Hopf-algebra morphism
`R[G] → R[G']` between the corresponding finite-type diagonalizable groups.
decls.statement:
abbrev coordinateMap {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) :
    coordinateRing R G ⟶ coordinateRing R H

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.toBialgHom_coordinateMap
decls.doc:
The bialgebra morphism underlying `coordinateMap φ` is the group-algebra map induced
by the underlying group homomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem toBialgHom_coordinateMap {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom (coordinateMap R φ) =
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R (FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateMap_single
decls.doc:
The coordinate map sends a group-algebra basis element to the basis element indexed
by its image under the underlying group homomorphism.

This is deliberately not a `simp` lemma: `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_ofHom`
already rewrites the left-hand side to `MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom`, so `simp` would
never see this form.
decls.statement:
theorem coordinateMap_single {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) (g : G) (r : R) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom (coordinateMap R φ) (MonoidAlgebra.single g r) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single (FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom φ g) r

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateMap_injective
decls.doc:
Over a nontrivial base ring, the coordinate morphism remembers the group homomorphism
that induced it.
decls.statement:
theorem coordinateMap_injective [Nontrivial R] {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} :
    Function.Injective (coordinateMap R :
      (G ⟶ H) → (coordinateRing R G ⟶ coordinateRing R H))

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRingFunctor
decls.doc:
The coordinate-ring construction for finite-type diagonalizable groups.

It is covariant on coordinate Hopf algebras. After applying the contravariant spectrum
functor, it becomes the usual contravariant assignment `G ↦ D(G)`.
decls.statement:
def coordinateRingFunctor :
    FGCommGrpCat.{v} ⥤ FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, max u v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRingFunctor_obj
decls.doc:
The coordinate-ring functor sends a finitely generated commutative group to its
coordinate Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem coordinateRingFunctor_obj (G : FGCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    (coordinateRingFunctor R).obj G = coordinateRing R G

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRingFunctor_map
decls.doc:
The coordinate-ring functor sends a group homomorphism to the induced coordinate
Hopf-algebra morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem coordinateRingFunctor_map {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) :
    (coordinateRingFunctor R).map φ = coordinateMap R φ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRingFunctor_faithful
decls.doc:
The coordinate-ring functor of finite-type diagonalizable groups is faithful over a
nontrivial base ring.
decls.statement:
instance coordinateRingFunctor_faithful [Nontrivial R] :
    (coordinateRingFunctor R).Faithful

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMap
decls.doc:
**The diagonalizable group is contravariant in the abelian group.** A group homomorphism
`φ : G →* G'` induces, by pre-composition with the bialgebra map `R[G] →ₐc[R] R[G']`, a
homomorphism of convolution groups of points `D(G')(A) → D(G)(A)`.
decls.title: The diagonalizable group is contravariant in the abelian group
decls.statement:
def pointsMap (φ : G →* G') :
    WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G' →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMap_apply
decls.doc: `pointsMap φ` acts by pre-composition with the induced bialgebra map.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMap_apply (φ : G →* G') (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G' →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMap (A := A) φ f =
      toConv (f.ofConv.comp
        (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R φ : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] MonoidAlgebra R G'))

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMap_id
decls.doc: Pre-composition by the identity homomorphism is the identity on points.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMap_id :
    (pointsMap (MonoidHom.id G) :
        WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) =
      MonoidHom.id _

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMap_comp
decls.doc:
**Contravariant functoriality.** Pre-composition by a composite homomorphism is the
composite of the induced points homomorphisms, in the opposite order.
decls.title: Contravariant functoriality
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMap_comp (φ : G →* G') (ψ : G' →* G'') :
    (pointsMap (A := A) (ψ.comp φ) :
        WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G'' →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) =
      (pointsMap (R := R) (A := A) φ).comp (pointsMap (R := R) (A := A) ψ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.mapValue_pointsMap
decls.doc:
**Naturality in the value algebra.** The contravariant points homomorphism `pointsMap φ`
commutes with the value-algebra functoriality `AlgHom.mapValue χ`: pre-composition by the
induced bialgebra map and post-composition by `χ : A →ₐ[R] B` may be applied in either order.
This makes `pointsMap φ` a natural transformation of functors of points.
decls.title: Naturality in the value algebra
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMap {B : Type*} [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B] (φ : G →* G')
    (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (pointsMap (A := B) φ).comp (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G') χ) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G) χ).comp (pointsMap (A := A) φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_comp
decls.doc:
Reading off the character of a point pre-composed by the induced bialgebra map is the
character of the original point pre-composed by `φ`.
decls.statement:
theorem charOfPoint_comp (φ : G →* G') (f : MonoidAlgebra R G' →ₐ[R] A) :
    charOfPoint (f.comp
        (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R φ : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] MonoidAlgebra R G')) =
      (charOfPoint f).comp φ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_pointsMap
decls.doc:
**The points homomorphism is precomposition of characters.** Under the identification of
points of `D(G)` with characters of `G`, the homomorphism `pointsMap φ` induced by
`φ : G →* G'` is intertwined with precomposition `χ ↦ χ ∘ φ` of characters.
decls.title: The points homomorphism is precomposition of characters
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_pointsMap (φ : G →* G') (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G' →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (pointsMap (A := A) φ f) = (pointsMulEquiv f).comp φ

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMap_injective
decls.doc:
If `φ` is surjective, then the induced contravariant map on diagonalizable-group points is
injective. Under the character identification this is injectivity of precomposition by a
surjective homomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMap_injective (φ : G →* G') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Function.Injective (pointsMap (R := R) (A := A) φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMap_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: Mapping the point attached to a character is precomposition of that character by `φ`.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMap_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : G →* G') (χ : G' →* Aˣ) :
    pointsMap (R := R) (A := A) φ ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G')).symm χ) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G)).symm (χ.comp φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.multiplicativeGroupPointsCommGroup
decls.doc: The convolution group structure on the points of `𝔾ₘ`.
decls.statement:
instance multiplicativeGroupPointsCommGroup :
    CommGroup (WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_apply
decls.doc:
**The power endomorphism is the power map.** The `z`th power endomorphism of
`𝔾ₘ = D(Multiplicative ℤ)`, defined through the diagonalizable-group functoriality, acts on the
convolution group of points as the genuine `z`th power `f ↦ f ^ z`.
decls.title: The power endomorphism is the power map
decls.statement:
theorem powEnd_apply (z : ℤ) (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    powEnd z f = f ^ z

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_zero
decls.doc:
The zeroth power endomorphism is the trivial homomorphism. This is the additive unit of the
endomorphism ring, complementing `powEnd_one` (its multiplicative unit).
decls.statement:
theorem powEnd_zero :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) 0 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_add
decls.doc:
**Power endomorphisms add exponents under the pointwise product.** In the abelian group of
endomorphisms of `𝔾ₘ` (pointwise multiplication of homomorphisms into the commutative group of
points), `powEnd (a + b) = powEnd a * powEnd b`. This is the addition of the endomorphism ring
`End(𝔾ₘ) ≅ ℤ`, complementing the multiplication `powEnd_comp`.
decls.title: Power endomorphisms add exponents under the pointwise product
decls.statement:
theorem powEnd_add (a b : ℤ) :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) (a + b) = powEnd a * powEnd b

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_neg
decls.doc:
The power endomorphism of a negated exponent is the pointwise inverse endomorphism:
`powEnd (-a)` sends a point to the inverse of its image under `powEnd a`.
decls.statement:
theorem powEnd_neg (a : ℤ) :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) (-a) = (powEnd (R := R) (A := A) a)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.toAdditive_powEnd_eq_intCast
decls.doc:
**The power endomorphism is the canonical integer action.** The additive form of `powEnd z`
is the canonical integer endomorphism. Together with `powEnd_zero`, `powEnd_one`, `powEnd_add`,
and `powEnd_comp`, this
exhibits `z ↦ powEnd z` as the power-endomorphism realization of the canonical ring homomorphism
`Int.castRingHom` into `End(𝔾ₘ(A))`; on a fixed algebra `A` this map need not be injective, for
example when `Aˣ` has finite exponent.
decls.title: The power endomorphism is the canonical integer action
decls.statement:
theorem toAdditive_powEnd_eq_intCast (z : ℤ) :
    MonoidHom.toAdditive (powEnd (R := R) (A := A) z) =
      Int.castRingHom
        (AddMonoid.End (Additive (WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)))) z

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.charPoints_cocharPoints_apply
decls.doc:
**The character–cocharacter pairing is the exponent of a power map.** For a character `m : M`
and a cocharacter `ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ` of the diagonalizable group `D(M)`, composing the
character after the cocharacter raises a `𝔾ₘ`-point to the `⟨m, ψ⟩` power, where
`⟨m, ψ⟩ = pairing m ψ`. This is the pointwise form of `charPoints_comp_cocharPoints`, reading the
pairing off as the power to which the composite endomorphism raises a point.
decls.title: The character–cocharacter pairing is the exponent of a power map
decls.statement:
theorem charPoints_cocharPoints_apply (m : M) (ψ : M →* Multiplicative ℤ)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    charPoints (R := R) (A := A) m (cocharPoints ψ f) = f ^ pairing m ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChange
decls.doc:
Base change of a finite-type commutative Hopf algebra along `k → K`.

The underlying coordinate Hopf algebra is `K ⊗[k] H`, with the tensor-product Hopf algebra
structure over `K`.
decls.statement:
abbrev baseChange (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{w, max w v} K

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap
decls.doc: Scalar extension of a morphism of finite-type commutative Hopf algebras.
decls.statement:
abbrev baseChangeMap {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) : baseChange (K := K) H ⟶ baseChange (K := K) L

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_baseChangeMap
decls.doc:
The underlying bialgebra hom of `baseChangeMap` is tensoring the morphism with
the identity on the new base.
decls.statement:
lemma toBialgHom_baseChangeMap {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) :
    toBialgHom (baseChangeMap (K := K) φ) =
      _root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) (toBialgHom φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_apply_tmul
decls.doc: On pure tensors, `baseChangeMap` applies the original morphism to the second factor.

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor
decls.doc: Base change is functorial on finite-type commutative Hopf algebras.
decls.statement:
abbrev baseChangeFunctor :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k ⥤ FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{w, max w v} K
