decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor_obj
decls.doc: The object part of `baseChangeFunctor` is the bundled base-change object.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_obj (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k) :
    (baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).obj H = baseChange (K := K) H

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor_map
decls.doc: The morphism part of `baseChangeFunctor` is scalar extension of coordinate morphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_map {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k} (φ : H ⟶ L) :
    (baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).map φ = baseChangeMap (K := K) φ

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The points of the base-changed finite-type Hopf algebra are the original points evaluated
on the same algebra, with scalars restricted from `K` to `k`.
decls.statement:
def baseChangePointsMulEquiv (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k) :
    HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A ≃*
      HopfAlgebra.points (R := k) (H := H)
        (_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_apply
decls.doc: Applying the base-change points equivalence restricts a `K`-point along `h ↦ 1 ⊗ h`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_apply (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A) (h : H) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H f).ofConv h = f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] h)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
decls.doc:
The inverse base-change points equivalence sends a restricted point to
`s ⊗ h ↦ s • f h`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
    (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := k) (H := H)
      (_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A))
    (s : K) (h : H) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H).symm f).ofConv (s ⊗ₜ[k] h) = s • f.ofConv h

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The base-change points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
    {B : CommAlgCat.{x} K} (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k)
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) B H (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := baseChange (K := K) H) χ f) =
      HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H)
        ((_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap k K)).map χ)
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H f)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
decls.doc: The base-change points equivalence is natural in the coordinate Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) L) A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A) (toBialgHom (baseChangeMap (K := K) φ)) f) =
      AlgHom.mapDomain
        (A := _root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A)
        (toBialgHom φ)
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A L f)

decls.name: TauCeti.finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty
decls.doc:
The object property on commutative Hopf algebras selecting finite-type coordinate
algebras.
decls.statement:
def finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    ObjectProperty (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)

decls.name: TauCeti.finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the finite-type commutative Hopf algebra object property.
decls.statement:
lemma finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty R H ↔ Algebra.FiniteType R H

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat
decls.doc:
The category of finite-type commutative Hopf algebras over a commutative ring `R`.

This is the full subcategory of `CommHopfAlgCat R` on objects whose underlying commutative
`R`-algebra is finitely generated. The finite-type hypothesis is deliberately a separate
object property, not part of the Hopf algebra typeclass.
decls.statement: abbrev FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat (R : Type u) [CommRing R]

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.instCoeSortType
decls.statement: instance : CoeSort (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (Type v)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.commRing
decls.statement: instance commRing (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) : CommRing H

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.hopfAlgebra
decls.statement:
instance hopfAlgebra (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    _root_.HopfAlgebra R H

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.finiteType
decls.statement: instance finiteType (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) : Algebra.FiniteType R H

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.of
decls.doc:
Construct a bundled finite-type commutative Hopf algebra from the usual unbundled
typeclasses.
decls.statement:
abbrev of (H : Type v) [CommRing H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R H] : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom
decls.doc: Turn a morphism in `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat` back into a bialgebra morphism.
decls.statement:
abbrev toBialgHom {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    H →ₐc[R] K

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.ofHom
decls.doc:
Typecheck a bialgebra morphism between finite-type commutative Hopf algebras as a
morphism in `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement:
abbrev ofHom {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R H] [Algebra.FiniteType R K] (φ : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    of R H ⟶ of R K

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext
decls.doc:
Two morphisms of finite-type commutative Hopf algebras are equal when their underlying
bialgebra morphisms are equal.
decls.statement:
lemma hom_ext {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} {φ ψ : H ⟶ K}
    (h : toBialgHom φ = toBialgHom ψ) : φ = ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_id
decls.statement:
lemma toBialgHom_id {H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} :
    toBialgHom (𝟙 H : H ⟶ H) = BialgHom.id R H

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_comp
TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.ofHom_toBialgHom
decls.statement:
lemma ofHom_toBialgHom {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    ofHom (toBialgHom φ) = φ

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_ofHom
decls.statement:
lemma toBialgHom_ofHom {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R H] [Algebra.FiniteType R K] (φ : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    toBialgHom (ofHom (R := R) φ) = φ

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_obj
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_obj (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).obj H =
      H.obj

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map φ =
      φ.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.hasForgetToFGAlgCat
decls.doc:
The forgetful functor from finite-type commutative Hopf algebras to finitely generated
commutative algebras.
decls.statement:
instance hasForgetToFGAlgCat :
    HasForget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (FGAlgCat.{v, u} R)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_fgAlgCat_obj
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_fgAlgCat_obj (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (FGAlgCat.{v, u} R)).obj H =
      ⟨CommAlgCat.of R H, inferInstanceAs (Algebra.FiniteType R H)⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_fgAlgCat_map
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_fgAlgCat_map {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (FGAlgCat.{v, u} R)).map φ =
      ObjectProperty.homMk (CommAlgCat.ofHom (toBialgHom φ).toAlgHom)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor
decls.doc:
The contravariant group-valued functor of points of a finite-type commutative Hopf
algebra.
decls.statement:
def pointsFunctor :
    (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommAlgCat.{w} R ⥤ GrpCat.{max v w}

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_obj
decls.doc:
The object part of `pointsFunctor` is the points functor of the underlying commutative
Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_obj (H : (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)ᵒᵖ) :
    (pointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H =
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H.unop)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_map
decls.doc:
The morphism part of `pointsFunctor` is pre-composition in the coordinate commutative
Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_map {H K : (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)ᵒᵖ} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (pointsFunctor (R := R)).map φ = CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor φ.unop.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply
decls.doc:
Pointwise form of the morphism part of `pointsFunctor`: the image of a point `f` under `φ`
sends `h` to the value of `f` at the image of `h` under `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply {H K : (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)ᵒᵖ}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H.unop) A) (h : K.unop) :
    (show K.unop.obj →ₐ[R] A from
      (((pointsFunctor (R := R)).map φ).app A f).ofConv) h =
      f.ofConv (toBialgHom φ.unop (h : K.unop.obj))

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.tensorProduct_finiteType
decls.doc: The tensor product of two finite-type commutative algebras is finite type over the base.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorProduct_finiteType (A B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.FiniteType R A] [Algebra.FiniteType R B] :
    Algebra.FiniteType R (A ⊗[R] B)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.tensorProduct
decls.doc:
The tensor product of two finite-type commutative Hopf algebras, bundled as a finite-type
commutative Hopf algebra.

Contravariantly, this is the coordinate-Hopf-algebra model for the product of the represented
affine group schemes.
decls.statement:
abbrev tensorProduct (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.includeLeft
decls.doc:
The left coordinate inclusion `H → H ⊗[R] K`, bundled in the finite-type commutative
Hopf-algebra category. On points this is the first projection from product points.
decls.statement:
abbrev includeLeft (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    H ⟶ tensorProduct H K

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.includeRight
decls.doc:
The right coordinate inclusion `K → H ⊗[R] K`, bundled in the finite-type commutative
Hopf-algebra category. On points this is the second projection from product points.
decls.statement:
abbrev includeRight (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    K ⟶ tensorProduct H K

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc: The product-points equivalence for the finite-type tensor-product object.

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_fst
decls.doc: The first component of `pointsMulEquiv` is induced by the left coordinate inclusion.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_fst
    (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := tensorProduct H K) A) :
    (pointsMulEquiv A H K f).1 =
      (((pointsFunctor (R := R)).map (includeLeft H K).op).app A f)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_snd
decls.doc: The second component of `pointsMulEquiv` is induced by the right coordinate inclusion.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_snd
    (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := tensorProduct H K) A) :
    (pointsMulEquiv A H K f).2 =
      (((pointsFunctor (R := R)).map (includeRight H K).op).app A f)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse of `pointsMulEquiv` is Mathlib's tensor-product product map.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (p : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A × HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) :
    (pointsMulEquiv A H K).symm p =
      toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap p.1.ofConv p.2.ofConv)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc:
The product-points equivalence is natural in the value algebra: post-composing a point of
the product by `φ`, then splitting it into its two factor points, agrees with splitting first
and then post-composing each factor point by `φ`.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := tensorProduct H K) A) :
    pointsMulEquiv B H K (AlgHom.mapValue (H := tensorProduct H K) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) φ (pointsMulEquiv A H K f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) φ (pointsMulEquiv A H K f).2)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_fst
decls.doc: First-component form of `pointsMulEquiv_mapValue`.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_fst (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := tensorProduct H K) A) :
    (pointsMulEquiv B H K (AlgHom.mapValue (H := tensorProduct H K) φ f)).1 =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) φ (pointsMulEquiv A H K f).1

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_snd
decls.doc: Second-component form of `pointsMulEquiv_mapValue`.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_snd (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := tensorProduct H K) A) :
    (pointsMulEquiv B H K (AlgHom.mapValue (H := tensorProduct H K) φ f)).2 =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) φ (pointsMulEquiv A H K f).2

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse product-points map is natural in the value algebra: assembling an `A`-valued
product point from a pair of factor points and post-composing by `φ` is the same as
post-composing both factor points by `φ` and then assembling the resulting `B`-valued point.
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A × HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := tensorProduct H K) φ ((pointsMulEquiv A H K).symm p) =
      (pointsMulEquiv B H K).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) φ p.1, AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) φ p.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
decls.doc:
On pure tensors, naturality of the inverse product-points map evaluates post-composition by
`φ` as applying `φ` to the product of the two factor values.
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A × HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A)
    (x : H) (y : K) :
    (AlgHom.mapValue (H := tensorProduct H K) φ ((pointsMulEquiv A H K).symm p)).ofConv
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      φ (p.1.ofConv x * p.2.ofConv y)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue_apply_tmul
decls.doc:
On pure tensors, assembling after post-composing both factor points by `φ` multiplies the
two post-composed factor values.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue_apply_tmul (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A × HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A)
    (x : H) (y : K) :
    ((pointsMulEquiv B H K).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) φ p.1, AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) φ p.2)).ofConv (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      φ (p.1.ofConv x) * φ (p.2.ofConv y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.antipodeComp
decls.doc:
Post-composition of an algebra homomorphism `f : H →ₐ[R] A` with the antipode `S` of
`H`, as an `R`-algebra homomorphism `H →ₐ[R] A`. Its underlying linear map is
`f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ HopfAlgebra.antipode R`. This is well-defined even when `H` is
noncommutative: `S` is an antihomomorphism (`HopfAlgebra.antipode_mul_antidistrib`), and `A` is
commutative, so `f ∘ S` is a homomorphism.
decls.statement: def antipodeComp (f : H →ₐ[R] A) : H →ₐ[R] A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.toLinearMap_antipodeComp
decls.statement:
lemma toLinearMap_antipodeComp (f : H →ₐ[R] A) :
    (antipodeComp f).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.instInv
decls.doc:
The convolution inverse of an `R`-algebra homomorphism `f : H →ₐ[R] A` out of a Hopf
algebra is `f ∘ S`, where `S` is the antipode.
decls.statement: instance instInv : Inv (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.convInv_def
decls.doc:
The convolution inverse of `f` is `f ∘ S`, where `S` is the antipode: definitionally,
`f⁻¹ = toConv (antipodeComp f.ofConv)`. Kept private as an implementation detail of the group
instance; the public pointwise characterization is `convInv_apply`.
decls.statement:
lemma convInv_def (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    f⁻¹ = toConv (antipodeComp f.ofConv)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.convInv_apply
decls.doc:
Pointwise, the convolution inverse of `f` sends `h` to `f (S h)`, where `S` is the
antipode.
decls.statement:
lemma convInv_apply (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H) :
    f⁻¹ h = f.ofConv (antipode R h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.instGroup
decls.doc:
For a Hopf algebra `H` over `R` and a commutative `R`-algebra `A`, the convolution
monoid of `R`-algebra homomorphisms `H →ₐ[R] A` is a group, with inverse `f ↦ f ∘ S`. When
`H` is moreover commutative, `Spec H` is an affine group scheme and this is the group
structure on its functor of points evaluated at `A`.
decls.statement: instance instGroup : Group (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue
decls.doc:
Functoriality of `A ↦ (H →ₐ[R] A)` in the value algebra: an `R`-algebra homomorphism
`φ : A →ₐ[R] B` induces, by post-composition, a monoid homomorphism between the convolution
monoids. This needs only the bialgebra structure on `H`. When `H` is moreover a Hopf algebra,
these convolution monoids are the convolution groups (`instGroup`); a `MonoidHom` between
groups is automatically a group homomorphism, so no separate construction is needed there.
decls.statement:
def mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H →ₐ[R] B)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_apply
decls.doc: `mapValue φ` acts pointwise by post-composition: `(mapValue φ f) = φ ∘ f`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapValue_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapValue φ f = toConv (φ.comp f.ofConv)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_id
decls.doc: `mapValue` preserves the identity: `mapValue (𝟙 A)` is the identity monoid homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma mapValue_id :
    mapValue (H := H) (AlgHom.id R A) = MonoidHom.id (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_comp
decls.doc: `mapValue` preserves composition: `mapValue (ψ ∘ φ) = mapValue ψ ∘ mapValue φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapValue_comp (ψ : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    mapValue (H := H) (ψ.comp φ) = (mapValue ψ).comp (mapValue φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.instCommGroup
decls.doc:
When `H` is moreover cocommutative, the convolution group of `R`-algebra homomorphisms
`H →ₐ[R] A` is abelian.
decls.statement: instance instCommGroup : CommGroup (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.single_sub_one_pow_eq_zero
decls.doc:
In characteristic `p`, the `p`-th power of `single g 1 - 1` collapses by the freshman's
dream to `single (g ^ p) 1 - 1`; when `g ^ p = 1` this is `single 1 1 - 1 = 0`.
decls.statement:
theorem single_sub_one_pow_eq_zero {g : G} (hgp : g ^ p = 1) :
    (MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : R) - 1) ^ p = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.isNilpotent_single_sub_one
decls.doc:
The group-like difference `single g 1 - 1` is nilpotent when `g ^ p = 1` in characteristic
`p`: its `p`-th power vanishes.
decls.statement:
theorem isNilpotent_single_sub_one {g : G} (hgp : g ^ p = 1) :
    IsNilpotent (MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : R) - 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.single_sub_one_ne_zero
decls.doc:
The group-like difference `single g 1 - 1` is nonzero when `g ≠ 1`, since `single` is
injective in its index (the coefficient `1` is nonzero over a nontrivial base).
decls.statement:
theorem single_sub_one_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {g : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) :
    MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : R) - 1 ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.not_isReduced_monoidAlgebra
decls.doc:
**A diagonalizable group with `p`-torsion is non-reduced in characteristic `p`.** If `R` has
characteristic `p` and `G` has a nontrivial element `g` with `g ^ p = 1`, then the coordinate
Hopf algebra `R[G]` of `D(G)` is not reduced: `single g 1 - 1` is a nonzero nilpotent.
decls.title: A diagonalizable group with `p`-torsion is non-reduced in characteristic `p`
decls.statement:
theorem not_isReduced_monoidAlgebra [Nontrivial R] {g : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) (hgp : g ^ p = 1) :
    ¬ IsReduced (MonoidAlgebra R G)

decls.name: TauCeti.RootsOfUnityGroup.generator_ne_one
decls.doc:
The standard generator of `μ_p = D(ℤ/p)` is nontrivial: `ofAdd 1 ≠ 1` because `1 ≠ 0` in the
field `ZMod p`.
decls.statement: theorem generator_ne_one : generator p ≠ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.RootsOfUnityGroup.generator_pow_eq_one
decls.doc:
The standard generator of `μ_p = D(ℤ/p)` is `p`-torsion: `(ofAdd 1) ^ p = ofAdd (p • 1) = 1`
since `p = 0` in `ZMod p`.
decls.statement: theorem generator_pow_eq_one : generator p ^ p = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.RootsOfUnityGroup.coordinateRing_not_isReduced
decls.doc:
**The coordinate Hopf algebra of `μ_p` is non-reduced in characteristic `p`.** Over a
nontrivial base `R` of characteristic `p`, the group algebra `R[Multiplicative (ZMod p)]`
representing `μ_p = D(ℤ/p)` is not reduced: the group-like difference
`single (ofAdd 1) 1 - 1` is a nonzero nilpotent. Geometrically this exhibits `μ_p` as a
non-smooth affine group scheme, the canonical non-reduced example admitted by the
finite-type theory.
decls.title: The coordinate Hopf algebra of `μ_p` is non-reduced in characteristic `p`
decls.statement:
theorem coordinateRing_not_isReduced [Nontrivial R] :
    ¬ IsReduced (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative (ZMod p)))

decls.name: TauCeti.RootsOfUnityGroup.isNilpotent_single_generator_sub_one
decls.doc:
The explicit nonzero nilpotent in the coordinate Hopf algebra of `μ_p`: the difference
`single (ofAdd 1) 1 - 1` of the group-like generator and the identity.
decls.statement:
theorem isNilpotent_single_generator_sub_one :
    IsNilpotent (MonoidAlgebra.single (generator p) (1 : R) - 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
**The monoid algebra of a product gives the product functor on convolution points.**
For commutative monoids `G` and `H` and every commutative `R`-algebra `A`, the convolution
monoid of `A`-points of `Spec R[G × H]` is the product of the convolution monoids of
`A`-points of `Spec R[G]` and `Spec R[H]`.
decls.title: The monoid algebra of a product gives the product functor on convolution points

decls.name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_fst_ofConv_single
decls.doc:
The first component of `prodPointsMulEquiv` restricts an `A`-point of `Spec R[G × H]` to
the factor `Spec R[G]`: on the generator `single g 1` it evaluates the original point at
`single (g, 1) 1`, the image of `g` under `G → G × H`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_fst_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G × H) →ₐ[R] A)) (g : G) :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1.ofConv (single g (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single (g, (1 : H)) 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
decls.doc:
The second component of `prodPointsMulEquiv` restricts an `A`-point of `Spec R[G × H]` to
the factor `Spec R[H]`: on the generator `single h 1` it evaluates the original point at
`single (1, h) 1`, the image of `h` under `H → G × H`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G × H) →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H) :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2.ofConv (single h (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single ((1 : G), h) 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
decls.doc:
The inverse of `prodPointsMulEquiv` assembles an `A`-point of `Spec R[G × H]` from a pair of
points of `Spec R[G]` and `Spec R[H]`: on the generator `single (g, h) 1` it multiplies the
value of the first point at `single g 1` and the value of the second at `single h 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
    (f₁ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) (f₂ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R H →ₐ[R] A))
    (g : G) (h : H) :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv.symm (f₁, f₂)).ofConv (single (g, h) (1 : R)) =
      f₁.ofConv (single g 1) * f₂.ofConv (single h 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The product-points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G × H) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    prodPointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R (G × H)) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G) φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R H) φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
**The diagonalizable group of a product is the product of diagonalizable groups, on points.**
For commutative groups `G` and `H` and every commutative `R`-algebra `A`, the convolution group
of `A`-points of `D(G × H)` is the product of the convolution groups of `A`-points of `D(G)` and
`D(H)`.
decls.title: The diagonalizable group of a product is the product of diagonalizable groups, on points

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_fst_ofConv_single
decls.doc:
On generators, the first component of the diagonalizable product-points equivalence restricts
along `g ↦ (g, 1)`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_fst_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) (g : G') :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1.ofConv (single g (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single (g, (1 : H')) 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
decls.doc:
On generators, the second component of the diagonalizable product-points equivalence restricts
along `h ↦ (1, h)`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H') :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2.ofConv (single h (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single ((1 : G'), h) 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
decls.doc:
On generators, the inverse diagonalizable product-points equivalence multiplies the two
factor-point values.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
    (f₁ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G' →ₐ[R] A)) (f₂ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R H' →ₐ[R] A))
    (g : G') (h : H') :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv.symm (f₁, f₂)).ofConv (single (g, h) (1 : R)) =
      f₁.ofConv (single g 1) * f₂.ofConv (single h 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The diagonalizable product-points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue {B : Type*} [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B] (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) :
    prodPointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H')) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G') φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R H') φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2)

decls.name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_prodPointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The diagonalizable product-points equivalence agrees with the existing character
description of diagonalizable-group points: reading the character of a product point is the
coproduct of the characters read from its two restrictions.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_prodPointsMulEquiv
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G' × H') f =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G') (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1).coprod
        (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := H') (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The points of the quotient by the Hopf-ideal kernel of a surjective Hopf algebra
morphism are the points of its codomain.

Contravariantly, this is induced by the bialgebra equivalence
`H ⧸ ker f ≃ₐc[R] K` from the Hopf-algebra first isomorphism theorem.

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The quotient-kernel point equivalence acts by pre-composition with the inverse
bialgebra equivalence `K ≃ₐc[R] H ⧸ ker f`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : WithConv (H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal →ₐ[R] A)) :
    quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A g =
      AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
        ((kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf).symm : K →ₐc[R] H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) g

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse quotient-kernel point equivalence acts by pre-composition with the
bialgebra equivalence `H ⧸ ker f ≃ₐc[R] K`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : WithConv (K →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A).symm g =
      AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
        (kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf : H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal →ₐc[R] K) g

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The quotient-kernel point equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_mapValue {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : WithConv (H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal →ₐ[R] A)) :
    quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf (CommAlgCat.of R B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) χ g) =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) χ (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A g)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mapValue_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse quotient-kernel point equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : WithConv (K →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) χ
        ((quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A).symm g) =
      (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf (CommAlgCat.of R B)).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) χ g)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
Including the quotient point attached to a `K`-point back into ambient `H`-points is
pre-composition along the original surjective Hopf algebra morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) :
    CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.of R H) (ker f hf) A
        ((quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A).symm g) =
      AlgHom.mapDomain f g

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_apply
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) (h : H) :
    (CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.of R H) (ker f hf) A
        ((quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A).symm g)).ofConv h = g.ofConv (f h)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
For an arbitrary point of `H ⧸ ker f`, the quotient-points inclusion agrees with first
identifying it as a `K`-point and then pre-composing along `f`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) A) :
    CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.of R H) (ker f hf) A g =
      AlgHom.mapDomain f (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A g)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsHom_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) A) (h : H) :
    (CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.of R H) (ker f hf) A g).ofConv h =
      (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A g).ofConv (f h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.convMul_comp_bialgHom_distrib_of_semiring_source
decls.statement:
lemma convMul_comp_bialgHom_distrib_of_semiring_source
    (f g : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    AlgHom.comp (f * g).ofConv (φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂) =
      ofConv (toConv (f.ofConv.comp φ) * toConv (g.ofConv.comp φ))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain
decls.doc:
Contravariant functoriality of convolution algebra homomorphisms in the source
bialgebra. A bialgebra morphism `φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂` sends an `A`-valued point of `H₂` to an
`A`-valued point of `H₁` by pre-composition.
decls.statement:
def mapDomain (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_apply
decls.doc: `mapDomain φ` acts pointwise by pre-composition with `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomain_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapDomain φ f = toConv (f.ofConv.comp (φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `mapDomain_apply`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomain_apply_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H₁) :
    mapDomain φ f h = f.ofConv (φ h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_id
decls.doc:
Pre-composition by the identity bialgebra morphism is the identity map on the
convolution monoid.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomain_id :
    (mapDomain (BialgHom.id R H₁) : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) =
      MonoidHom.id (WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_comp
decls.doc:
Pre-composition by a composite bialgebra morphism is the composite of the corresponding
pre-composition maps.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomain_comp (ψ : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₃) (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₃) (ψ.comp φ) :
        WithConv (H₃ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) =
      (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
          WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)).comp
        (mapDomain (H₁ := H₂) (H₂ := H₃) ψ :
          WithConv (H₃ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv
decls.doc:
A bialgebra isomorphism `e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂` induces a multiplicative equivalence of the
convolution monoids of points, by pre-composition: the equiv-version of the contravariant
functoriality `mapDomain`.
decls.statement:
def mapDomainMulEquiv (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) :
    WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) ≃* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc: `mapDomainMulEquiv` acts by the underlying `mapDomain` in the forward direction.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomainMulEquiv_apply (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapDomainMulEquiv e f = mapDomain (e : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
`mapDomainMulEquiv` acts by pre-composition with the inverse bialgebra equivalence in the
reverse direction.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomainMulEquiv_symm_apply (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (mapDomainMulEquiv (A := A) e).symm f = mapDomain (e.symm : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₁) f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_mapDomain
decls.doc:
Pre-composition in the coordinate bialgebra commutes with post-composition in the value
algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma mapValue_mapDomain (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
        WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] B) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] B)).comp
        (mapValue (H := H₂) χ) =
      (mapValue (H := H₁) χ).comp
        (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
          WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_inv_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse in the target convolution group is transported by `mapDomain` pointwise as
pre-composition with the bialgebra morphism. The group homomorphism statement follows from
`mapDomain` being a `MonoidHom`; this lemma records the concrete formula used at points.
decls.statement:
lemma mapDomain_inv_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H₁) :
    mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ (f⁻¹ : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) h =
      f.ofConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (φ h))

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom
decls.doc:
The map on `A`-points induced by the quotient coordinate morphism `H ⟶ H ⧸ I`.

Contravariantly, this is the closed-subgroup inclusion on points: it sends a point of the
quotient Hopf algebra to its composite with the quotient map from `H`.
decls.statement:
def quotientPointsHom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A ⟶
      HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_apply
decls.doc: The quotient-points map acts by pre-composition with the quotient morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A f =
      toConv (f.ofConv.comp ((mkQuotient H I).hom : H →ₐ[R] quotient H I))

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_apply`.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_apply_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) (h : H) :
    ((quotientPointsHom H I A f).ofConv) h =
      f.ofConv (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_injective
decls.doc: The map from quotient points to ambient points is injective.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_injective (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    Function.Injective (quotientPointsHom H I A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotientPoint
decls.doc: An ambient `A`-point factors through `H ⧸ I` when it kills the Hopf ideal `I`.
decls.statement:
def liftQuotientPoint (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) :
    HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotientPoint_mk
decls.doc:
The quotient point built from a point killing `I` evaluates on a quotient class by
choosing any representative.
decls.statement:
lemma liftQuotientPoint_mk (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) (h : H) :
    ((liftQuotientPoint H I A g hg).ofConv) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      g.ofConv h

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint
decls.doc:
Factoring a point that kills `I` through the quotient and then including it back in the
ambient point group recovers the original point.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A (liftQuotientPoint H I A g hg) = g

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mem_range_quotientPointsHom_iff
decls.doc:
A point of the ambient Hopf algebra lies in the image of quotient points if and only if it
kills the Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_range_quotientPointsHom_iff (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A) :
    g ∈ Set.range (quotientPointsHom H I A) ↔ ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup
decls.doc:
The subgroup of ambient `A`-points cut out by a Hopf ideal `I`.

Its elements are exactly those algebra maps `H →ₐ[R] A` that vanish on `I`; this is the
point-level closed subgroup represented by the quotient coordinate Hopf algebra `H ⧸ I`.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the subgroup of points cut out by a Hopf ideal is vanishing on that ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A) :
    g ∈ quotientPointsSubgroup H I A ↔ ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup
decls.doc: The included quotient point belongs to the subgroup cut out by the Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A f ∈ quotientPointsSubgroup H I A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPoints_quotientPointsHom
decls.doc: The quotient-points inclusion is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPoints_quotientPointsHom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ (quotientPointsHom H I A f) =
      quotientPointsHom H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ f)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPoints_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup
decls.doc: Post-composition preserves the ambient-point subgroup cut out by a Hopf ideal.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup
decls.doc: The functor-of-points map restricted to the subgroups cut out by a Hopf ideal.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor
decls.doc: The value-algebra functor of the point subgroups cut out by a Hopf ideal.

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_obj
decls.doc: The object part of the subgroup functor is the cut-out point subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_obj (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I).obj A =
      GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map
decls.doc: The map part of the subgroup functor is the restricted value-algebra map.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I).map χ =
      GrpCat.ofHom (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIncl
decls.doc: The subgroup functor includes naturally into the ambient functor of points.
decls.statement:
def quotientPointsSubgroupIncl (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I ⟶
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIncl_app
decls.doc: The component of the subgroup inclusion is the subgroup subtype map.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIncl_app (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIncl H I).app A =
      GrpCat.ofHom (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A).subtype

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply
decls.doc: The restricted map on cut-out subgroups is induced by the ambient functor-of-points map.
decls.statement:
lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ g =
      ⟨HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ g,
        mapPoints_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I χ g.property⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.coe_mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply
decls.doc: Coercing the restricted subgroup map gives the ambient functor-of-points map.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ g :
      HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) B) =
      HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ g

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of the restricted subgroup map.
decls.statement:
lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) (h : H) :
    ((mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ g :
      HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) B).ofConv) h =
      χ.hom (g.val.ofConv h)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_id
decls.doc: The restricted subgroup maps preserve identity morphisms of value algebras.
decls.statement:
lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_id (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I (𝟙 A) =
      MonoidHom.id (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_comp
decls.doc: The restricted subgroup maps preserve composition of value-algebra morphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_comp (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B C : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B) (ψ : B ⟶ C) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I (χ ≫ ψ) =
      (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I ψ).comp
        (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotientPointHom
TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotientPointHom_apply
decls.statement:
lemma liftQuotientPointHom_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    liftQuotientPointHom H I A g =
      liftQuotientPoint H I A g ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mp g.property)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso
decls.doc: The component isomorphism between quotient points and the cut-out subgroup.
decls.statement:
def quotientPointsSubgroupIso (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    GrpCat.of (HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) ≅
      GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_apply
decls.doc: The component isomorphism sends a quotient point to its included ambient point.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIso H I A).hom f =
      (⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ :
        quotientPointsSubgroup H I A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse component is the quotient point factoring the included ambient point.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIso_inv_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIso H I A).inv g =
      liftQuotientPoint H I A g ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mp g.property)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom_aux
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom_aux
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
        ⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ =
      ⟨quotientPointsHom H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ f),
        quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I B _⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso
decls.doc: The quotient Hopf algebra represents the subgroup functor cut out by the Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
def quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := quotient H I) ≅
      quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_hom_app_apply
decls.doc: The natural isomorphism's forward component is the quotient-subgroup component isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_hom_app_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
        (X := HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := quotient H I).obj A)
        (Y := GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A))
        ((quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso H I).hom.app A) f =
      (⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ :
        quotientPointsSubgroup H I A)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_inv_app_apply
decls.doc: The natural isomorphism's inverse component is the quotient lift of a subgroup point.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_inv_app_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
        (X := GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A))
        (Y := HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := quotient H I).obj A)
        ((quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso H I).inv.app A) g =
      liftQuotientPoint H I A g ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mp g.property)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom
decls.doc:
The image of a quotient point under the subgroup functor is its mapped quotient point,
viewed inside the cut-out subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
        ⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ =
      ⟨quotientPointsHom H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ f),
        quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I B _⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint
decls.doc: Factoring an ambient point through the quotient is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
lemma mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) :
    HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ
        (liftQuotientPoint H I A g hg) =
      liftQuotientPoint H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ g)
        (by
          intro h hh
          exact (mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I B _).mp
            (mapPoints_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
              ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mpr hg)) h hh)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_antitone
decls.doc:
The point subgroup cut out by a Hopf ideal is antitone in the Hopf ideal:
larger ideals impose more vanishing equations.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_antitone (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    Antitone fun I : HopfIdeal R H => quotientPointsSubgroup H I A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le
decls.doc:
If `I ≤ J`, then the point subgroup cut out by `J` is contained in the point subgroup
cut out by `I`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    quotientPointsSubgroup H J A ≤ quotientPointsSubgroup H I A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_of_le
decls.doc: Rewriting form of `quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le` as a membership implication.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_of_le (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    {g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A}
    (hg : g ∈ quotientPointsSubgroup H J A) :
    g ∈ quotientPointsSubgroup H I A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_eq_of_eq
decls.doc: If `I = J`, then the point subgroups cut out by `I` and `J` are equal.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_eq_of_eq (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I = J) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    quotientPointsSubgroup H I A = quotientPointsSubgroup H J A

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_bot
decls.doc: The point subgroup cut out by the zero Hopf ideal is the full ambient point group.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_bot (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    quotientPointsSubgroup H (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) A = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_inclusion_apply
decls.doc: The subgroup inclusions associated to `I ≤ J` commute with maps of value algebras.
decls.statement:
theorem mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_inclusion_apply
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H J A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
        (Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ A) g) =
      Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ B)
        (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H J χ g)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion
decls.doc: The natural inclusion of subgroup functors associated to `I ≤ J`.
decls.statement:
def quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H J ⟶
      quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_app
decls.doc: The component of `quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion` is the subgroup inclusion.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_app
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H hIJ).app A =
      GrpCat.ofHom (Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ A))

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_refl
decls.doc: The inclusion associated to reflexivity is the identity natural transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_refl
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H (le_refl I) =
      𝟙 (quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_comp
decls.doc: Inclusions of quotient point subgroup functors compose along transitive ideal inclusions.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_comp
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J K : HopfIdeal R H}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H hJK ≫
        quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H hIJ =
      quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H (hIJ.trans hJK)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotient
decls.doc:
The quotient of a commutative Hopf algebra by a Hopf ideal, as a bundled commutative
Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
abbrev quotient (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient morphism `H ⟶ H ⧸ I` in `CommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement:
abbrev mkQuotient (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    H ⟶ quotient H I

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_mkQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient morphism has the expected underlying bialgebra morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma hom_mkQuotient (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    (mkQuotient H I).hom = Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_apply
decls.doc: The quotient morphism sends an element to its quotient class.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) (h : H) :
    (mkQuotient H I).hom h = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_ker
decls.doc: The kernel of the quotient morphism is the Hopf ideal being quotiented by.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_ker (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    RingHom.ker (mkQuotient H I).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom = I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: An element maps to zero in the quotient exactly when it belongs to the Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) (h : H) :
    (mkQuotient H I).hom h = 0 ↔ h ∈ I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient
decls.doc:
A morphism of commutative Hopf algebras out of `H` which kills a Hopf ideal factors
through the quotient object.
decls.statement:
abbrev liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) : quotient H I ⟶ K

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_liftQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient lift has the expected underlying bialgebra morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma hom_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (liftQuotient I f hf).hom = Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom I.toIdeal f.hom hf

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_mk
decls.doc: The quotient lift evaluates on quotient classes as the original morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma liftQuotient_mk (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (h : H) :
    (liftQuotient I f hf).hom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      f.hom h

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient lift composed with the quotient morphism is the original morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ liftQuotient I f hf = f

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_unique
decls.doc:
A morphism out of the quotient object is determined by its precomposition with the
quotient morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma liftQuotient_unique (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : quotient H I ⟶ K)
    (hg : mkQuotient H I ≫ g = f) : g = liftQuotient I f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le
decls.doc: If `I ≤ J`, then the quotient map by `J` kills every element of `I`.
decls.statement:
lemma toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (mkQuotient H J).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe
decls.doc:
The coordinate morphism `H ⧸ I ⟶ H ⧸ J` induced by an inclusion `I ≤ J` of Hopf
ideals.

It is the unique morphism out of `H ⧸ I` whose composite with `H ⟶ H ⧸ I` is the quotient
map `H ⟶ H ⧸ J`.
decls.statement:
abbrev quotientMapOfLe (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) : quotient H I ⟶ quotient H J

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_mk
decls.doc:
The quotient-to-quotient morphism sends the class of `h` modulo `I` to its class
modulo `J`.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_mk (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J) (h : H) :
    (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ).hom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe
decls.doc:
Composing the quotient map `H ⟶ H ⧸ I` with the quotient-to-quotient morphism for
`I ≤ J` gives the quotient map `H ⟶ H ⧸ J`.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hIJ = mkQuotient H J

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_refl
decls.doc: The quotient-to-quotient morphism for `I ≤ I` is the identity morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_refl (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientMapOfLe H (le_refl I) = 𝟙 (quotient H I)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_comp
decls.doc: Quotient-to-quotient morphisms compose along inclusions of Hopf ideals.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_comp (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J K : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientMapOfLe H hIJ ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hJK =
      quotientMapOfLe H (hIJ.trans hJK)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotient
decls.doc:
The quotient of a finite-type commutative Hopf algebra by a Hopf ideal, as a bundled
finite-type commutative Hopf algebra.
decls.statement:
abbrev quotient (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient morphism `H ⟶ H ⧸ I` in `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat`.
decls.statement:
abbrev mkQuotient (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) : H ⟶ quotient H I

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_mkQuotient
decls.doc: The finite-type quotient morphism forgets to the `CommHopfAlgCat` quotient morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_mkQuotient (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map
      (mkQuotient H I) = CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient H.obj I

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_ker
decls.doc: The kernel of the finite-type quotient morphism is the Hopf ideal being quotiented by.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_ker (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    RingHom.ker (toBialgHom (mkQuotient H I)).toAlgHom.toRingHom = I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
An element maps to zero in the finite-type quotient exactly when it belongs to the Hopf
ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (h : H) : toBialgHom (mkQuotient H I) h = 0 ↔ h ∈ I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient
decls.doc:
A morphism of finite-type commutative Hopf algebras out of `H` which kills a Hopf ideal
factors through the quotient object.
decls.statement:
abbrev liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) : quotient H I ⟶ K

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_liftQuotient
decls.doc: The finite-type quotient lift forgets to the `CommHopfAlgCat` quotient lift.
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map
      (liftQuotient I f hf) = CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient I f.hom hf

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient lift composed with the quotient morphism is the original morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ liftQuotient I f hf = f

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_unique
decls.doc:
A morphism out of the quotient object is determined by its precomposition with the
quotient morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma liftQuotient_unique (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : quotient H I ⟶ K)
    (hg : mkQuotient H I ≫ g = f) : g = liftQuotient I f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe
decls.doc:
The finite-type coordinate morphism `H ⧸ I ⟶ H ⧸ J` induced by an inclusion `I ≤ J` of
Hopf ideals.
decls.statement:
abbrev quotientMapOfLe (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) : quotient H I ⟶ quotient H J

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_quotientMapOfLe
decls.doc:
The finite-type quotient-to-quotient morphism forgets to the `CommHopfAlgCat`
quotient-to-quotient morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_quotientMapOfLe
    (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map
        (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ) =
      CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe H.obj hIJ

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_mk
decls.doc:
The finite-type quotient-to-quotient morphism sends the class of `h` modulo `I` to its
class modulo `J`.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_mk (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (h : H) :
    (toBialgHom (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe
decls.doc:
Composing the finite-type quotient map `H ⟶ H ⧸ I` with the quotient-to-quotient
morphism for `I ≤ J` gives the quotient map `H ⟶ H ⧸ J`.
decls.statement:
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hIJ = mkQuotient H J

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_refl
decls.doc: The finite-type quotient-to-quotient morphism for `I ≤ I` is the identity morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_refl (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientMapOfLe H (le_refl I) = 𝟙 (quotient H I)

decls.name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_comp
decls.doc: Finite-type quotient-to-quotient morphisms compose along inclusions of Hopf ideals.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_comp (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J K : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientMapOfLe H hIJ ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hJK =
      quotientMapOfLe H (hIJ.trans hJK)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
decls.doc:
On points, precomposition with `quotientMapOfLe` is compatible with the ambient
quotient-points inclusions.

Starting with a point of `H ⧸ J`, mapping it to a point of `H ⧸ I` and then including into
ambient `H`-points gives the same ambient point as the direct inclusion from `H ⧸ J`.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H J) A) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A ((mapPointsFunctor (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)).app A f) =
      quotientPointsHom H J A f

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app_apply
decls.doc:
The pointwise form of
`CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app`.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app_apply
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H J) A) (h : H) :
    (quotientPointsHom H I A ((mapPointsFunctor (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)).app A f)).ofConv h =
      f.ofConv (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h)

decls.name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
decls.doc:
Under the quotient-point subgroup isomorphisms, the points map induced by
`quotientMapOfLe` is exactly the subgroup inclusion attached to `I ≤ J`.
decls.statement:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H J) A) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIso H I A).hom
        ((mapPointsFunctor (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)).app A f) =
      Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ A)
        ((quotientPointsSubgroupIso H J A).hom f)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The `A`-points of the base change `K ⊗[k] k[T;T⁻¹]` of the multiplicative group are
the unit group `Aˣ`.

The source is the convolution group of `K`-algebra maps out of the base-changed Hopf algebra.
The target is the ordinary unit group of the value algebra.
decls.statement:
def baseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (K ⊗[k] k[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[K] A) ≃* Aˣ

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The base-changed multiplicative-group points equivalence reads a point by evaluating it
on the base-changed coordinate `1 ⊗ T`.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] k[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[K] A)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv f : A) =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] LaurentPolynomial.T 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_C_mul_T
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed multiplicative-group points equivalence evaluates pure Laurent
monomials `s ⊗ C r * T n` as scalar multiples of the corresponding power of the chosen unit.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_C_mul_T (u : Aˣ) (s : K) (r : k) (n : ℤ) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A)).symm u).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] (LaurentPolynomial.C r * LaurentPolynomial.T n)) =
      s • (r • ((u ^ n : Aˣ) : A))

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_T
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed multiplicative-group points equivalence evaluates pure tensors
`s ⊗ T n` as scalar multiples of the corresponding power of the chosen unit.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_T (u : Aˣ) (s : K) (n : ℤ) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A)).symm u).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      s • ((u ^ n : Aˣ) : A)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_T
decls.doc:
The inverse base-changed multiplicative-group points equivalence takes `1 ⊗ T` to the
chosen unit.
decls.statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_T (u : Aˣ) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A)).symm u).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] LaurentPolynomial.T 1) =
      (u : A)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.point
decls.doc:
The `R[T;T⁻¹]`-point of the multiplicative group corresponding to a unit of the value
algebra. It sends `T n` to `u ^ n`.
decls.statement: def point (u : Aˣ) : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.point_T
decls.doc: The point associated to a unit sends `T n` to `u ^ n`.
decls.statement:
theorem point_T (u : Aˣ) (n : ℤ) :
    point (R := R) (A := A) u (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = (u ^ n).val

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.point_C
decls.doc: The point associated to a unit sends constants through the algebra map.
decls.statement:
theorem point_C (u : Aˣ) (r : R) :
    point (R := R) (A := A) u (LaurentPolynomial.C r) = algebraMap R A r

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.unitOfPoint
decls.doc: The unit of `A` obtained by evaluating an `R[T;T⁻¹]`-point at `T`.
decls.statement: def unitOfPoint (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) : Aˣ

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.unitOfPoint_val
decls.doc: Evaluating `unitOfPoint f` as an element of `A` gives the value of `f` on `T`.
decls.statement:
theorem unitOfPoint_val (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) :
    (unitOfPoint f : A) = f (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.unitOfPoint_inv
decls.doc: The inverse of `unitOfPoint f` is the value of `f` on `T⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
theorem unitOfPoint_inv (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) :
    ↑(unitOfPoint f)⁻¹ = f (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.unitOfPoint_point
decls.doc: The point-to-unit construction inverts `point`.
decls.statement: theorem unitOfPoint_point (u : Aˣ) : unitOfPoint (point (R := R) (A := A) u) = u

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.point_unitOfPoint_single
decls.statement:
theorem point_unitOfPoint_single (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) (n : ℤ) :
    (unitOfPoint f ^ n).val = f (LaurentPolynomial.T n)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.point_unitOfPoint
decls.doc: The unit-to-point construction inverts `unitOfPoint`.
decls.statement:
theorem point_unitOfPoint (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) :
    point (R := R) (A := A) (unitOfPoint f) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointEquiv
decls.doc: Algebra maps out of `R[T;T⁻¹]` are the same as units of the value algebra.
decls.statement: def pointEquiv : (R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) ≃ Aˣ

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The equivalence sends a point to its value on `T`.
decls.statement:
theorem pointEquiv_apply (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) :
    pointEquiv (R := R) (A := A) f = unitOfPoint f

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse equivalence sends a unit to the corresponding evaluation map.
decls.statement:
theorem pointEquiv_symm_apply (u : Aˣ) :
    (pointEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm u = point (R := R) (A := A) u

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The functor of points of the multiplicative group is the unit group of the value algebra.

The source is the convolution group of `R`-algebra maps out of `R[T;T⁻¹]`; the target is the
ordinary unit group of `A`.
decls.statement: def pointsMulEquiv : WithConv (R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) ≃* Aˣ

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The multiplicative equivalence sends a convolution point to its value on `T`.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_apply (f : WithConv (R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) f = unitOfPoint f.ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse multiplicative equivalence sends a unit to the corresponding point.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (u : Aˣ) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm u = toConv (point (R := R) (A := A) u)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.unitOfPoint_comp
decls.doc:
Reading a Laurent-polynomial point as a unit is natural under post-composition of algebra
maps.
decls.statement:
theorem unitOfPoint_comp (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) :
    unitOfPoint (φ.comp f) = Units.map φ.toMonoidHom (unitOfPoint f)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointEquiv_comp
decls.doc: The plain Laurent-polynomial points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem pointEquiv_comp (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) :
    pointEquiv (R := R) (A := B) (φ.comp f) =
      Units.map φ.toMonoidHom (pointEquiv (R := R) (A := A) f)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.comp_point
decls.doc: Naturality of the inverse plain points equivalence in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem comp_point (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (u : Aˣ) :
    φ.comp (point (R := R) (A := A) u) =
      point (R := R) (A := B) (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom u)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.unitOfPoint_mapValue
decls.doc:
Reading a multiplicative-group point as a unit is natural in the value algebra:
post-composing the point with an `R`-algebra map applies the induced map on unit groups.
decls.statement:
theorem unitOfPoint_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A)) :
    unitOfPoint ((AlgHom.mapValue (H := R[T;T⁻¹]) φ f).ofConv) =
      Units.map φ.toMonoidHom (unitOfPoint f.ofConv)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
decls.doc: The `𝔾ₘ` points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := R[T;T⁻¹]) φ f) =
      Units.map φ.toMonoidHom (pointsMulEquiv f)

decls.name: TauCeti.MultiplicativeGroup.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: Naturality of the inverse `𝔾ₘ` points equivalence in the value algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (u : Aˣ) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := R[T;T⁻¹]) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm u) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)).symm (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom u)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.points
decls.doc:
The group of `A`-points of the affine group object represented by a Hopf algebra `H`.

The underlying type is `WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)`: algebra homomorphisms from `H` to `A`, with
the convolution group structure supplied by the antipode of `H`.
decls.statement: abbrev points (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) : GrpCat.{max v w}
