decls.doc: The forgetful functor from comodules to their underlying semimodules.
decls.statement: instance hasForgetToSemimodule : HasForget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.forget₂_obj
decls.doc: The forgetful functor sends a comodule to its underlying semimodule.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_obj (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).obj M =
      SemimoduleCat.of R M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.forget₂_map
decls.doc: The forgetful functor sends a comodule morphism to its underlying linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_map {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).map f =
      SemimoduleCat.ofHom f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv
decls.doc: A categorical isomorphism of comodules induces the underlying linear equivalence.
decls.statement: def isoToLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) : M ≃ₗ[R] N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The linear equivalence induced by a comodule isomorphism has the isomorphism's forward
comodule morphism underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).toLinearMap = i.hom.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The inverse of the linear equivalence induced by a comodule isomorphism has the
isomorphism's inverse comodule morphism underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm.toLinearMap = i.inv.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The linear equivalence induced by a comodule isomorphism applies as its forward morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) (m : M) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i m = i.hom m

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse linear equivalence induced by a comodule isomorphism applies as the inverse
morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N)
    (n : N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm n = i.inv n

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_refl
decls.doc: The linear equivalence induced by the identity comodule isomorphism is the identity.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_refl (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (Iso.refl M) = LinearEquiv.refl R M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_symm
decls.doc:
The linear equivalence induced by the inverse comodule isomorphism is the inverse linear
equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i.symm =
      (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_trans
decls.doc:
The linear equivalence induced by a composite comodule isomorphism is the composite of
the induced linear equivalences.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_trans {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N)
    (j : N ≅ P) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (i ≪≫ j) =
      (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).trans
        (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) j)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
Build a comodule isomorphism from a linear equivalence whose forward map respects the
coactions.
decls.statement:
def isoOfLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (h : TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap)
    : M ≅ N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The forward morphism of `isoOfLinearEquiv` has the original linear equivalence
underneath.

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The inverse morphism of `isoOfLinearEquiv` has the inverse linear equivalence
underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    ((isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).inv).toLinearMap =
      e.symm.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply
decls.doc: The forward morphism of `isoOfLinearEquiv` applies as the original linear equivalence.

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse morphism of `isoOfLinearEquiv` applies as the inverse linear equivalence.

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_isoOfLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
Converting `isoOfLinearEquiv` back to a linear equivalence recovers the original linear
equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_isoOfLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h) =
      e

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_isoToLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
Rebuilding a comodule isomorphism from its induced linear equivalence recovers the original
isomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_isoToLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i)
      (by simp [i.hom.map_coact]) = i

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofreeCoact
decls.doc:
The coaction of the cofree right `C`-comodule on `M ⊗[R] C`, namely `id ⊗ Δ` followed by
reassociation: `m ⊗ c ↦ ∑ (m ⊗ c₁) ⊗ c₂`. This is an implementation detail of `Comodule.cofree`;
the public characterizations of the coaction are `Comodule.cofree_coact` and
`Comodule.cofree_coact_tmul`.
decls.statement: def cofreeCoact : M ⊗[R] C →ₗ[R] (M ⊗[R] C) ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofreeCoact_tmul
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeCoact_tmul (m : M) (c : C) :
    cofreeCoact R C M (m ⊗ₜ c) = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (m ⊗ₜ Coalgebra.comul c)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.counit_lTensor_comp_assoc_symm
decls.doc: Pushing the counit through the inverse associator (an instance of naturality).
decls.statement:
theorem counit_lTensor_comp_assoc_symm :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M ⊗[R] C) ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm.toLinearMap
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C R).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor M ((Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.comul_lTensor_comp_assoc_symm
decls.doc: Pushing the comultiplication through the inverse associator (an instance of naturality).
decls.statement:
theorem comul_lTensor_comp_assoc_symm :
    Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M ⊗[R] C) ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm.toLinearMap
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C (C ⊗[R] C)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor M ((Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.assoc_comp_cofreeCoact_rTensor_comp_cofreeCoact
decls.doc:
The double cofree coaction reorganized, with the coalgebra's own double comultiplication
isolated on the right factor. This is pure associator bookkeeping (it does not use
coassociativity), and feeds the coassociativity proof of the cofree coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem assoc_comp_cofreeCoact_rTensor_comp_cofreeCoact :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⊗[R] C) C C ∘ₗ (cofreeCoact R C M).rTensor C ∘ₗ cofreeCoact R C M
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C (C ⊗[R] C)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor M (TensorProduct.assoc R C C C ∘ₗ
            Coalgebra.comul.rTensor C ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofree
decls.doc:
The cofree (coinduced) right `C`-comodule structure on `M ⊗[R] C`, with coaction
`m ⊗ c ↦ ∑ (m ⊗ c₁) ⊗ c₂`.

This is not registered as a global instance: an `R`-module can carry many coactions, and the
cofree one should be selected explicitly with `Comodule.cofree`.
decls.statement: def cofree : Comodule R C (M ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofree_coact
decls.doc: The coaction of the cofree comodule is `id ⊗ Δ` followed by reassociation.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofree_coact_eq_cofreeCoact
decls.doc: The coaction of the cofree comodule unfolds to its implementation `cofreeCoact`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact_eq_cofreeCoact :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C) = cofreeCoact R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofree_coact_tmul
decls.doc: The coaction of the cofree comodule on a simple tensor: `m ⊗ c ↦ ∑ (m ⊗ c₁) ⊗ c₂`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact_tmul (m : M) (c : C) :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C) (m ⊗ₜ c)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (m ⊗ₜ Coalgebra.comul c)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap
decls.doc:
Functoriality of the cofree comodule in the coefficient module: an `R`-linear map
`f : M → N` induces the comodule morphism `f ⊗ id : M ⊗[R] C → N ⊗[R] C`.
decls.statement:
def cofreeMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Hom R C (M ⊗[R] C) (N ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `cofreeMap f` is `f ⊗ id`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_toLinearMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (cofreeMap (C := C) f).toLinearMap = f.rTensor C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap_apply
decls.doc: `cofreeMap f` acts as `f ⊗ id`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M ⊗[R] C) :
    cofreeMap (C := C) f x = f.rTensor C x

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap_id
decls.doc: The cofree functor preserves identities.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_id :
    cofreeMap (C := C) (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M) = Comodule.Hom.id R C (M ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap_comp
decls.doc: The cofree functor preserves composition.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_comp (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    cofreeMap (C := C) (g.comp f) = comp (cofreeMap (C := C) g) (cofreeMap (C := C) f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeUnit
decls.doc:
The coaction of a comodule `P`, viewed as a comodule morphism `P → P ⊗[R] C` into its cofree
comodule. This is the unit of the cofree adjunction.
decls.statement:
def cofreeUnit [Comodule R C P] :
    Hom R C P (P ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeUnit_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `cofreeUnit P` is the coaction of `P`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeUnit_toLinearMap [Comodule R C P] :
    (cofreeUnit (R := R) (C := C) P).toLinearMap = coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeUnit_apply
decls.doc: `cofreeUnit P` acts as the coaction of `P`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeUnit_apply [Comodule R C P] (p : P) :
    cofreeUnit (R := R) (C := C) P p = coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) p

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeLift
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism `P → M ⊗[R] C` lifting an `R`-linear map `g : P → M`, namely
`(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
decls.statement:
def cofreeLift [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    Hom R C P (M ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeLift_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `cofreeLift g` is `(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeLift_toLinearMap [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    (cofreeLift (C := C) g).toLinearMap = g.rTensor C ∘ₗ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeLift_apply
decls.doc: `cofreeLift g` acts as `(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeLift_apply [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) (p : P) :
    cofreeLift (C := C) g p = g.rTensor C (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.counit_lTensor_rTensor
decls.doc: Pushing the counit past `g ⊗ id`.
decls.statement:
theorem counit_lTensor_rTensor (g : P →ₗ[R] M) (z : P ⊗[R] C) :
    (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor M (g.rTensor C z)
      = g.rTensor R ((Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor P z)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.counit_rTensor_assoc_symm
decls.doc: Pushing the counit through the inverse associator, element form.
decls.statement:
theorem counit_rTensor_assoc_symm (m : M) (y : C ⊗[R] C) :
    ((Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor M).rTensor C
        ((TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (m ⊗ₜ y))
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M R C).symm
          (m ⊗ₜ (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).rTensor C y)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofree_retract
decls.doc:
The cofree coaction is split by `(ε ∘ -) ∘ counit`: applying the counit to the right factor
and then the right unitor retracts the cofree coaction. This is the right-counit law of `C`
transported to `M ⊗[R] C`, and underlies the cofree adjunction.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_retract (z : M ⊗[R] C) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R M).toLinearMap.rTensor C
        (((Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor M).rTensor C (cofreeCoact R C M z)) = z

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv
decls.doc:
Comodule morphisms `P → M ⊗[R] C` into the cofree comodule on `M` are exactly `R`-linear
maps `P → M`: this is the universal property of the cofree comodule (the cofree functor is right
adjoint to the forgetful functor).
decls.statement:
def cofreeEquiv [Comodule R C P] :
    Hom R C P (M ⊗[R] C) ≃ (P →ₗ[R] M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The forward direction of the cofree adjunction sends a comodule morphism to the
`R`-linear map obtained by applying the counit to the `C` factor.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeEquiv_apply [Comodule R C P] :
    ∀ φ : Hom R C P (M ⊗[R] C),
      cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (P := P) φ
        = (TensorProduct.rid R M).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
            (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor M ∘ₗ φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse direction of the cofree adjunction is `cofreeLift`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeEquiv_symm_apply [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    (cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (P := P)).symm g = cofreeLift (C := C) g

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree
decls.doc:
The cofree right `C`-comodule on a module `M`, bundled as an object of `ComoduleCat`. Its
underlying module is `M ⊗[R] C` and its coaction is `m ⊗ c ↦ ∑ (m ⊗ c₁) ⊗ c₂`.
decls.statement:
abbrev cofree (M : Type w) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] :
    ComoduleCat.{u, v, max w v} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree_toSemimoduleCat
decls.doc: The underlying semimodule of the bundled cofree comodule is `M ⊗[R] C`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_toSemimoduleCat :
    (cofree R C M).toSemimoduleCat = SemimoduleCat.of R (M ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree_coact
decls.doc: The coaction on the bundled cofree comodule is `id ⊗ Δ` followed by reassociation.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree_coact_tmul
decls.doc:
The coaction on the bundled cofree comodule on a simple tensor is
`m ⊗ c ↦ ∑ (m ⊗ c₁) ⊗ c₂`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact_tmul (m : M) (c : C) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictCoact
decls.doc:
The coaction obtained from a right `C`-comodule by corestricting along a coalgebra
morphism `f : C →ₗc[R] D`.
decls.statement: def corestrictCoact (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : M →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] D

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.assoc_rTensor_corestrictCoact
decls.statement:
theorem assoc_rTensor_corestrictCoact (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R M D D
        ((corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f).rTensor D
          (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap t)) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap)
        (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
          ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.comul_lTensor_corestrict_map
decls.statement:
theorem comul_lTensor_corestrict_map (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap t) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap)
        (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.counit_lTensor_corestrict_map
decls.statement:
theorem counit_lTensor_corestrict_map (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor M (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap t) =
      Coalgebra.counit.lTensor M t

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Corestrict
decls.doc:
Corestrict a right comodule along a coalgebra morphism.

If `M` is a right `C`-comodule and `f : C →ₗc[R] D`, the new right `D`-coaction is
`(id ⊗ f) ∘ ρ`.
decls.statement: def Corestrict (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrict_coact
decls.doc: The corestricted coaction is `(id ⊗ f) ∘ ρ`.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_coact (f : C →ₗc[R] D) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictCoact_apply
decls.doc: The corestricted coaction evaluates as `(id ⊗ f) (ρ m)`.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictCoact_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (m : M) :
    corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f m =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrict_coact_apply
decls.doc: The coaction of `Corestrict f` evaluates as `(id ⊗ f) (ρ m)`.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_coact_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictCoact_id
decls.doc: Corestricting along the identity coalgebra morphism leaves the coaction unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictCoact_id :
    corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := C) (M := M) (CoalgHom.id R C) =
      coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictCoact_comp
decls.doc: Corestricted coactions compose in the coalgebra morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictCoact_comp (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E) :
    corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (g.comp f) =
      letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom
decls.doc:
A morphism of `C`-comodules is also a morphism after corestricting both comodules along
the same coalgebra morphism.
decls.statement:
def corestrictHom (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : Hom R C M N) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc: Corestricting a comodule morphism does not change its underlying linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictHom_toLinearMap (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : Hom R C M N) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_apply
decls.doc: Corestricting a comodule morphism does not change its underlying function.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictHom_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_comp_coalg_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
Corestriction of morphisms is unchanged on underlying linear maps under composition of
coalgebra morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictHom_comp_coalg_toLinearMap (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E)
    (h : Hom R C M N) :
    (letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (g.comp f)
     letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := N) (g.comp f)
     (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) (g.comp f) h).toLinearMap) =
      (letI : Comodule R D M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
       letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
       letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) g
       letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := N) g
       (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) g
          (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := N) f h)).toLinearMap)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_comp_coalg_apply
decls.doc:
Corestriction of morphisms is unchanged on elements under composition of coalgebra
morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictHom_comp_coalg_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E) (h : Hom R C M N)
    (m : M) :
    (letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (g.comp f)
     letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := N) (g.comp f)
     corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) (g.comp f) h m) =
      (letI : Comodule R D M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
       letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
       letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) g
       letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := N) g
       corestrictHom (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) g
          (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := N) f h) m)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_id
decls.doc: Corestriction sends identity morphisms to identity morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictHom_id (f : C →ₗc[R] D) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_comp
decls.doc: Corestriction preserves composition of comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrictHom_comp {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : Hom R C M N) (h : Hom R C N P) :
    letI : Comodule R D M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.corestrict
decls.doc: Corestriction of bundled right comodules along a coalgebra morphism.
decls.statement: def corestrict (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : ComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C ⥤ ComoduleCat.{u, w, x} R D

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.corestrict_obj
decls.doc: The corestriction functor leaves the underlying type of an object unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_obj (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    (corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M =
      (letI : Comodule R D M :=
        Comodule.Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
       of R D M)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.corestrict_map_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The corestriction functor leaves the underlying linear map of a morphism unchanged.

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.corestrict_map_apply
decls.doc: The corestriction functor leaves the underlying function of a morphism unchanged.

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.corestrict_map_comp_coalg_toLinearMap
decls.doc: Corestriction functors compose in the coalgebra morphism on underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_map_comp_coalg_toLinearMap (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E)
    {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C} (h : M ⟶ N) :
    ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (g.comp f)).map h).toLinearMap =
      ((corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) g).map
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map h)).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.corestrict_map_comp_coalg_apply
decls.doc: Corestriction functors compose in the coalgebra morphism on elements.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_map_comp_coalg_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E)
    {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C} (h : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (g.comp f)).map h m =
      (corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) g).map
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map h) m

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isFG
decls.doc: Finite-generation as an object property on the category of right comodules.
decls.statement: def isFG : ObjectProperty (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isFG_iff
decls.doc:
The finitely generated comodule property is exactly finite generation of the underlying
module.
decls.statement:
theorem isFG_iff (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    isFG (R := R) (C := C) M ↔ Module.Finite R M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.finite_zero
decls.doc: The zero comodule is finitely generated.
decls.statement: theorem finite_zero : Module.Finite R (zero R C : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isFG_containsZero
decls.doc: The finite-generation property contains the zero comodule.
decls.statement: instance isFG_containsZero : (isFG (R := R) (C := C)).ContainsZero

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat
decls.doc:
The category of finitely generated right comodules over a fixed coalgebra.

For a field base, this is the category of finite-dimensional right comodules.
decls.statement: abbrev FGComoduleCat

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.carrier
decls.doc: The underlying type of a finitely generated comodule.
decls.statement: def carrier (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : Type w

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instCoeSortType
decls.statement: instance : CoeSort (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (Type w)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instAddCommMonoidCarrier
decls.statement: instance (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : AddCommMonoid M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instModuleCarrier
decls.statement: instance (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : Module R M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instComoduleCarrier
decls.statement: instance (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instFiniteCarrier
decls.doc: The underlying module of a finitely generated comodule is finitely generated.
decls.statement: instance (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : Module.Finite R M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.incl
decls.doc: The inclusion from finitely generated comodules to all comodules.
decls.statement: abbrev incl : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C ⥤ ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasForgetToSemimoduleCat
decls.doc: Forget a finitely generated comodule to its underlying semimodule.
decls.statement:
instance hasForgetToSemimoduleCat :
    HasForget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.forget₂_semimoduleCat_obj
decls.doc:
Forgetting a finitely generated comodule to semimodules agrees with forgetting its ambient
comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_obj (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).obj M =
      (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).obj M.obj

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.forget₂_semimoduleCat_map
decls.doc:
Forgetting a finitely generated comodule morphism to semimodules agrees with forgetting its
ambient comodule morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_map {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).map f =
      (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).map f.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.of
decls.doc: Lift an unbundled finitely generated right comodule to `FGComoduleCat`.
decls.statement:
abbrev of (M : Type w) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.of_obj
decls.doc: The object of `ComoduleCat` underlying `FGComoduleCat.of` is `ComoduleCat.of`.
decls.statement:
theorem of_obj (M : Type w) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] :
    (of (R := R) (C := C) M).obj = ComoduleCat.of R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.of_coact
decls.doc: The coaction on `FGComoduleCat.of` is the original unbundled coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem of_coact {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := of (R := R) (C := C) M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.ofHom
decls.doc:
Typecheck an unbundled comodule morphism between finitely generated comodules as a
categorical morphism in `FGComoduleCat`.
decls.statement:
abbrev ofHom {M N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [Module.Finite R N] (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    of (R := R) (C := C) M ⟶ of (R := R) (C := C) N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.ofHom_hom
decls.doc:
Turning an unbundled comodule morphism into an `FGComoduleCat` morphism and projecting to
the ambient comodule category recovers the original bundled morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem ofHom_hom {M N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [Module.Finite R N] (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    (ofHom (R := R) (C := C) f).hom = ComoduleCat.ofHom (R := R) (C := C) f

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.ofHom_id
decls.doc:
The categorical identity on a finitely generated bundled comodule is the bundled form of
the identity comodule morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem ofHom_id {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] :
    ofHom (R := R) (C := C) (Comodule.Hom.id R C M) = 𝟙 (of (R := R) (C := C) M)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.ofHom_comp
decls.doc:
Categorical composition of finitely generated bundled comodule morphisms is the bundled
form of composition of comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem ofHom_comp {M N P : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [Module.Finite R N] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    [Module.Finite R P] (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (g : Comodule.Hom R C N P) :
    ofHom (R := R) (C := C) (Comodule.Hom.comp g f) =
      ofHom (R := R) (C := C) f ≫ ofHom (R := R) (C := C) g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.ofHom_apply
decls.doc: The `FGComoduleCat` morphism induced by an unbundled morphism applies as that morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem ofHom_apply {M N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [Module.Finite R N] (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    ofHom (R := R) (C := C) f m = f m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
Build an isomorphism of finitely generated comodules from a linear equivalence of the
underlying modules whose *forward* map respects the coactions.

Compatibility of the inverse is automatic, and is supplied by
`TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv`; being a full subcategory, `FGComoduleCat` then inherits
the isomorphism from `ComoduleCat`.
decls.statement:
def isoOfLinearEquiv {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (h : TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap) :
    M ≅ N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The forward morphism of `FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv` has the original linear equivalence
underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (h : TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv e h).hom.hom.toLinearMap = e.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The inverse morphism of `FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv` has the inverse linear equivalence
underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (h : TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv e h).inv.hom.toLinearMap = e.symm.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply
decls.doc: The forward map of `FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv` is the given linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (h : TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap) (m : M) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv e h).hom m = e m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse map of `FGComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv` is the inverse linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (h : TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap) (n : N) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv e h).inv n = e.symm n

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.zero
decls.doc: The bundled finitely generated zero right comodule.
decls.statement: def zero : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.zero_obj
decls.doc: The ambient comodule underlying the finitely generated zero comodule is the zero comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem zero_obj :
    (zero R C : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C).obj = ComoduleCat.zero R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isZero_zero
decls.doc: The named finitely generated zero comodule is a zero object.
decls.statement: theorem isZero_zero : IsZero (zero R C : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.zero_hom_eq_zero
decls.doc: Any morphism from the named finitely generated zero comodule is zero.
decls.statement: theorem zero_hom_eq_zero (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (f : zero R C ⟶ M) : f = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hom_zero_eq_zero
decls.doc: Any morphism to the named finitely generated zero comodule is zero.
decls.statement: theorem hom_zero_eq_zero (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (f : M ⟶ zero R C) : f = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isZero_zero_to
decls.doc:
The canonical morphism out of the named finitely generated zero comodule is the zero
morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isZero_zero_to (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (isZero_zero (R := R) (C := C)).to_ M = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.isZero_zero_from
decls.doc: The canonical morphism into the named finitely generated zero comodule is the zero morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isZero_zero_from (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (isZero_zero (R := R) (C := C)).from_ M = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.zero_hom_ext
decls.doc: Morphisms from the named finitely generated zero comodule are unique.
decls.statement: theorem zero_hom_ext {M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : zero R C ⟶ M) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hom_zero_ext
decls.doc: Morphisms to the named finitely generated zero comodule are unique.
decls.statement: theorem hom_zero_ext {M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ zero R C) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instAddCommGroupCarrier
decls.statement: instance (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : AddCommGroup M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofree
decls.doc:
The cofree right `C`-comodule with finitely generated tensor-product carrier, bundled as an
object of `FGComoduleCat`.

The underlying module is `M ⊗[R] C`, with coaction `id ⊗ Δ` followed by reassociation.
decls.statement:
abbrev cofree (M : Type w) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R (M ⊗[R] C)] : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, max w v} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofree_obj
decls.doc:
Forgetting the finitely generated cofree comodule to all comodules gives the ambient
cofree comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_obj :
    (cofree (R := R) (C := C) M).obj = ComoduleCat.cofree R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofree_coe
decls.doc: The underlying type of the finitely generated cofree comodule is `M ⊗[R] C`.
decls.statement: theorem cofree_coe : (cofree (R := R) (C := C) M : Type (max w v)) = M ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofree_coact
decls.doc:
The coaction on the finitely generated cofree comodule is `id ⊗ Δ` followed by
reassociation.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := cofree (R := R) (C := C) M)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofree_coact_tmul
decls.doc:
The coaction on the finitely generated cofree comodule sends a simple tensor
`m ⊗ c` to `∑ (m ⊗ c₁) ⊗ c₂`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofree_coact_tmul (m : M) (c : C) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := cofree (R := R) (C := C) M) (m ⊗ₜ[R] c)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (m ⊗ₜ Coalgebra.comul c)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.incl_cofree
decls.doc:
The inclusion of finitely generated comodules sends `FGComoduleCat.cofree` to
`ComoduleCat.cofree`.
decls.statement:
theorem incl_cofree :
    (incl (R := R) (C := C)).obj (cofree (R := R) (C := C) M) =
      ComoduleCat.cofree R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.forget₂_semimoduleCat_cofree_obj
decls.doc: The finite cofree comodule forgets to the tensor product module `M ⊗[R] C`.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_cofree_obj :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, max w v} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{max w v} R)).obj
        (cofree (R := R) (C := C) M) =
      SemimoduleCat.of R (M ⊗[R] C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeMap
decls.doc:
Functoriality of finite cofree comodules in the coefficient module.

An `R`-linear map `f : M → N` induces the comodule morphism `f ⊗ id`.
decls.statement:
abbrev cofreeMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    cofree (R := R) (C := C) M ⟶ cofree (R := R) (C := C) N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeMap_apply
decls.doc: `cofreeMap f` acts as `f ⊗ id`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M ⊗[R] C) :
    cofreeMap (R := R) (C := C) f x = f.rTensor C x

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeMap_tmul
decls.doc: On simple tensors, `cofreeMap f` applies `f` to the coefficient factor.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_tmul (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) (c : C) :
    cofreeMap (R := R) (C := C) f (m ⊗ₜ[R] c) = f m ⊗ₜ[R] c

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeMap_id
decls.doc: The finite cofree construction sends the identity linear map to the identity morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_id :
    cofreeMap (R := R) (C := C) (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M) =
      𝟙 (cofree (R := R) (C := C) M)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeMap_comp
decls.doc: The finite cofree construction preserves composition of coefficient-module maps.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeMap_comp {P : Type w} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    [Module.Finite R (P ⊗[R] C)] (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    cofreeMap (R := R) (C := C) (g.comp f) =
      cofreeMap (R := R) (C := C) f ≫ cofreeMap (R := R) (C := C) g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeLift
decls.doc:
The finite-category cofree lift of an `R`-linear map from a finite comodule to the
coefficient module.
decls.statement:
abbrev cofreeLift (P : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, max w v} R C) (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    P ⟶ cofree (R := R) (C := C) M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeLift_apply
decls.doc: `cofreeLift g` acts as `(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeLift_apply (g : P →ₗ[R] M) (p : P) :
    cofreeLift (R := R) (C := C) P g p =
      g.rTensor C (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) p)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeEquiv
decls.doc: The finite-category cofree universal property.
decls.statement:
def cofreeEquiv (P : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, max w v} R C) :
    (P ⟶ cofree (R := R) (C := C) M) ≃ (P →ₗ[R] M)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The forward direction of the finite cofree adjunction sends a comodule morphism to the
`R`-linear map obtained by applying the counit to the `C` factor.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeEquiv_apply (φ : P ⟶ cofree (R := R) (C := C) M) :
    cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) P φ =
      Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (P := P) φ.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.cofreeEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse direction of the finite cofree adjunction is `cofreeLift`.
decls.statement:
theorem cofreeEquiv_symm_apply (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    (cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) P).symm g =
      cofreeLift (R := R) (C := C) P g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict
decls.doc:
Corestriction of finitely generated right comodules along a coalgebra morphism.

The underlying module is unchanged, so the finite-generation proof is inherited from the
source object.
decls.statement: def corestrict (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C ⥤ FGComoduleCat.{u, w, x} R D

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_obj_obj
decls.doc: Corestriction on finitely generated comodules is corestriction on the ambient comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_obj_obj (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M).obj =
      (ComoduleCat.corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M.obj

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_obj_coe
decls.doc: Corestriction leaves the underlying type of a finitely generated comodule unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_obj_coe (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M : Type x) = M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_obj_coact
decls.doc: The coaction after corestricting a finitely generated comodule is `(id ⊗ f) ∘ ρ`.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_obj_coact (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := D)
        (M := (corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M) =
      Comodule.corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_obj_coact_apply
decls.doc:
The coaction after corestricting a finitely generated comodule evaluates as
`(id ⊗ f) (ρ m)`.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_obj_coact_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C)
    (m : M) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := D)
        (M := (corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M) m =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap
        (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_map_hom
decls.doc:
Corestriction on finitely generated morphisms is corestriction on ambient comodule
morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_map_hom (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C}
    (g : M ⟶ N) :
    ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map g).hom =
      (ComoduleCat.corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map g.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_map_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
Corestriction leaves the underlying linear map of a finitely generated comodule morphism
unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_map_toLinearMap (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C}
    (g : M ⟶ N) :
    (((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map g).hom).toLinearMap =
      g.hom.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_map_apply
decls.doc:
Corestriction leaves the underlying function of a finitely generated comodule morphism
unchanged.

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.incl_corestrict_obj
decls.doc:
Corestriction of finitely generated comodules commutes with the inclusion into all
comodules on objects.
decls.statement:
theorem incl_corestrict_obj (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    (incl (R := R) (C := D)).obj
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M) =
      (ComoduleCat.corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj
        ((incl (R := R) (C := C)).obj M)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.incl_corestrict_map
decls.doc:
Corestriction of finitely generated comodules commutes with the inclusion into all
comodules on morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem incl_corestrict_map (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C}
    (g : M ⟶ N) :
    (incl (R := R) (C := D)).map
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map g) =
      (ComoduleCat.corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map
        ((incl (R := R) (C := C)).map g)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.forget₂_semimoduleCat_corestrict_obj
decls.doc: Corestriction leaves the underlying semimodule object unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_corestrict_obj (f : C →ₗc[R] D)
    (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, w, x} R D) (SemimoduleCat.{x} R)).obj
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).obj M) =
      (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{x} R)).obj M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.forget₂_semimoduleCat_corestrict_map
decls.doc: Corestriction leaves the underlying semimodule morphism unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_corestrict_map (f : C →ₗc[R] D)
    {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C} (g : M ⟶ N) :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, w, x} R D) (SemimoduleCat.{x} R)).map
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map g) =
      (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{x} R)).map g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_obj_coact_id
decls.doc:
Corestricting finitely generated comodules along the identity coalgebra morphism leaves the
coaction unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_obj_coact_id (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C)
        (M := (corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := C) (CoalgHom.id R C)).obj M) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_map_comp_coalg_toLinearMap
decls.doc: Corestriction functors compose in the coalgebra morphism on underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_map_comp_coalg_toLinearMap (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E)
    {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C} (h : M ⟶ N) :
    (((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (g.comp f)).map h).hom).toLinearMap =
      (((corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) g).map
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map h)).hom).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.corestrict_map_comp_coalg_apply
decls.doc: Corestriction functors compose in the coalgebra morphism on elements.
decls.statement:
theorem corestrict_map_comp_coalg_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E)
    {M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C} (h : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (g.comp f)).map h m =
      (corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) g).map
        ((corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) f).map h) m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorUnit
decls.doc:
The tensor unit in finitely generated right comodules: the base semiring with the trivial
coaction `r ↦ r ⊗ 1`.
decls.statement: abbrev tensorUnit : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorAssociator
decls.doc:
The associator on finitely generated comodules: the associativity
equivalence of tensor products, which intertwines the diagonal coactions because the coefficient
multiplication is associative. The user-facing form is `α_`, characterized by
`associator_hom_apply` below.
decls.statement:
def tensorAssociator (M N P : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C) :
    tensor R C (tensor R C M N) P ≅ tensor R C M (tensor R C N P)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorLeftUnitor
decls.doc:
The left unitor on finitely generated comodules: the equivalence
`R ⊗ M ≃ M`, which intertwines the diagonal coactions because `1` is a left unit for the
coefficient multiplication. The user-facing form is `λ_`, characterized by
`leftUnitor_hom_apply` below.
decls.statement:
def tensorLeftUnitor (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C) :
    tensor R C (tensorUnit R C) M ≅ M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorRightUnitor
decls.doc:
The right unitor on finitely generated comodules: the equivalence
`M ⊗ R ≃ M`, which intertwines the diagonal coactions because `1` is a right unit for the
coefficient multiplication. The user-facing form is `ρ_`, characterized by
`rightUnitor_hom_apply` below.
decls.statement:
def tensorRightUnitor (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C) :
    tensor R C M (tensorUnit R C) ≅ M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instMonoidalCategoryStruct
decls.doc:
The tensor product, trivial unit, associator, and unitors on finitely generated right
comodules over a bialgebra.
decls.statement:
instance instMonoidalCategoryStruct :
    MonoidalCategoryStruct (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instMonoidalCategory
decls.doc:
Finitely generated right comodules over a bialgebra form a monoidal category under the
diagonal tensor product. Over a field, these are precisely finite-dimensional comodules.
decls.statement:
instance instMonoidalCategory :
    MonoidalCategory (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorAssociator_eq
decls.doc:
The monoidal associator is the named one. Rewriting in this direction sends the
implementation name to the notation, where `associator_hom_apply` and `associator_inv_apply`
take over.
decls.statement: theorem tensorAssociator_eq : tensorAssociator R C M N P = α_ M N P

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorLeftUnitor_eq
decls.doc: The monoidal left unitor is the named one; see `tensorAssociator_eq`.
decls.statement: theorem tensorLeftUnitor_eq : tensorLeftUnitor R C M = λ_ M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorRightUnitor_eq
decls.doc: The monoidal right unitor is the named one; see `tensorAssociator_eq`.
decls.statement: theorem tensorRightUnitor_eq : tensorRightUnitor R C M = ρ_ M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The monoidal tensor product of two finite-comodule morphisms is their ordinary tensor
product on underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorHom_toLinearMap (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (f ⊗ₘ g).hom.toLinearMap =
      TensorProduct.map f.hom.toLinearMap g.hom.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorHom_tmul
decls.doc:
The monoidal tensor product of finite-comodule morphisms acts componentwise on pure
tensors.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorHom_tmul (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    (f ⊗ₘ g) (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = f m ⊗ₜ[R] g n

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.leftUnitor_hom_apply
decls.doc: The left unitor acts by scalar multiplication.
decls.statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom_apply (r : R) (m : M) :
    (λ_ M).hom (r ⊗ₜ[R] m) = r • m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.leftUnitor_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse left unitor sends `m` to `1 ⊗ m`.
decls.statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_apply (m : M) :
    (λ_ M).inv m = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.rightUnitor_hom_apply
decls.doc: The right unitor acts by scalar multiplication.
decls.statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_apply (m : M) (r : R) :
    (ρ_ M).hom (m ⊗ₜ[R] r) = r • m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.rightUnitor_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse right unitor sends `m` to `m ⊗ 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_apply (m : M) :
    (ρ_ M).inv m = m ⊗ₜ[R] 1

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.associator_hom_apply
decls.doc: The associator sends `(m ⊗ n) ⊗ p` to `m ⊗ (n ⊗ p)`.
decls.statement:
theorem associator_hom_apply (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    (α_ M N P).hom (m ⊗ₜ[R] n ⊗ₜ[R] p) = m ⊗ₜ[R] (n ⊗ₜ[R] p)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.associator_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse associator sends `m ⊗ (n ⊗ p)` to `(m ⊗ n) ⊗ p`.
decls.statement:
theorem associator_inv_apply (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    (α_ M N P).inv (m ⊗ₜ[R] (n ⊗ₜ[R] p)) = m ⊗ₜ[R] n ⊗ₜ[R] p

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hom_zero
decls.doc: The ambient comodule morphism underlying the zero morphism is the zero morphism.
decls.statement: theorem hom_zero : (0 : M ⟶ N).hom = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hom_add
decls.doc: The ambient comodule morphism underlying a sum is the sum of the underlying morphisms.
decls.statement: theorem hom_add (f g : M ⟶ N) : (f + g).hom = f.hom + g.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hom_neg
decls.doc:
The ambient comodule morphism underlying a negation is the negation of the underlying
morphism.
decls.statement: theorem hom_neg (f : M ⟶ N) : (-f).hom = -f.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hom_sub
decls.doc:
The ambient comodule morphism underlying a difference is the difference of the underlying
morphisms.
decls.statement: theorem hom_sub (f g : M ⟶ N) : (f - g).hom = f.hom - g.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.zero_apply
decls.doc: The zero morphism acts as the zero function.
decls.statement: theorem zero_apply (m : M) : (0 : M ⟶ N) m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.add_apply
decls.doc: Addition of morphisms acts by pointwise addition.
decls.statement: theorem add_apply (f g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) : (f + g) m = f m + g m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.neg_apply
decls.doc: Negation of morphisms acts by pointwise negation.
decls.statement: theorem neg_apply (f : M ⟶ N) (m : M) : (-f) m = -f m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.sub_apply
decls.doc: Subtraction of morphisms acts by pointwise subtraction.
decls.statement: theorem sub_apply (f g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) : (f - g) m = f m - g m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prod
decls.doc:
The product of two finitely generated comodules, carried by the product of the
underlying modules.
decls.statement: abbrev prod (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodFst
decls.statement: abbrev prodFst (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : prod R C M N ⟶ M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodSnd
decls.statement: abbrev prodSnd (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : prod R C M N ⟶ N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodLift
decls.statement:
abbrev prodLift {P M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N) :
    P ⟶ prod R C M N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodFst_hom
decls.statement:
theorem prodFst_hom (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (prodFst M N).hom = ComoduleCat.prodFst M.obj N.obj

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodSnd_hom
decls.statement:
theorem prodSnd_hom (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (prodSnd M N).hom = ComoduleCat.prodSnd M.obj N.obj

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodLift_fst
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_fst {P M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N) :
    prodLift f g ≫ prodFst M N = f

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodLift_snd
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_snd {P M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N) :
    prodLift f g ≫ prodSnd M N = g

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prod_hom_ext
TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodBinaryFan
decls.statement: def prodBinaryFan (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : Limits.BinaryFan M N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.prodBinaryFanIsLimit
decls.statement:
def prodBinaryFanIsLimit (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    Limits.IsLimit (prodBinaryFan M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasBinaryProduct
decls.doc:
The concrete product supplies the categorical binary product of finitely generated
comodules.
decls.statement:
instance hasBinaryProduct (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    Limits.HasBinaryProduct M N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasBinaryProducts
decls.doc: Finitely generated comodules have categorical binary products.
decls.statement: instance hasBinaryProducts : Limits.HasBinaryProducts (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasFiniteProducts
decls.doc: Finitely generated comodules have finite products.
decls.statement: instance hasFiniteProducts : Limits.HasFiniteProducts (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasBinaryBiproduct
decls.doc: The preadditive binary product is also a binary biproduct.
decls.statement:
instance hasBinaryBiproduct (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    Limits.HasBinaryBiproduct M N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasBinaryBiproducts
decls.doc: Finitely generated comodules over a commutative ring have binary biproducts.
decls.statement: instance hasBinaryBiproducts : Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.hasFiniteBiproducts
decls.doc: Finitely generated comodules over a commutative ring have finite biproducts.
decls.statement: instance hasFiniteBiproducts : Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorBraiding
decls.doc:
The braiding on finite comodules: the ordinary tensor-product swap, which intertwines
the diagonal coactions because the coefficient bialgebra is commutative.
decls.statement:
def tensorBraiding (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C) :
    tensor R C M N ≅ tensor R C N M

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instBraidedCategory
decls.doc: The tensor-product swap makes finite comodules over a commutative bialgebra braided.
decls.statement:
instance instBraidedCategory :
    BraidedCategory (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instForgetBraided
decls.doc: The forgetful functor from finite comodules to semimodules preserves the braiding.
decls.statement:
instance instForgetBraided :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{u} R)).Braided

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.instSymmetricCategory
decls.doc: Finite comodules over a commutative bialgebra form a symmetric monoidal category.
decls.statement:
instance instSymmetricCategory :
    SymmetricCategory (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorBraiding_eq
decls.doc: The monoidal braiding is the named tensor-product swap.
decls.statement: theorem tensorBraiding_eq : tensorBraiding R C M N = β_ M N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.braiding_hom_apply
decls.doc: The braiding sends `m ⊗ n` to `n ⊗ m`.
decls.statement:
theorem braiding_hom_apply (m : M) (n : N) :
    (β_ M N).hom (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = n ⊗ₜ[R] m

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.braiding_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse braiding sends `n ⊗ m` back to `m ⊗ n`.
decls.statement:
theorem braiding_inv_apply (n : N) (m : M) :
    (β_ M N).inv (n ⊗ₜ[R] m) = m ⊗ₜ[R] n

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensor
decls.doc:
The tensor product of two finitely generated right comodules over a bialgebra.

Its carrier is the tensor product of the underlying modules, equipped with the diagonal
coaction from `Comodule.tensor`.
decls.statement:
abbrev tensor (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensor_obj
decls.doc:
The ambient comodule underlying the finite tensor product is the diagonal tensor-product
comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_obj (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (tensor R C M N).obj = ComoduleCat.of R C (M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensor_coe
decls.doc:
The underlying type of the finite tensor product is the tensor product of the underlying
modules.
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_coe (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (tensor R C M N : Type w) = M ⊗[R] N

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensor_coact
decls.doc: The coaction on the finite tensor product is the diagonal tensor coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_coact (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := tensor R C M N) =
      Comodule.tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.incl_tensor
decls.doc:
The inclusion into all comodules sends the finite tensor product to the ambient
tensor-product comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem incl_tensor (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (incl (R := R) (C := C)).obj (tensor R C M N) =
      ComoduleCat.of R C (M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.forget₂_semimoduleCat_tensor_obj
decls.doc:
Forgetting the finite tensor product to semimodules gives the ordinary tensor-product
module.
decls.statement:
theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_tensor_obj (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (forget₂ (FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).obj (tensor R C M N) =
      SemimoduleCat.of R (M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorMap
decls.doc: The tensor product of two morphisms of finitely generated comodules.
decls.statement:
abbrev tensorMap (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    tensor R C M N ⟶ tensor R C M' N'

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorMap_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The underlying linear map of `tensorMap f g` is the tensor product of the underlying
linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_toLinearMap (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (tensorMap f g).hom.toLinearMap =
      TensorProduct.map f.hom.toLinearMap g.hom.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorMap_apply
decls.doc:
The finite-comodule tensor map acts as the ordinary tensor product of its two underlying
linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_apply (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    tensorMap f g x = TensorProduct.map f.hom.toLinearMap g.hom.toLinearMap x

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorMap_tmul
decls.doc: On a simple tensor, `tensorMap f g` applies the two component morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_tmul (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorMap f g (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = f m ⊗ₜ[R] g n

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorMap_id
decls.doc: Tensoring two identity morphisms gives the identity of the finite tensor product.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_id (M N : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    tensorMap (𝟙 M) (𝟙 N) = 𝟙 (tensor R C M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorMap_comp
decls.doc: Tensor products of finite-comodule morphisms preserve composition.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_comp (f : M ⟶ M') (f' : M' ⟶ M'') (g : N ⟶ N') (g' : N' ⟶ N'') :
    tensorMap (f ≫ f') (g ≫ g') = tensorMap f g ≫ tensorMap f' g'

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorBifunctor
decls.doc:
Tensor product as a bifunctor on finitely generated right comodules.

It sends `(M, N)` to the finite diagonal comodule `M ⊗ N` and a pair of morphisms `(f, g)`
to `f ⊗ g`. This is the tensor bifunctor underlying the future monoidal structure on
`FGComoduleCat`.

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorBifunctor_obj
decls.doc: The object part of `tensorBifunctor` is the finite tensor product.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorBifunctor_obj (P : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C ×
    FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (tensorBifunctor R C).obj P = tensor R C P.1 P.2

decls.name: TauCeti.FGComoduleCat.tensorBifunctor_map
decls.doc:
The morphism part of `tensorBifunctor` is the tensor product of the two component
morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorBifunctor_map {P Q : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C ×
    FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (fg : P ⟶ Q) :
    (tensorBifunctor R C).map fg = tensorMap fg.1 fg.2

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.instZero
decls.doc: The zero morphism of right comodules.
decls.statement: instance instZero : Zero (Hom R C M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.instAdd
decls.doc: Addition of right-comodule morphisms, defined pointwise.
decls.statement: instance instAdd : Add (Hom R C M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.instSMul
decls.doc: Scalar multiplication of right-comodule morphisms, defined pointwise.
decls.statement: instance instSMul : SMul R (Hom R C M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The zero comodule morphism has the zero linear map underneath.
decls.statement: theorem zero_toLinearMap : (0 : Hom R C M N).toLinearMap = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_toLinearMap
decls.doc: Addition of comodule morphisms is addition of the underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem add_toLinearMap (f g : Hom R C M N) :
    (f + g).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap + g.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.smul_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
Scalar multiplication of comodule morphisms is scalar multiplication of the underlying
linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem smul_toLinearMap (r : R) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    (r • f).toLinearMap = r • f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_apply
decls.doc: The zero comodule morphism evaluates to zero.
decls.statement: theorem zero_apply (m : M) : (0 : Hom R C M N) m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_apply
decls.doc: Addition of comodule morphisms is pointwise addition.
decls.statement: theorem add_apply (f g : Hom R C M N) (m : M) : (f + g) m = f m + g m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.smul_apply
decls.doc: Scalar multiplication of comodule morphisms is pointwise scalar multiplication.
decls.statement: theorem smul_apply (r : R) (f : Hom R C M N) (m : M) : (r • f) m = r • f m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.instAddCommMonoid
decls.doc:
Comodule morphisms form an additive commutative monoid under pointwise zero and
addition, with the default natural-number scalar multiplication `nsmulRec`.
decls.statement: instance instAddCommMonoid : AddCommMonoid (Hom R C M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.toLinearMapAddMonoidHom
decls.doc:
The map sending a comodule morphism to its underlying linear map, bundled as an
additive monoid homomorphism.
decls.statement: def toLinearMapAddMonoidHom : Hom R C M N →+ M →ₗ[R] N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.instModule
decls.doc: Comodule morphisms form an `R`-module under pointwise scalar multiplication.
decls.statement: instance instModule : Module R (Hom R C M N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.nsmul_apply
decls.doc: Natural-number scalar multiplication of comodule morphisms is pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem nsmul_apply (n : ℕ) (f : Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    (n • f) m = n • f m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.nsmul_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
Natural-number scalar multiplication of comodule morphisms is natural-number scalar
multiplication of the underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem nsmul_toLinearMap (n : ℕ) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    (n • f).toLinearMap = n • f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.sum_apply
decls.doc: Finite sums of comodule morphisms are evaluated pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem sum_apply {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) m = ∑ i ∈ s, f i m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.sum_toLinearMap
decls.doc: Finite sums of comodule morphisms are finite sums of the underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem sum_toLinearMap {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Hom R C M N) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i).toLinearMap = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_comp
decls.doc: Composition of comodule morphisms is additive in the left argument.
decls.statement:
theorem add_comp (g h : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp (g + h) f = comp g f + comp h f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_add
decls.doc: Composition of comodule morphisms is additive in the right argument.
decls.statement:
theorem comp_add (g : Hom R C N P) (f h : Hom R C M N) :
    comp g (f + h) = comp g f + comp g h

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.smul_comp
decls.doc:
Composition of comodule morphisms is compatible with scalar multiplication in the left
argument.
decls.statement:
theorem smul_comp (r : R) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp (r • g) f = r • comp g f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_smul
decls.doc:
Composition of comodule morphisms is compatible with scalar multiplication in the right
argument.
decls.statement:
theorem comp_smul (r : R) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp g (r • f) = r • comp g f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_comp
decls.doc: Composing the zero morphism on the left gives the zero morphism.
decls.statement: theorem zero_comp (f : Hom R C M N) : comp (0 : Hom R C N P) f = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_zero
decls.doc: Composing the zero morphism on the right gives the zero morphism.
decls.statement: theorem comp_zero (g : Hom R C N P) : comp g (0 : Hom R C M N) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSet
decls.doc: The set of all matrix coefficients of a right comodule.
decls.statement: def matrixCoefficientSet : Set C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSet_def
decls.doc: The matrix coefficient set is the range of the uncurried matrix coefficient map.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_def :
    matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Set.range (Function.uncurry (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_mem_set
decls.doc: A matrix coefficient belongs to the set of all matrix coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_mem_set (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m ∈
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.mem_matrixCoefficientSet_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in the set of matrix coefficients is the existence of a functional and a
vector giving the element.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_matrixCoefficientSet_iff (c : C) :
    c ∈ matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ↔
      ∃ (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M), matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule
decls.doc: The `R`-submodule spanned by all matrix coefficients of a right comodule.
decls.statement: def matrixCoefficientSubmodule : Submodule R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_def
decls.doc: The matrix coefficient submodule is the span of the matrix coefficient set.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_def :
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Submodule.span R (matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_mem_submodule
decls.doc: A matrix coefficient belongs to the submodule spanned by all matrix coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_mem_submodule (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m ∈
      matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le
decls.doc: The coefficient submodule is the smallest submodule containing all matrix coefficients.

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le_iff
decls.doc:
The coefficient submodule is contained in a submodule iff that submodule contains each
matrix coefficient.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le_iff {P : Submodule R C} :
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ≤ P ↔
      ∀ (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M), matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m ∈ P

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_mem_set_of_map
decls.doc:
The matrix coefficient of the image of a vector under a comodule morphism is a matrix
coefficient of the source comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_mem_set_of_map (f : Hom R C M N) (φ : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (f m) ∈
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective
decls.doc:
If `f : M → N` is a surjective comodule morphism, every matrix coefficient of `N` is a
matrix coefficient of `M`.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective (f : Hom R C M N)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ⊆
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le_of_surjective
decls.doc:
A surjective comodule morphism makes the coefficient submodule of the target contained in
the coefficient submodule of the source.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le_of_surjective (f : Hom R C M N)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ≤
      matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSet_eq_of_inverse_hom
decls.doc: Inverse comodule morphisms identify the coefficient sets.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_eq_of_inverse_hom (f : Hom R C M N) (g : Hom R C N M)
    (hfg : ∀ n, f (g n) = n) (hgf : ∀ m, g (f m) = m) :
    matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_eq_of_inverse_hom
decls.doc: Inverse comodule morphisms identify the coefficient submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_eq_of_inverse_hom (f : Hom R C M N) (g : Hom R C N M)
    (hfg : ∀ n, f (g n) = n) (hgf : ∀ m, g (f m) = m) :
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra
decls.doc:
The `R`-subalgebra generated by all matrix coefficients of a right comodule.

For a Hopf algebra coordinate ring, the faithful-representation criterion will ask whether
this subalgebra is `⊤`.
decls.statement: def matrixCoefficientSubalgebra : Subalgebra R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_def
decls.doc: The matrix coefficient subalgebra is the algebra generated by the matrix coefficient set.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_def :
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Algebra.adjoin R (matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_mem_subalgebra
decls.doc: A matrix coefficient belongs to the algebra generated by all matrix coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_mem_subalgebra (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m ∈
      matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_le
decls.doc: The coefficient algebra is the smallest subalgebra containing all matrix coefficients.

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_le_iff
decls.doc:
The coefficient algebra is contained in a subalgebra iff that subalgebra contains each
matrix coefficient.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_le_iff {S : Subalgebra R C} :
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ≤ S ↔
      ∀ (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M), matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m ∈ S

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_eq_top_of_submodule_eq_top
decls.doc:
If the matrix coefficients linearly span the coalgebra, then they generate the ambient
algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_eq_top_of_submodule_eq_top
    (h : matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) = ⊤) :
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_le_of_surjective
decls.doc:
A surjective comodule morphism makes the coefficient algebra of the target contained in
the coefficient algebra of the source.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_le_of_surjective (f : Hom R C M N)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ≤
      matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_eq_of_inverse_hom
decls.doc: Inverse comodule morphisms identify the coefficient algebras.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_eq_of_inverse_hom (f : Hom R C M N) (g : Hom R C N M)
    (hfg : ∀ n, f (g n) = n) (hgf : ∀ m, g (f m) = m) :
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientLinear
decls.doc:
The linear map of matrix coefficients associated to a functional on a right comodule.

It sends `m : M` to `(φ ⊗ id) (ρ m)`, with the canonical identification `R ⊗ C ≃ C`.
decls.statement: def matrixCoefficientLinear (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) : M →ₗ[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient
decls.doc: The matrix coefficient attached to a functional and a vector in a right comodule.
decls.statement: def matrixCoefficient (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) : C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientLinear_apply
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientLinear_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ m = matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_def
decls.doc: Matrix coefficients are obtained by applying `φ ⊗ id` to the coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_def (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m =
      TensorProduct.lid R C
        (TensorProduct.map φ LinearMap.id (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact
decls.doc:
**Alias** of `TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_def`.

---

Matrix coefficients are obtained by applying `φ ⊗ id` to the coaction.
decls.title: Alias
decls.statement: alias matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_zero
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_zero (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ 0 = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_add
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_add (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m n : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (m + n) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ n

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_smul
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_smul (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (r • m) =
      r • matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientBilinear
decls.doc: Matrix coefficients as a linear map from the dual module to linear maps `M →ₗ[R] C`.
decls.statement: def matrixCoefficientBilinear : (M →ₗ[R] R) →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    matrixCoefficientBilinear (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) φ =
      matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply_apply
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficientBilinear (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) φ m =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_zero_functional
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_zero_functional (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (0 : M →ₗ[R] R) m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_add_functional
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_add_functional (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ + ψ) m =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) ψ m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_smul_functional
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_smul_functional (r : R) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (r • φ) m =
      r • matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_map
decls.doc:
Matrix coefficients are natural in comodule morphisms: pushing the vector forward is
the same as pulling the functional back.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_map (f : Hom R C M N) (φ : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (f m) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ.comp f.toLinearMap) m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_counit_self
decls.doc: For the regular comodule, the coefficient attached to the counit is the identity map.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_counit_self (c : C) :
