    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (M := C) (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)) c = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_groupLike
decls.doc:
Matrix coefficients of a group-like comodule are scalar multiples of the group-like
element.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_groupLike (g : GroupLike R C) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_trivial
decls.doc: Matrix coefficients of the trivial comodule are scalar multiples of `1`.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_trivial (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m = φ m • (1 : C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_prod
decls.doc:
Matrix coefficients of the product comodule split as the sum of the left and right
matrix coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_prod (φ : M × N →ₗ[R] R) (x : M × N) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ x =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ.comp (LinearMap.inl R M N)) x.1 +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ.comp (LinearMap.inr R M N)) x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_prod_inl
decls.doc:
Matrix coefficients of a left summand, viewed in the product comodule, are the original
left matrix coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_prod_inl (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ.comp (LinearMap.fst R M N))
        (LinearMap.inl R M N m) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_prod_inr
decls.doc:
Matrix coefficients of a right summand, viewed in the product comodule, are the original
right matrix coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_prod_inr (ψ : N →ₗ[R] R) (n : N) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (ψ.comp (LinearMap.snd R M N))
        (LinearMap.inr R M N n) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) ψ n

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_prod
decls.doc:
The coefficient submodule of the product comodule is the supremum of the coefficient
submodules of the two factors.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_prod :
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M × N) =
      matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ⊔
        matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_prod
decls.doc:
The coefficient subalgebra of the product comodule is the supremum of the coefficient
subalgebras of the two factors.
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_prod :
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M × N) =
      matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ⊔
        matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.mem_regular_matrixCoefficientSet
decls.doc:
Every element of a coalgebra is a matrix coefficient of the regular comodule.

The element `c` is obtained by pairing `c` with the counit functional.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_regular_matrixCoefficientSet (c : C) :

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.lid_map_dualDistrib_tensorCombine
decls.doc:
The combining map underlying the tensor coaction turns the coefficient computation on the
tensor product into the product of the two component computations. This is the linear-algebra
core of `matrixCoefficient_tensor`, stated for arbitrary elements `x : M ⊗ C` and `y : N ⊗ C`
so that it can be applied to the two component coactions.
decls.statement:
theorem lid_map_dualDistrib_tensorCombine (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (ψ : N →ₗ[R] R)
    (x : M ⊗[R] C) (y : N ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.lid R C
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R M N (φ ⊗ₜ[R] ψ)) LinearMap.id
          (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y))) =
      TensorProduct.lid R C (TensorProduct.map φ LinearMap.id x) *
        TensorProduct.lid R C (TensorProduct.map ψ LinearMap.id y)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_tensor
decls.doc:
**Matrix coefficients multiply on a tensor product of comodules.** For the diagonal
coaction on `M ⊗[R] N`, the matrix coefficient of the product functional
`TensorProduct.dualDistrib R M N (φ ⊗ₜ ψ)` (which sends `m ⊗ n ↦ φ m · ψ n`) evaluated at
`m ⊗ n` is the product of the matrix coefficients of `φ` at `m` and of `ψ` at `n`.
decls.title: Matrix coefficients multiply on a tensor product of comodules
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_tensor (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (ψ : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N)
        (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R M N (φ ⊗ₜ[R] ψ)) (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m * matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) ψ n

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.mul_matrixCoefficient_mem_set_tensor
decls.doc:
The product of a matrix coefficient of `M` and a matrix coefficient of `N` is a matrix
coefficient of the tensor product `M ⊗[R] N`, realized on the product functional and the
decomposable vector.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_matrixCoefficient_mem_set_tensor (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (ψ : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m * matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) ψ n ∈
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSet_mul_subset
decls.doc:
**Products of coefficients are coefficients of the tensor product.** The pointwise product
of the coefficient sets of `M` and of `N` is contained in the coefficient set of `M ⊗[R] N`.
decls.title: Products of coefficients are coefficients of the tensor product
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_mul_subset :
    matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) *
        matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ⊆
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientSubmodule_mul_le
decls.doc:
**The coefficient submodules multiply into the tensor product's.** The product of the
matrix coefficient submodules of `M` and of `N` is contained in the matrix coefficient
submodule of `M ⊗[R] N`.
decls.title: The coefficient submodules multiply into the tensor product's
decls.statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_mul_le :
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) *
        matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ≤
      matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact
decls.doc: The direct-sum coaction on the product of two comodules.
decls.statement: def prodCoact : M × N →ₗ[R] (M × N) ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_apply
decls.doc: The product coaction evaluated on a pair.
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_apply (x : M × N) :
    prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) x =
      TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) LinearMap.id
          (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) x.1) +
        TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) LinearMap.id
          (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) x.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_inl
decls.doc: The product coaction after the left inclusion.
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_inl (m : M) :
    prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inl R M N m) =
      TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) LinearMap.id
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_inr
decls.doc: The product coaction after the right inclusion.
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_inr (n : N) :
    prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inr R M N n) =
      TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) LinearMap.id
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) n)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_coassoc_map
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_coassoc_map {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    [Comodule R C P] (f : P →ₗ[R] M × N)
    (hcomp :
      prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ f =
        TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id ∘ₗ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P))
    (p : P) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M × N) C C
        ((prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C
          (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (f p))) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M × N)
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (f p))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_coassoc_inl
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_coassoc_inl (m : M) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M × N) C C
        ((prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C
          (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inl R M N m))) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M × N)
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inl R M N m))

decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_coassoc_inr (n : N) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M × N) C C
        ((prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C
          (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inr R M N n))) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M × N)
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inr R M N n))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_coassoc
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_coassoc :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M × N) C C ∘ₗ
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
          prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M × N) ∘ₗ
        prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)

decls.statement:

    (f : P →ₗ[R] M × N) (t : P ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M × N) (TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id t) =
      TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id (Coalgebra.counit.lTensor P t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_counit_map
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_counit_map {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    [Comodule R C P] (f : P →ₗ[R] M × N)
    (hcomp :
      prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ f =
        TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id ∘ₗ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P))
    (p : P) :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M × N)
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (f p)) =
      f p ⊗ₜ[R] 1

    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M × N)
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inl R M N m)) =

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_counit_inr
decls.statement:

    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M × N)
        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (LinearMap.inr R M N n)) =

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_counit
decls.statement:
theorem prodCoact_counit :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M × N) ∘ₗ
        prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      (TensorProduct.mk R (M × N) R).flip 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Prod_coact
decls.doc: The coaction in `Comodule.Prod` is `Comodule.prodCoact`.
decls.statement:
theorem Prod_coact :

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodFst

def prodFst :

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodFst_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the first projection from the product comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem prodFst_toLinearMap :
    (prodFst (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).toLinearMap =

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodFst_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the first projection from the product comodule returns the first component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodFst_apply (x : M × N) :
    prodFst (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) x = x.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodSnd
decls.doc: The second projection from the product comodule.
decls.statement:
def prodSnd :

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodSnd_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the second projection from the product comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem prodSnd_toLinearMap :

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodSnd_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the second projection from the product comodule returns the second component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodSnd_apply (x : M × N) :
    prodSnd (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) x = x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodInl
decls.doc: The left inclusion into the product comodule.
decls.statement:
def prodInl :
    Hom R C M (M × N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodInl_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the left inclusion into the product comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInl_toLinearMap :

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodInl_apply
decls.doc:
Evaluating the left inclusion into the product comodule gives a pair with zero right
component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInl_apply (m : M) :
    prodInl (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) m = (m, 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodInr
decls.doc: The right inclusion into the product comodule.
decls.statement:
def prodInr :
    Hom R C N (M × N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodInr_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the right inclusion into the product comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInr_toLinearMap :
    (prodInr (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.inr R M N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodInr_apply
decls.doc:
Evaluating the right inclusion into the product comodule gives a pair with zero left
component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInr_apply (n : N) :
    prodInr (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) n = (0, n)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodLeft_map_prod
decls.statement:
theorem prodLeft_map_prod {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    (f : P →ₗ[R] M) (g : P →ₗ[R] N) (t : P ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.prodLeft R R M N C
        (TensorProduct.map (f.prod g) LinearMap.id t) =
      (TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id t, TensorProduct.map g LinearMap.id t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodLift
decls.doc: The product morphism induced by two morphisms with a common source.
decls.statement:
def prodLift {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : Hom R C P M) (g : Hom R C P N) :
    Hom R C P (M × N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodLift_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `Comodule.prodLift`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_toLinearMap {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : Hom R C P M) (g : Hom R C P N) :
    (prodLift (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) f g).toLinearMap =
      f.toLinearMap.prod g.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodLift_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating `Comodule.prodLift` gives the pair of evaluations.
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_apply {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : Hom R C P M) (g : Hom R C P N) (p : P) :
    prodLift (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) f g p = (f p, g p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodDesc
decls.doc: The product morphism induced by two morphisms with a common target.
decls.statement:
def prodDesc {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : Hom R C M P) (g : Hom R C N P) :
    Hom R C (M × N) P

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodDesc_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `Comodule.prodDesc`.
decls.statement:
theorem prodDesc_toLinearMap {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : Hom R C M P) (g : Hom R C N P) :
    (prodDesc (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) f g).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.coprod f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodDesc_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating `Comodule.prodDesc` adds the evaluations of its two components.
decls.statement:
theorem prodDesc_apply {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : Hom R C M P) (g : Hom R C N P) (x : M × N) :
    prodDesc (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) f g x = f x.1 + g x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prod
decls.doc: The product of two bundled comodules, carried by the product of the underlying modules.
decls.statement: abbrev prod (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodFst
decls.doc: The first projection from the bundled product comodule.
decls.statement: abbrev prodFst (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : prod R C M N ⟶ M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodSnd
decls.doc: The second projection from the bundled product comodule.
decls.statement: abbrev prodSnd (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : prod R C M N ⟶ N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodLift
decls.doc: The morphism into the bundled product induced by a pair of morphisms.
decls.statement:
abbrev prodLift {P M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N) :
    P ⟶ prod R C M N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInl
decls.doc: The left inclusion into the bundled product comodule.
decls.statement: abbrev prodInl (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : M ⟶ prod R C M N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInr
decls.doc: The right inclusion into the bundled product comodule.
decls.statement: abbrev prodInr (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : N ⟶ prod R C M N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodDesc
decls.doc: The morphism out of the bundled product induced by a pair of morphisms.
decls.statement:
abbrev prodDesc {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ P) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    prod R C M N ⟶ P

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodFst_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the bundled first projection returns the first component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodFst_apply (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (x : prod R C M N) :
    prodFst M N x = x.1

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodSnd_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the bundled second projection returns the second component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodSnd_apply (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (x : prod R C M N) :
    prodSnd M N x = x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodLift_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the bundled product lift gives the pair of evaluations.
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_apply {P M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N)
    (p : P) :
    prodLift f g p = (f p, g p)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInl_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the bundled left inclusion gives a pair with zero right component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInl_apply (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (m : M) :
    prodInl M N m = (m, 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInr_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the bundled right inclusion gives a pair with zero left component.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInr_apply (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (n : N) :
    prodInr M N n = (0, n)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodDesc_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating the bundled product desc adds the evaluations of its two components.
decls.statement:
theorem prodDesc_apply {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ P) (g : N ⟶ P)
    (x : prod R C M N) :
    prodDesc f g x = f x.1 + g x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodLift_fst
decls.doc: The first projection after the bundled product lift is the first morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_fst {P M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N) :
    prodLift f g ≫ prodFst M N = f

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodLift_snd
decls.doc: The second projection after the bundled product lift is the second morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem prodLift_snd {P M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : P ⟶ M) (g : P ⟶ N) :
    prodLift f g ≫ prodSnd M N = g

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInl_desc
decls.doc: The bundled product desc after the left inclusion is the first morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInl_desc {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ P) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    prodInl M N ≫ prodDesc f g = f

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInr_desc
decls.doc: The bundled product desc after the right inclusion is the second morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInr_desc {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ P) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    prodInr M N ≫ prodDesc f g = g

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInl_fst
decls.doc: The first projection after the left inclusion is the identity.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInl_fst (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    prodInl M N ≫ prodFst M N = 𝟙 M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInl_snd
decls.doc: The second projection after the left inclusion is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInl_snd (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    prodInl M N ≫ prodSnd M N = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInr_fst
decls.doc: The first projection after the right inclusion is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInr_fst (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    prodInr M N ≫ prodFst M N = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prodInr_snd
decls.doc: The second projection after the right inclusion is the identity.
decls.statement:
theorem prodInr_snd (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    prodInr M N ≫ prodSnd M N = 𝟙 N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prod_fst_inl_add_snd_inr
decls.doc: The two projection-inclusion composites reconstruct the identity of the bundled product.
decls.statement:
theorem prod_fst_inl_add_snd_inr (M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    prodFst M N ≫ prodInl M N + prodSnd M N ≫ prodInr M N = 𝟙 (prod R C M N)

decls.doc: Morphisms into the bundled product are determined by their projections.

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.prod_hom_ext'
decls.doc: Morphisms out of the bundled product are determined by their values on the inclusions.

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine
decls.doc:
Combine two coacted tensor factors by shuffling the middle factors together and multiplying
the two `C`-components.

On pure tensors it sends `(m ⊗ c) ⊗ (n ⊗ d)` to `(m ⊗ n) ⊗ cd`.
decls.statement:
def tensorCombine :
    (M ⊗[R] C) ⊗[R] (N ⊗[R] C) →ₗ[R] (M ⊗[R] N) ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_def
decls.doc:
Unfold `tensorCombine` to its defining composition. Kept `private`: the map's body is
deliberately not exposed to downstream modules (the module system hides non-`@[expose]`d
definition bodies), so this equation is an in-file helper for the lemmas below.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_def :
    tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M ⊗[R] N →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] N) (LinearMap.mul' R C) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.tensorTensorTensorComm R M C N C).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_tmul_tmul
decls.doc: `tensorCombine` sends `(m ⊗ c) ⊗ (n ⊗ d)` to `(m ⊗ n) ⊗ cd`.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_tmul_tmul (m : M) (c : C) (n : N) (d : C) :
    tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)
        ((m ⊗ₜ[R] c) ⊗ₜ[R] (n ⊗ₜ[R] d)) =
      (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) ⊗ₜ[R] (c * d)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_natural
decls.doc: The combining map is natural in the two comodule carriers.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_natural (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N') :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f g) (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) ∘ₗ
        tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))
          (TensorProduct.map g (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_assoc
decls.doc:
Combining three coacted factors is compatible with reassociation. The two sides multiply
the coefficient factors as `(c * d) * e` and `c * (d * e)`, respectively.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_assoc (x : M ⊗[R] C) (y : N ⊗[R] C) (z : P ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.assoc R M N P).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N) (N := P)
          (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) ⊗ₜ[R] z)) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N ⊗[R] P)
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := P) (y ⊗ₜ[R] z))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_assoc_symm
decls.doc: The inverse associator is compatible with combining three coacted factors.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_assoc_symm (x : M ⊗[R] C) (y : N ⊗[R] C) (z : P ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.assoc R M N P).symm.toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N ⊗[R] P)
          (x ⊗ₜ[R] tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := P) (y ⊗ₜ[R] z))) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N) (N := P)
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) ⊗ₜ[R] z)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_lid
decls.doc:
Combining the trivial coefficient `1` on the left and applying the left tensor unitor
scales a coacted vector by the scalar in the trivial factor.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_lid (r : R) (x : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.lid R M).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) (N := M)
          ((r ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)) ⊗ₜ[R] x)) =
      r • x

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_lid_symm
decls.doc:
Combining the trivial coefficient `1` on the left agrees with applying the inverse left
tensor unitor to the carrier factor.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_lid_symm (x : M ⊗[R] C) :
    tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) (N := M)
        (((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)) ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.lid R M).symm.toLinearMap LinearMap.id x

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_rid
decls.doc:
Combining the trivial coefficient `1` on the right and applying the right tensor unitor
scales a coacted vector by the scalar in the trivial factor.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_rid (x : M ⊗[R] C) (r : R) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.rid R M).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := R)
          (x ⊗ₜ[R] (r ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)))) =
      r • x

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_rid_symm
decls.doc:
Combining the trivial coefficient `1` on the right agrees with applying the inverse right
tensor unitor to the carrier factor.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_rid_symm (x : M ⊗[R] C) :
    tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := R)
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C))) =
      TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.rid R M).symm.toLinearMap LinearMap.id x

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_comm
decls.doc:
Swapping two coacted factors commutes with combining their coefficients when the
coefficient algebra is commutative.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCombine_comm (x : M ⊗[R] C) (y : N ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.comm R M N).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := M) (y ⊗ₜ[R] x)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact
decls.doc:
The diagonal coaction map on the tensor product of two right comodules over a bialgebra.

The later full tensor-product comodule structure uses this map as its coaction.
decls.statement:
def tensorCoact [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N] :
    M ⊗[R] N →ₗ[R] (M ⊗[R] N) ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_def
decls.doc:
Unfold `tensorCoact` to the combining map applied to the two component coactions. Kept
`private` for the same reason as `tensorCombine_def`: the coaction's body is not exposed
downstream, so this equation only serves the lemmas in this file.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCoact_def [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N] :
    tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M))
          (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_tmul
decls.doc: The tensor-product coaction, before expanding the two component coactions.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCoact_tmul [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N] (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ⊗ₜ[R]
          coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) n)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_natural
decls.doc: The diagonal tensor coaction is natural under tensor products of comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCoact_natural [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] [Comodule R C M']
    [AddCommMonoid N'] [Module R N'] [Comodule R C N']
    (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C N N') :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) ∘ₗ
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.lTensor_comp_tensorCombine
decls.doc:
An `R`-algebra homomorphism `φ : C →ₐ[R] D` may be pushed through the combining map:
`tensorCombine` multiplies the two coefficient factors, and `φ` is multiplicative.

Taking `φ` to be the comultiplication and the counit of a bialgebra gives precisely the two
compatibilities that make `tensorCoact` a coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem lTensor_comp_tensorCombine (φ : C →ₐ[R] D) :
    φ.toLinearMap.lTensor (M ⊗[R] N) ∘ₗ tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := D) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (φ.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (φ.toLinearMap.lTensor N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.assoc_comp_tensorCombine_rTensor_comp_tensorCombine
decls.doc:
Combining twice and then reassociating agrees with reassociating each factor first and
then combining once over `C ⊗[R] C`.

This is pure bookkeeping about `tensorCombine` — it uses no coalgebra structure — and it is
what turns the coassociativity of the two factors into the coassociativity of `tensorCoact`.
decls.statement:
theorem assoc_comp_tensorCombine_rTensor_comp_tensorCombine :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⊗[R] N) C C ∘ₗ
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
          tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C) (N := N ⊗[R] C) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C ⊗[R] C) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).toLinearMap
          (TensorProduct.assoc R N C C).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_coassoc
decls.doc:
The diagonal coaction on `M ⊗[R] N` is coassociative.

Coassociativity of the two factors puts the doubly coacted vectors into the form
`m₀ ⊗ Δ(m₁)`, and the comultiplication of `C` is an algebra homomorphism, so it commutes with
the multiplication that `tensorCombine` performs on the coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCoact_coassoc :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⊗[R] N) C C ∘ₗ
        (tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
          tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M ⊗[R] N) ∘ₗ
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_counit
decls.doc:
The diagonal coaction on `M ⊗[R] N` satisfies the counit law: the counit of `C` is an
algebra homomorphism, so it turns the product of the two coefficients into the product of
their counits, which is `1`.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorCoact_counit :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M ⊗[R] N) ∘ₗ
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      (TensorProduct.mk R (M ⊗[R] N) R).flip 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensor
decls.doc:
The tensor product of two right `C`-comodules over a bialgebra, with the diagonal coaction
`m ⊗ n ↦ (m₀ ⊗ n₀) ⊗ m₁ n₁`.

Following `Comodule.cofree`, this is deliberately *not* a global instance: an `R`-module can
carry many coactions, so a global instance on a tensor product would make `Comodule`
resolution non-confluent. Select it explicitly, or register it as a local instance.
decls.statement: def tensor : Comodule R C (M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensor_coact
decls.doc: The coaction of the tensor-product comodule is the diagonal coaction `tensorCoact`.
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_coact :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N) =
      tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.tensorMap
decls.doc:
The tensor product of two comodule morphisms, as a morphism of tensor-product comodules.

Both source and target carry the diagonal coaction of `Comodule.tensor`; the required
compatibility is `Comodule.tensorCoact_natural`.
decls.statement:
def tensorMap (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C N N') :
    Hom R C (M ⊗[R] N) (M' ⊗[R] N')

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.tensorMap_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The underlying linear map of `tensorMap f g` is the tensor product of the two underlying
linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_toLinearMap (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C N N') :
    (tensorMap f g).toLinearMap = TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.tensorMap_apply
decls.doc: `tensorMap f g` acts as `f ⊗ g`.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_apply (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C N N') (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    tensorMap f g x = TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap x

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.tensorMap_tmul
decls.doc: `tensorMap` acts on a simple tensor as the pair of component morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_tmul (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C N N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorMap f g (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = f m ⊗ₜ[R] g n

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.tensorMap_id
decls.doc:
The tensor product of two identity morphisms is the identity morphism.

This is not a `simp` lemma: its left-hand side is not in `simp`-normal form, because the `@[simp]`
lemma `ComoduleCat.ofHom_id` rewrites each `Comodule.Hom.id R C _` to the categorical identity
`𝟙 (ComoduleCat.of R C _)`. This fires even though no `ComoduleCat.ofHom` appears syntactically in
the left-hand side: `ofHom` is a reducible `abbrev` for the identity coercion (a categorical
morphism `of R C M ⟶ of R C N` just *is* a `Comodule.Hom R C M N`), so `simp` unifies `ofHom_id`'s
left-hand side `ofHom (Comodule.Hom.id R C _)` with a bare `Comodule.Hom.id R C _`. Tagging this
lemma `@[simp]` therefore fails the `simpNF` linter. (Contrast `cofreeMap_id`, whose left-hand side
`cofreeMap LinearMap.id` carries no bare `Comodule.Hom.id` and so stays normal.)
decls.statement: theorem tensorMap_id : tensorMap (id R C M) (id R C N) = id R C (M ⊗[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.tensorMap_comp
decls.doc: The tensor product of morphisms is compatible with composition.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorMap_comp (f : Hom R C M M') (f' : Hom R C M' M'')
    (g : Hom R C N N') (g' : Hom R C N' N'') :
    tensorMap (f'.comp f) (g'.comp g) = (tensorMap f' g').comp (tensorMap f g)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportCoact
decls.doc:
The coaction obtained by transporting a right-comodule structure across a linear
equivalence `e : M ≃ₗ[R] N`.

It sends `n` to `(e ⊗ id) (ρ (e.symm n))`.
decls.statement: def transportCoact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : N →ₗ[R] N ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportCoact_apply
decls.doc: The transported coaction evaluates as `(e ⊗ id) (ρ (e.symm n))`.
decls.statement:
theorem transportCoact_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : N) :
    transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e n =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (e.symm n))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportCoact_refl
decls.doc: Transporting along the identity linear equivalence leaves the coaction unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem transportCoact_refl :
    transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := M) (LinearEquiv.refl R M) =
      coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.assoc_rTensor_transportCoact
decls.statement:
theorem assoc_rTensor_transportCoact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R N C C
        ((transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e).rTensor C
          (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t)) =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id LinearMap.id)
        (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
          ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t))

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.comul_lTensor_transport_map
decls.statement:
theorem comul_lTensor_transport_map (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.comul.lTensor N (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t) =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id LinearMap.id)
        (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.counit_lTensor_transport_map
decls.statement:
theorem counit_lTensor_transport_map (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor N (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t) =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id (Coalgebra.counit.lTensor M t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Transport
decls.doc:
Transport a right-comodule structure across a linear equivalence.

If `M` is a right `C`-comodule and `e : M ≃ₗ[R] N`, then `N` becomes a right `C`-comodule by
the coaction `(e ⊗ id) ∘ ρ ∘ e.symm`. This definition is intentionally not a global
instance: the target module may carry several different coactions.
decls.statement: def Transport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transport_coact
decls.doc: The transported coaction is `(e ⊗ id) ∘ ρ ∘ e.symm`.
decls.statement:
theorem transport_coact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transport_coact_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `transport_coact`.
decls.statement:
theorem transport_coact_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportCoact_trans
decls.doc: Transported coactions compose in the linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem transportCoact_trans (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (f : N ≃ₗ[R] P) :
    transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := P) (e.trans f) =
      letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensor_map_transport_conj
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_map_transport_conj (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N')
    (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (eN.toLinearMap.comp (f.comp eM.symm.toLinearMap)) LinearMap.id
        (TensorProduct.map eM.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t) =
      TensorProduct.map eN.toLinearMap LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportHom
decls.doc: Transport a comodule morphism across linear equivalences on source and target.
decls.statement:
def transportHom (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (f : Hom R C M M') :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc: Transporting a morphism has the conjugated underlying linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem transportHom_toLinearMap (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (f : Hom R C M M') :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportHom_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `transportHom_toLinearMap`.
decls.statement:
theorem transportHom_apply (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (f : Hom R C M M')
    (n : N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportHom_id
decls.doc: Transporting the identity morphism gives the identity morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem transportHom_id (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportHom_comp
decls.doc: Transporting morphisms preserves composition.
decls.statement:
theorem transportHom_comp (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eM' : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (eP : P ≃ₗ[R] P')
    (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C M' P) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportToHom
decls.doc: The forward morphism from a comodule to its transport along a linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
def transportToHom (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportInvHom
decls.doc: The inverse morphism from a transported comodule back to the original comodule.
decls.statement:
def transportInvHom (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportToHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The forward transport morphism has the original linear equivalence underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem transportToHom_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportInvHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The inverse transport morphism has the inverse linear equivalence underneath.
decls.statement:
theorem transportInvHom_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportToHom_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `transportToHom_toLinearMap`.
decls.statement:
theorem transportToHom_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.transportInvHom_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `transportInvHom_toLinearMap`.
decls.statement:
theorem transportInvHom_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transport
decls.doc: Bundle the transport of a comodule structure across a linear equivalence.
decls.statement: def transport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : ComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transport_coact
decls.doc: The coaction on `ComoduleCat.transport` is the transported coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem transport_coact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := transport R C e) =
      Comodule.transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transportIso
decls.doc: The categorical isomorphism from a comodule to its transport along a linear equivalence.
decls.statement: def transportIso (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) : of R C M ≅ transport R C e

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transportIso_hom_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The transport isomorphism has the original linear equivalence as its forward map.
decls.statement:
theorem transportIso_hom_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    ((transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).hom).toLinearMap = e.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transportIso_inv_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The transport isomorphism has the inverse linear equivalence as its inverse map.
decls.statement:
theorem transportIso_inv_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    ((transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).inv).toLinearMap = e.symm.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transportIso_hom_apply
decls.doc: The forward map of the transport isomorphism applies as the original linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem transportIso_hom_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) (m : M) :
    (transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).hom m = e m

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.transportIso_inv_apply
decls.doc: The inverse map of the transport isomorphism applies as the inverse linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
theorem transportIso_inv_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) (n : N₀) :
    (transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).inv n = e.symm n

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.groupLikeCoact
decls.doc:
The map `m ↦ m ⊗ g` attached to a group-like element `g : GroupLike R C`, as an
`R`-linear map `M →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] C`. It serves as the coaction of the comodule structure
`Comodule.groupLike g`.
decls.statement: def groupLikeCoact (g : GroupLike R C) : M →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.groupLike
decls.doc:
The right `C`-comodule structure on an `R`-module attached to a group-like element
`g : GroupLike R C`, with coaction `m ↦ m ⊗ g`.

This is not registered as a global instance: an `R`-module can carry many coactions, and the
group-like coaction should be selected explicitly with `Comodule.groupLike`.
decls.statement: def groupLike (g : GroupLike R C) : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.groupLike_coact_apply
decls.doc: The coaction attached to a group-like element sends `m` to `m ⊗ g`.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLike_coact_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.groupLike_coact
decls.doc: The coaction attached to a group-like element is the map `m ↦ m ⊗ g`.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLike_coact (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofGroupLike
decls.doc:
A linear map is automatically a comodule morphism between the comodules attached to
the same group-like element.
decls.statement:
def Hom.ofGroupLike (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofGroupLike_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `Hom.ofGroupLike g f` is `f`.
decls.statement:
theorem ofGroupLike_toLinearMap (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofGroupLike_apply
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism induced by a linear map between group-like comodules applies as
that linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem ofGroupLike_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofGroupLike_id
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism induced by the identity linear map between group-like comodules is
the identity comodule morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem ofGroupLike_id (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofGroupLike_comp
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism induced by a composite linear map between group-like comodules is
the composite of the induced comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem ofGroupLike_comp {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    (g : GroupLike R C) (h : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv
decls.doc:
Comodule morphisms between comodules attached to the same group-like element are exactly
ordinary linear maps.
decls.statement:
def groupLikeEquiv (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv_apply
decls.doc: Applying `groupLikeEquiv` returns the underlying linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeEquiv_apply (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse of `groupLikeEquiv` sends a linear map to the corresponding morphism of
group-like comodules.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.doc: Pointwise form of `groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply`.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.trivial
decls.doc:
The trivial right `C`-comodule structure on an `R`-module.

This is not registered as a global instance: an `R`-module can carry many coactions, and the
trivial one should be selected explicitly with `Comodule.trivial`.
decls.statement: def trivial : Comodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.trivial_coact_apply
decls.doc: The coaction of the trivial right comodule sends `m` to `m ⊗ 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem trivial_coact_apply (m : M) :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m = m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.trivial_coact
decls.doc: The coaction of the trivial right comodule is the map `m ↦ m ⊗ 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem trivial_coact :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) = (TensorProduct.mk R M C).flip (1 : C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofTrivial
decls.doc: A linear map between trivial comodules is automatically a comodule morphism.
decls.statement: def Hom.ofTrivial (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : Hom R C M N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofTrivial_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of `Hom.ofTrivial f` is `f`.
decls.statement:
theorem ofTrivial_toLinearMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) f).toLinearMap = f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofTrivial_apply
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism induced by a linear map between trivial comodules applies as that
linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem ofTrivial_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) f m = f m

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofTrivial_id
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism induced by the identity linear map between trivial comodules is
the identity comodule morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem ofTrivial_id :
    ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) LinearMap.id = Comodule.Hom.id R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ofTrivial_comp
decls.doc:
The comodule morphism induced by a composite linear map between trivial comodules is the
composite of the induced comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem ofTrivial_comp {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) (g.comp f) =
      comp (ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) g) (ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.trivialEquiv
decls.doc: Comodule morphisms between trivial comodules are exactly ordinary linear maps.
decls.statement: def trivialEquiv : Hom R C M N ≃ (M →ₗ[R] N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.trivialEquiv_apply
decls.doc: Applying `trivialEquiv` returns the underlying linear map.
decls.statement:
theorem trivialEquiv_apply (f : Hom R C M N) :
    trivialEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) f = f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.trivialEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse of `trivialEquiv` sends a linear map to the corresponding morphism of
trivial comodules.
decls.statement:
theorem trivialEquiv_symm_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (trivialEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).symm f =
      ofTrivial (R := R) (C := C) f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.trivialEquiv_symm_apply_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `trivialEquiv_symm_apply`.
decls.statement:
theorem trivialEquiv_symm_apply_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    (trivialEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).symm f m = f m

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.trivial
decls.doc:
The bundled trivial right comodule over a bialgebra.

This is the tensor-unit candidate for the monoidal category of right comodules: its
underlying `R`-module is `R`, and its coaction is `r ↦ r ⊗ 1`.
decls.statement: abbrev trivial : ComoduleCat.{u, v, u} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.instPUnit
decls.doc: The unique right-comodule structure on the zero module `PUnit`.
decls.statement: instance instPUnit : Comodule R C PUnit

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.zero
decls.doc: The bundled zero right comodule.
decls.statement: def zero : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.subsingleton_zero
decls.doc: The named zero comodule has subsingleton carrier.
decls.statement: theorem subsingleton_zero : Subsingleton (zero R C : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton
decls.doc: A comodule whose underlying type is subsingleton is a zero object.
decls.statement: theorem isZero_of_subsingleton (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) [Subsingleton M] : IsZero M

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isZero_zero
decls.doc: The named zero comodule is a zero object.
decls.statement: theorem isZero_zero : IsZero (zero R C : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.zero_hom_eq_zero
decls.doc: Any morphism from the named zero comodule is zero.
decls.statement: theorem zero_hom_eq_zero (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (f : zero R C ⟶ M) : f = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.hom_zero_eq_zero
decls.doc: Any morphism to the named zero comodule is zero.
decls.statement: theorem hom_zero_eq_zero (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (f : M ⟶ zero R C) : f = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isZero_zero_to
decls.doc: The canonical morphism out of the named zero comodule is the zero morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isZero_zero_to (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (isZero_zero (R := R) (C := C)).to_ M = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isZero_zero_from
decls.doc: The canonical morphism into the named zero comodule is the zero morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isZero_zero_from (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (isZero_zero (R := R) (C := C)).from_ M = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.zero_hom_ext
decls.doc: Morphisms from the named zero comodule are unique.
decls.statement: theorem zero_hom_ext {M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : zero R C ⟶ M) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.hom_zero_ext
decls.doc: Morphisms to the named zero comodule are unique.
decls.statement: theorem hom_zero_ext {M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ zero R C) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.hasZeroObject
decls.doc: The category of right comodules has a zero object.
decls.statement: instance hasZeroObject : HasZeroObject (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra
decls.doc:
A subcoalgebra of an `R`-coalgebra `C`.

It is an `R`-submodule `carrier` such that the comultiplication of every element of
`carrier` lies in the range of `carrier ⊗ carrier → C ⊗ C`.
decls.statement: structure Subcoalgebra

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instSetLike
decls.statement: instance : SetLike (Subcoalgebra R C) C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instAddSubmonoidClass
decls.statement: instance : AddSubmonoidClass (Subcoalgebra R C) C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instSMulMemClass
decls.statement: instance : SMulMemClass (Subcoalgebra R C) R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instPartialOrder
decls.statement: instance : PartialOrder (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toSubmodule
decls.doc: The underlying submodule of a subcoalgebra.
decls.statement: def toSubmodule (D : Subcoalgebra R C) : Submodule R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_carrier
decls.statement: theorem mem_carrier {D : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} : c ∈ D.carrier ↔ c ∈ D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_toSubmodule
decls.statement: theorem mem_toSubmodule {D : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} : c ∈ D.toSubmodule ↔ c ∈ D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toSubmodule_carrier
decls.statement: theorem toSubmodule_carrier (D : Subcoalgebra R C) : D.toSubmodule = D.carrier

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.le_def
decls.statement: theorem le_def {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} : D ≤ E ↔ ∀ ⦃c : C⦄, c ∈ D → c ∈ E

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule
decls.statement:
theorem toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} :
    D.toSubmodule ≤ E.toSubmodule ↔ D ≤ E

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.ext
decls.doc: Two subcoalgebras are equal when they contain the same elements.
decls.statement: theorem ext {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} (h : ∀ c : C, c ∈ D ↔ c ∈ E) : D = E

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.comul_mem
decls.doc: The comultiplication of an element of a subcoalgebra belongs to its tensor square.
decls.statement:
theorem comul_mem (D : Subcoalgebra R C) {c : C} (hc : c ∈ D) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c ∈
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map D.carrier.subtype D.carrier.subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.ofSubmodule
decls.doc: Constructor from a submodule and the tensor-square stability condition.
decls.statement:
def ofSubmodule (D : Submodule R C)
    (hD :
      ∀ ⦃c : C⦄, c ∈ D →
        Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c ∈
          LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map D.subtype D.subtype)) :
    Subcoalgebra R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.ofSubmodule_carrier
decls.statement:
theorem ofSubmodule_carrier (D : Submodule R C) (hD) :
    (ofSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) D hD).carrier = D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_ofSubmodule
decls.statement:
theorem mem_ofSubmodule {D : Submodule R C} {hD} {c : C} :
    c ∈ ofSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) D hD ↔ c ∈ D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instTop
decls.doc: The full coalgebra as a subcoalgebra.
decls.statement: instance instTop : Top (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.top_toSubmodule
decls.statement: theorem top_toSubmodule : (⊤ : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule = (⊤ : Submodule R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_top
decls.statement: theorem mem_top (c : C) : c ∈ (⊤ : Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instOrderTop
decls.statement: instance : OrderTop (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instBot
decls.doc: The zero submodule as a subcoalgebra.
decls.statement: instance instBot : Bot (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.bot_toSubmodule
decls.statement: theorem bot_toSubmodule : (⊥ : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule = (⊥ : Submodule R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_bot
decls.statement: theorem mem_bot {c : C} : c ∈ (⊥ : Subcoalgebra R C) ↔ c = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instOrderBot
decls.doc: The zero subcoalgebra is contained in every subcoalgebra.
decls.statement: instance : OrderBot (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan
decls.doc: The subcoalgebra spanned by a set of group-like elements.
decls.statement: def groupLikeSetSpan (s : Set (GroupLike R C)) : Subcoalgebra R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of the subcoalgebra spanned by a set of group-like elements is the
linear span of their underlying elements.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule (s : Set (GroupLike R C)) :
    (groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s).toSubmodule =
      Submodule.span R ((↑) '' s : Set C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_groupLikeSetSpan
decls.statement:
theorem mem_groupLikeSetSpan {s : Set (GroupLike R C)} {c : C} :
    c ∈ groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s ↔
      c ∈ Submodule.span R ((↑) '' s : Set C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLike_mem_groupLikeSetSpan
decls.doc: A group-like element in the generating set belongs to the subcoalgebra it spans.

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_le
decls.doc: Universal property for subcoalgebras spanned by a set of group-like elements.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_le {s : Set (GroupLike R C)} {D : Subcoalgebra R C} :
    groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s ≤ D ↔ ∀ g ∈ s, (g : C) ∈ D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_mono
decls.doc: Monotonicity of the subcoalgebra spanned by a set of group-like elements.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_mono {s t : Set (GroupLike R C)} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s ≤ groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) t

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSpan
decls.doc: The subcoalgebra spanned by a group-like element.
decls.statement: def groupLikeSpan (g : GroupLike R C) : Subcoalgebra R C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSpan_le
decls.doc: Universal property for the subcoalgebra spanned by one group-like element.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeSpan_le {g : GroupLike R C} {D : Subcoalgebra R C} :
    groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g ≤ D ↔ (g : C) ∈ D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of the subcoalgebra spanned by one group-like element is the
submodule generated by `(g : C)`.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule (g : GroupLike R C) :
    (groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g).toSubmodule = R ∙ (g : C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLike_mem_groupLikeSpan
decls.doc: A group-like element belongs to its span subcoalgebra.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLike_mem_groupLikeSpan (g : GroupLike R C) :
    (g : C) ∈ groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_groupLikeSpan
decls.doc: Membership in the subcoalgebra spanned by a group-like element.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_groupLikeSpan {g : GroupLike R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g ↔ ∃ r : R, r • (g : C) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_finite
decls.doc: A subcoalgebra spanned by a finite set of group-like elements is finitely generated.
decls.statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_finite (s : Set (GroupLike R C)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    Module.Finite R (groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSpan_finite
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of the subcoalgebra spanned by one group-like element is finitely
generated.
decls.statement:
instance groupLikeSpan_finite (g : GroupLike R C) :
    Module.Finite R (groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.tensorSquare_range_mono
decls.statement:
lemma tensorSquare_range_mono {P Q : Submodule R C} (hPQ : P ≤ Q) :
    LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map P.subtype P.subtype) ≤
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map Q.subtype Q.subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.comul_mem_sup
decls.statement:
lemma comul_mem_sup (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) {c : C}
    (hc : c ∈ D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule).subtype
          (D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule).subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.comul_mem_sSup
decls.statement:
lemma comul_mem_sSup (S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)) {c : C}
    (hc : c ∈ ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule).subtype
          (⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule).subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instMax
decls.doc:
The join of two subcoalgebras has underlying submodule the join of the underlying
submodules.
decls.statement: instance instMax : Max (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instSupSet
decls.doc:
The supremum of a set of subcoalgebras has underlying submodule the supremum of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement: instance instSupSet : SupSet (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.sup_toSubmodule
decls.doc: The underlying submodule of the join is the join of the underlying submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem sup_toSubmodule (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (D ⊔ E).toSubmodule = D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_sup
decls.doc: Membership in the join of two subcoalgebras.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sup {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ D ⊔ E ↔ ∃ d ∈ D, ∃ e ∈ E, d + e = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instSemilatticeSup
decls.doc:
Subcoalgebras form a semilattice under the join whose carrier is the supremum of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement: instance instSemilatticeSup : SemilatticeSup (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.sSup_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of a supremum of a set of subcoalgebras is the supremum of the
underlying submodules indexed by that set.
decls.statement:
theorem sSup_toSubmodule (S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)) :
    (sSup S).toSubmodule = ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_sSup
decls.doc: Membership in the supremum of a set of subcoalgebras.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)} {c : C} :
    c ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ C, (∀ D : S, f D ∈ (D : Subcoalgebra R C)) ∧
        f.sum (fun _ x => x) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.iSup_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of a supremum of subcoalgebras is the supremum of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem iSup_toSubmodule {ι : Sort*} (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (⨆ i, D i).toSubmodule = ⨆ i, (D i).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_iSup
decls.doc: Membership in the supremum of a family of subcoalgebras.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ ⨆ i, D i ↔
      ∃ f : ι →₀ C, (∀ i, f i ∈ D i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ x => x) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instCompleteSemilatticeSup
decls.doc: Subcoalgebras have arbitrary suprema, computed on underlying submodules.
decls.statement: instance instCompleteSemilatticeSup : CompleteSemilatticeSup (Subcoalgebra R C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.sup_finite
decls.doc: The join of finitely generated subcoalgebras is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem sup_finite (D E : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R D.toSubmodule] [Module.Finite R E.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R (D ⊔ E).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instFiniteSup
decls.doc: The join of finitely generated subcoalgebras is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
instance instFiniteSup (D E : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R D.toSubmodule] [Module.Finite R E.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R (D ⊔ E).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.finset_sup_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of a finite join of subcoalgebras is the finite join of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem finset_sup_toSubmodule (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (s.sup D).toSubmodule = s.sup fun i => (D i).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_finset_sup
decls.doc: Membership in a finite join of subcoalgebras.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_finset_sup {s : Finset ι} {D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ s.sup D ↔ ∃ μ : ∀ i, (D i).toSubmodule, (∑ i ∈ s, (μ i : C)) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.iSup_finite
decls.doc:
A finite supremum of finitely generated subcoalgebras is finitely generated as an
`R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem iSup_finite [Finite ι] (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C)
    (hD : ∀ i, Module.Finite R (D i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (⨆ i, D i).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.finset_sup_finite
decls.doc:
A finite join of finitely generated subcoalgebras is finitely generated as an
`R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem finset_sup_finite (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C)
    (hD : ∀ i ∈ s, Module.Finite R (D i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (s.sup D).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mapSubtype
decls.statement:
def mapSubtype (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    A.carrier →ₗ[R] A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.image_tensorSquare_apply
decls.statement:
theorem image_tensorSquare_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C)
    (t : A.carrier ⊗[R] A.carrier) :
    TensorProduct.map (A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap).subtype
        (A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap).subtype
        (TensorProduct.map (mapSubtype f A) (mapSubtype f A) t) =
      TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap
        (TensorProduct.map A.carrier.subtype A.carrier.subtype t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map
decls.doc: The image of a subcoalgebra under a coalgebra morphism.
decls.statement: def map (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C) : Subcoalgebra R D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of the image subcoalgebra is the image of the underlying
submodule.
decls.statement:
theorem map_toSubmodule (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (A.map f).toSubmodule = A.toSubmodule.map f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_map
decls.doc: Membership in the image subcoalgebra.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_map {f : C →ₗc[R] D} {A : Subcoalgebra R C} {d : D} :
    d ∈ A.map f ↔ ∃ c ∈ A, f c = d

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_map_of_mem
decls.doc: The image of an element of a subcoalgebra belongs to the image subcoalgebra.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {A : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} (hc : c ∈ A) :
    f c ∈ A.map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_le_iff
decls.doc:
The image subcoalgebra is contained in `B` exactly when each image of an element of the
source subcoalgebra belongs to `B`.
decls.statement:
theorem map_le_iff {f : C →ₗc[R] D} {A : Subcoalgebra R C} {B : Subcoalgebra R D} :
    A.map f ≤ B ↔ ∀ ⦃c⦄, c ∈ A → f c ∈ B

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_mono
decls.doc: The image construction is monotone in the source subcoalgebra.
decls.statement:
theorem map_mono (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {A B : Subcoalgebra R C} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.map f ≤ B.map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_bot
decls.doc: The image of the bottom subcoalgebra is bottom.
decls.statement: theorem map_bot (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : (⊥ : Subcoalgebra R C).map f = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_top_toSubmodule
decls.doc: The image of the top subcoalgebra is the range of the coalgebra morphism as a submodule.
decls.statement:
theorem map_top_toSubmodule (f : C →ₗc[R] D) :
    ((⊤ : Subcoalgebra R C).map f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_id
decls.doc: The identity coalgebra morphism leaves a subcoalgebra unchanged.
decls.statement: theorem map_id (A : Subcoalgebra R C) : A.map (CoalgHom.id R C) = A

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_map
decls.doc: Images of subcoalgebras compose with coalgebra morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem map_map (A : Subcoalgebra R C) (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E) :
    (A.map f).map g = A.map (g.comp f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_sup
decls.doc: The image of a binary join is the binary join of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem map_sup (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A B : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (A ⊔ B).map f = A.map f ⊔ B.map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_iSup
decls.doc: The image of a supremum is the supremum of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem map_iSup {ι : Sort*} (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (⨆ i, A i).map f = ⨆ i, (A i).map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_finset_sup
decls.doc: The image of a finite join is the finite join of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem map_finset_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : C →ₗc[R] D)
    (A : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (s.sup A).map f = s.sup fun i => (A i).map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.map_finite
decls.doc: The image of a finitely generated subcoalgebra is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem map_finite (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R A.toSubmodule] : Module.Finite R (A.map f).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.tensorSquare_range_le_regular_range
decls.statement:
theorem tensorSquare_range_le_regular_range (D : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map D.toSubmodule.subtype D.toSubmodule.subtype) ≤
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map D.toSubmodule.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule
decls.doc:
A subcoalgebra as a subcomodule of the regular right comodule.

The underlying submodule is unchanged; the map `D ⊗ D → C ⊗ C` factors through
`D ⊗ C → C ⊗ C` by including the second tensor factor.
decls.statement: def toRegularSubcomodule (D : Subcoalgebra R C) : Subcomodule R C C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule is unchanged when a subcoalgebra is viewed as a subcomodule of
the regular comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule (D : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    D.toRegularSubcomodule.toSubmodule = D.toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_toRegularSubcomodule
decls.doc:
Membership is unchanged when a subcoalgebra is viewed as a subcomodule of the regular
comodule.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_toRegularSubcomodule {D : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ D.toRegularSubcomodule ↔ c ∈ D

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_mono
decls.doc: Viewing a subcoalgebra as a regular subcomodule is monotone.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_mono {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} (hDE : D ≤ E) :
    D.toRegularSubcomodule ≤ E.toRegularSubcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding
decls.doc: Viewing subcoalgebras as regular subcomodules is an order embedding.
decls.statement:
def toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding :
    Subcoalgebra R C ↪o Subcomodule R C C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding_apply
decls.doc:
Applying the order embedding from subcoalgebras to regular subcomodules gives
`toRegularSubcomodule`.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding_apply (D : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding (R := R) (C := C) D = D.toRegularSubcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_bot
decls.doc: The bottom subcoalgebra is the bottom regular subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_bot :
    (⊥ : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule = (⊥ : Subcomodule R C C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_top
decls.doc: The top subcoalgebra is the top regular subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_top :
    (⊤ : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule = (⊤ : Subcomodule R C C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_sup
decls.doc: Viewing subcoalgebras as regular subcomodules preserves binary joins.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_sup (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (D ⊔ E).toRegularSubcomodule = D.toRegularSubcomodule ⊔ E.toRegularSubcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_iSup
decls.doc: Viewing subcoalgebras as regular subcomodules preserves arbitrary joins.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_iSup {ι : Sort*} (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (⨆ i, D i).toRegularSubcomodule = ⨆ i, (D i).toRegularSubcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_sSup
decls.doc: Viewing subcoalgebras as regular subcomodules preserves set-indexed suprema.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_sSup (S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)) :
    (sSup S).toRegularSubcomodule =
      ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_finset_sup
decls.doc: Viewing subcoalgebras as regular subcomodules preserves finite joins.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_finset_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (s.sup D).toRegularSubcomodule = s.sup fun i => (D i).toRegularSubcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.toRegularSubcomodule_finite
decls.doc: A finite subcoalgebra is finite as a regular subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_finite (D : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R D.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R D.toRegularSubcomodule.toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.instFiniteToRegularSubcomodule
decls.doc: A finite subcoalgebra is finite as a regular subcomodule.
decls.statement:
instance instFiniteToRegularSubcomodule (D : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R D.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R D.toRegularSubcomodule.toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule
decls.doc:
A subcomodule of a right `C`-comodule `M`.

It is an `R`-submodule `carrier` such that the coaction of every element of `carrier` lies in
the range of `carrier ⊗ C → M ⊗ C`.
decls.statement: structure Subcomodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instSetLike
decls.statement: instance : SetLike (Subcomodule R C M) M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instAddSubmonoidClass
decls.statement: instance : AddSubmonoidClass (Subcomodule R C M) M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instSMulMemClass
decls.statement: instance : SMulMemClass (Subcomodule R C M) R M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instPartialOrder
decls.statement: instance : PartialOrder (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule
decls.doc: The underlying submodule of a subcomodule.
decls.statement: def toSubmodule (N : Subcomodule R C M) : Submodule R M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_carrier
decls.statement: theorem mem_carrier {N : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} : m ∈ N.carrier ↔ m ∈ N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_toSubmodule
decls.statement: theorem mem_toSubmodule {N : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} : m ∈ N.toSubmodule ↔ m ∈ N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule_carrier
decls.statement: theorem toSubmodule_carrier (N : Subcomodule R C M) : N.toSubmodule = N.carrier

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.finite
decls.doc: A subcomodule of a noetherian module is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem finite (N : Subcomodule R C M) [IsNoetherian R M] :
    Module.Finite R N.toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.le_def
decls.statement: theorem le_def {N P : Subcomodule R C M} : N ≤ P ↔ ∀ ⦃m : M⦄, m ∈ N → m ∈ P

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule
decls.statement:
theorem toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule {N P : Subcomodule R C M} :
    N.toSubmodule ≤ P.toSubmodule ↔ N ≤ P

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ext
decls.doc: Two subcomodules are equal when they contain the same elements.
decls.statement: theorem ext {N P : Subcomodule R C M} (h : ∀ m : M, m ∈ N ↔ m ∈ P) : N = P

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem
decls.doc:
The coaction of an element of a subcomodule belongs to its tensor product with the
coalgebra.
decls.statement:
theorem coact_mem (N : Subcomodule R C M) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ N) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map N.carrier.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ofSubmodule
decls.doc: Constructor from a submodule and the tensor-product stability condition.
decls.statement:
def ofSubmodule (N : Submodule R M)
    (hN :
      ∀ ⦃m : M⦄, m ∈ N →
        Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
          LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map N.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))) :
    Subcomodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ofSubmodule_carrier
decls.statement:
theorem ofSubmodule_carrier (N : Submodule R M) (hN) :
    (ofSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) N hN).carrier = N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_ofSubmodule
decls.statement:
theorem mem_ofSubmodule {N : Submodule R M} {hN} {m : M} :
    m ∈ ofSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) N hN ↔ m ∈ N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.tensor_mem_range_top
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_mem_range_top (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    t ∈ LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.map (⊤ : Submodule R M).subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instTop
decls.doc: The full module as a subcomodule.
decls.statement: instance instTop : Top (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.top_toSubmodule
decls.statement: theorem top_toSubmodule : (⊤ : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule = (⊤ : Submodule R M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_top
decls.statement: theorem mem_top (m : M) : m ∈ (⊤ : Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instOrderTop
decls.statement: instance : OrderTop (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instBot
decls.doc: The zero submodule as a subcomodule.
decls.statement: instance instBot : Bot (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.bot_toSubmodule
decls.statement: theorem bot_toSubmodule : (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule = (⊥ : Submodule R M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_bot
decls.statement: theorem mem_bot {m : M} : m ∈ (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M) ↔ m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instOrderBot
decls.doc: The zero subcomodule is contained in every subcomodule.
decls.statement: instance : OrderBot (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mapSubtype
decls.statement:
def mapSubtype (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (A : Subcomodule R C M) :
    A.carrier →ₗ[R] A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.image_tensor_apply
decls.statement:
theorem image_tensor_apply (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (A : Subcomodule R C M)
    (t : A.carrier ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap).subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
        (TensorProduct.map (mapSubtype f A) (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) t) =
      TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
        (TensorProduct.map A.carrier.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map
decls.doc: The image of a subcomodule under a comodule morphism.
decls.statement: def map (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) : Subcomodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of the image subcomodule is the image of the underlying
submodule.
decls.statement:
