theorem map_toSubmodule (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    (A.map f).toSubmodule = A.toSubmodule.map f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_finite
decls.doc: The image of a finitely generated subcomodule is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem map_finite (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (A : Subcomodule R C M)
    [Module.Finite R A.toSubmodule] : Module.Finite R (A.map f).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_map
decls.doc: Membership in the image subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_map {A : Subcomodule R C M} {f : Comodule.Hom R C M N} {n : N} :
    n ∈ A.map f ↔ ∃ m ∈ A, f m = n

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_map_of_mem
decls.doc: The image of an element of a subcomodule belongs to the image subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) {A : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ A) : f m ∈ A.map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_le_iff
decls.doc:
The image subcomodule is contained in `B` exactly when each image of an element of the
source subcomodule belongs to `B`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_mono
decls.doc: The image construction is monotone in the source subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem map_mono (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) {A B : Subcomodule R C M} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.map f ≤ B.map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_bot
decls.doc: The image of the bottom subcomodule is bottom.
decls.statement: theorem map_bot (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) : (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M).map f = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_top_toSubmodule
decls.doc: The image of the top subcomodule is the range of the comodule morphism as a submodule.
decls.statement:
theorem map_top_toSubmodule (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    ((⊤ : Subcomodule R C M).map f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_id
decls.doc: The identity comodule morphism leaves a subcomodule unchanged.
decls.statement: theorem map_id (A : Subcomodule R C M) : A.map (Comodule.Hom.id R C M) = A

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_map
decls.doc: Images of subcomodules compose with comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem map_map (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N)
    (g : Comodule.Hom R C N P) : (A.map f).map g = A.map (g.comp f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range
decls.doc: The image of a comodule morphism as a subcomodule of the codomain.
decls.statement: def range (f : Hom R C M N) : Subcomodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range_toSubmodule
decls.statement:
theorem range_toSubmodule (f : Hom R C M N) :
    (range (R := R) (C := C) f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range_finite
decls.doc:
The range of a comodule morphism out of a finitely generated module is finitely generated
as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem range_finite (f : Hom R C M N) [Module.Finite R M] :
    Module.Finite R (range (R := R) (C := C) f).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.mem_range
decls.statement:
theorem mem_range {f : Hom R C M N} {n : N} :
    n ∈ range (R := R) (C := C) f ↔ ∃ m, f m = n

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.mem_range_self
decls.doc: A comodule morphism lands in its image subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_range_self (f : Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    f m ∈ range (R := R) (C := C) f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range_le_iff
decls.doc:
The range of a comodule morphism is contained in `P` exactly when each value of the
morphism belongs to `P`.
decls.statement:
theorem range_le_iff {f : Hom R C M N} {P : Subcomodule R C N} :
    range (R := R) (C := C) f ≤ P ↔ ∀ m, f m ∈ P

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ker_rangeRestrict_mkQ_comp
decls.statement:
theorem ker_rangeRestrict_mkQ_comp {M₁ : Type w} {N₁ : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module R M₁] [AddCommGroup N₁] [Module R N₁]
    (B : Submodule R N₁) (f : M₁ →ₗ[R] N₁) :
    LinearMap.ker (B.mkQ.comp f).rangeRestrict = B.comap f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.rTensor_rangeRestrict_eq_zero_of_rTensor_eq_zero
TauCeti.Subcomodule.tensor_mem_range_comap
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_mem_range_comap {M₁ : Type w} {N₁ : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module R M₁] [AddCommGroup N₁] [Module R N₁]
    (B : Submodule R N₁) (f : M₁ →ₗ[R] N₁)
    {t : M₁ ⊗[R] C} (h : LinearMap.rTensor C (B.mkQ.comp f) t = 0) :
    t ∈ LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.map (B.comap f).subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem_range_comap_toLinearMap
decls.statement:
theorem coact_mem_range_comap_toLinearMap
    (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (B : Subcomodule R C N)
    {m : M} (hm : m ∈ B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap).subtype
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_coact_mem
decls.statement:
theorem comap_coact_mem (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (B : Subcomodule R C N)
    {m : M} (hm : m ∈ B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap).subtype
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap
decls.doc: The inverse image of a subcomodule under a comodule morphism.
decls.statement: def comap (B : Subcomodule R C N) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) : Subcomodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of an inverse-image subcomodule is the inverse image of the
underlying submodule.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_toSubmodule (B : Subcomodule R C N) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    (B.comap f).toSubmodule = B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_finite
decls.doc:
The inverse image of a subcomodule into a noetherian module is finitely generated as an
`R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_finite (B : Subcomodule R C N) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N)
    [IsNoetherian R M] : Module.Finite R (B.comap f).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_comap
decls.doc: Membership in an inverse-image subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_comap {B : Subcomodule R C N} {f : Comodule.Hom R C M N} {m : M} :
    m ∈ B.comap f ↔ f m ∈ B

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_mono
decls.doc: The inverse-image construction is monotone in the target subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_mono (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) {B D : Subcomodule R C N} (hBD : B ≤ D) :
    B.comap f ≤ D.comap f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_top
decls.doc: The inverse image of the top subcomodule is top.
decls.statement: theorem comap_top (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) : (⊤ : Subcomodule R C N).comap f = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_bot_toSubmodule
decls.doc: The underlying submodule of the inverse image of the bottom subcomodule is the kernel.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_bot_toSubmodule (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    ((⊥ : Subcomodule R C N).comap f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_le_iff_le_comap
decls.doc: Images are left adjoint to inverse images for subcomodules.

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.gc_map_comap
decls.doc: The image construction is left adjoint to inverse image for subcomodules.
decls.statement:
theorem gc_map_comap (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    GaloisConnection
      (fun A : Subcomodule R C M => A.map f)
      (fun B : Subcomodule R C N => B.comap f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.le_comap_map
decls.doc: A subcomodule is contained in the inverse image of its image.
decls.statement:
theorem le_comap_map (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    A ≤ (A.map f).comap f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.le_comap_map_of_le
decls.doc: A subcomodule is contained in the inverse image of the image of a larger subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem le_comap_map_of_le {A D : Subcomodule R C M} (hAD : A ≤ D)
    (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    A ≤ (D.map f).comap f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_comap_le
decls.doc: The image of the inverse image of a subcomodule is contained in the subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem map_comap_le (B : Subcomodule R C N) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    (B.comap f).map f ≤ B

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_comap
decls.doc: Inverse images compose contravariantly with comodule morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_comap {P : Type y} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (B : Subcomodule R C P) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (g : Comodule.Hom R C N P) :
    (B.comap g).comap f = B.comap (g.comp f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.comap_id
decls.doc: The inverse image along the identity comodule morphism is the original subcomodule.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_id (B : Subcomodule R C M) :
    B.comap (Comodule.Hom.id R C M) = B

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ker
decls.doc: The kernel of a comodule morphism as a subcomodule of the domain.
decls.statement: def ker (f : Hom R C M N) : Subcomodule R C M

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ker_toSubmodule
decls.doc: The underlying submodule of the kernel subcomodule is the linear-map kernel.
decls.statement:
theorem ker_toSubmodule (f : Hom R C M N) :
    (ker (R := R) (C := C) f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ker_finite
decls.doc:
The kernel of a comodule morphism out of a noetherian module is finitely generated as an
`R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem ker_finite (f : Hom R C M N) [IsNoetherian R M] :
    Module.Finite R (ker (R := R) (C := C) f).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.mem_ker
decls.doc: Membership in the kernel subcomodule is vanishing under the morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_ker {f : Hom R C M N} {m : M} :
    m ∈ ker (R := R) (C := C) f ↔ f m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_mem_ker
decls.doc: The kernel subcomodule contains zero.
decls.statement: theorem zero_mem_ker (f : Hom R C M N) : (0 : M) ∈ ker (R := R) (C := C) f

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.le_ker_iff
decls.doc: A subcomodule is contained in the kernel exactly when the morphism vanishes on it.
decls.statement:
theorem le_ker_iff {f : Hom R C M N} {A : Subcomodule R C M} :
    A ≤ ker (R := R) (C := C) f ↔ ∀ ⦃m⦄, m ∈ A → f m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.mem_ker_of_apply_eq_zero
decls.doc: An element whose image under a comodule morphism is zero belongs to its kernel.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_ker_of_apply_eq_zero {f : Hom R C M N} {m : M} (hm : f m = 0) :
    m ∈ ker (R := R) (C := C) f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_rTensor_injective
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_rTensor_injective :
    Function.Injective ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem_range
decls.doc:
The ambient coaction of an element of a subcomodule lies in the range of the tensored
inclusion `N ⊗ C → M ⊗ C`.
decls.statement:
theorem coact_mem_range (n : N) :
    ((Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).comp (SMulMemClass.subtype N)) n ∈
      LinearMap.range ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.inducedCoact
decls.doc:
The coaction induced on the subtype of a subcomodule.

It is the unique lift of the ambient coaction along `N ⊗ C → M ⊗ C`.
decls.statement: def inducedCoact : N →ₗ[R] N ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_rTensor_inducedCoact
decls.doc: The induced coaction, included back into `M ⊗ C`, is the ambient coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_rTensor_inducedCoact (n : N) :
    (SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C (N.inducedCoact n) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) n

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_rTensor_comp_inducedCoact
decls.doc: The induced coaction included into the ambient tensor product, as an equality of linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_rTensor_comp_inducedCoact :
    (SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C ∘ₗ N.inducedCoact =
      (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).comp (SMulMemClass.subtype N)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_rTensor_tensor_injective
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_rTensor_tensor_injective :
    Function.Injective (((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C).rTensor C)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_rTensor_R_injective
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_rTensor_R_injective :
    Function.Injective ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor R)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_rTensor_inducedCoact
decls.statement:
theorem map_rTensor_inducedCoact (t : N ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C) (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
        (TensorProduct.map N.inducedCoact (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) t) =
      TensorProduct.map (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M))
        (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
        (TensorProduct.map (SMulMemClass.subtype N) (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.assoc_symm_tmul_natural
decls.statement:
theorem assoc_symm_tmul_natural (n : N) (z : C ⊗[R] C) :
    (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (SMulMemClass.subtype N n ⊗ₜ[R] z) =
      ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C).rTensor C
        ((TensorProduct.assoc R N C C).symm (n ⊗ₜ[R] z))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.assoc_symm_lTensor_comul_natural
decls.statement:
theorem assoc_symm_lTensor_comul_natural (t : N ⊗[R] C) :
    (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm
        (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C t)) =
      ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C).rTensor C
        ((TensorProduct.assoc R N C C).symm (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor N t))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.lTensor_counit_natural
decls.statement:
theorem lTensor_counit_natural (t : N ⊗[R] C) :
    (SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor R (Coalgebra.counit.lTensor N t) =
      Coalgebra.counit.lTensor M ((SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C t)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instComodule
decls.doc: The subtype of a subcomodule carries the inherited right-comodule structure.
decls.statement: instance instComodule : Comodule R C N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.induced_coact
decls.doc: The inherited coaction on a subcomodule is `Subcomodule.inducedCoact`.
decls.statement:
theorem induced_coact :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) = N.inducedCoact

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_rTensor_coact
decls.doc: The inherited coaction, included back into `M ⊗ C`, is the ambient coaction.
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_rTensor_coact (n : N) :
    (SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) n) =
      Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) n

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype
decls.doc: The subtype map of a subcomodule as a morphism of right comodules.
decls.statement: def subtype : Comodule.Hom R C N M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the subcomodule inclusion is the linear inclusion.
decls.statement:
theorem subtype_toLinearMap :
    (Subcomodule.subtype N).toLinearMap = SMulMemClass.subtype N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.subtype_apply
decls.doc: The subcomodule inclusion acts as the underlying subtype coercion.
decls.statement: theorem subtype_apply (n : N) : Subcomodule.subtype N n = n

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.tensor_range_mono
decls.statement:
lemma tensor_range_mono {P Q : Submodule R M} (hPQ : P ≤ Q) :
    LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map P.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)) ≤
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map Q.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem_sup
decls.statement:
lemma coact_mem_sup (N P : Subcomodule R C M) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule).subtype
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem_sSup
decls.statement:
lemma coact_mem_sSup (S : Set (Subcomodule R C M)) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ ⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule).subtype
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instMax
decls.doc:
The join of two subcomodules has underlying submodule the join of the underlying
submodules.
decls.statement: instance instMax : Max (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instSupSet
decls.doc:
The supremum of a set of subcomodules has underlying submodule the supremum of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement: instance instSupSet : SupSet (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.sup_toSubmodule
decls.doc: The underlying submodule of the join is the join of the underlying submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem sup_toSubmodule (N P : Subcomodule R C M) :
    (N ⊔ P).toSubmodule = N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_sup
decls.doc: Membership in the join of two subcomodules.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sup {N P : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} :
    m ∈ N ⊔ P ↔ ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p ∈ P, n + p = m

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instSemilatticeSup
decls.doc:
Subcomodules form a semilattice under the join whose carrier is the supremum of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement: instance instSemilatticeSup : SemilatticeSup (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.sSup_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of a supremum of a set of subcomodules is the supremum of the
underlying submodules indexed by that set.
decls.statement:
theorem sSup_toSubmodule (S : Set (Subcomodule R C M)) :
    (sSup S).toSubmodule = ⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_sSup
decls.doc: Membership in the supremum of a set of subcomodules.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (Subcomodule R C M)} {m : M} :
    m ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ M, (∀ N : S, f N ∈ (N : Subcomodule R C M)) ∧
        f.sum (fun _ x => x) = m

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.iSup_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of a supremum of subcomodules is the supremum of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem iSup_toSubmodule {ι : Sort*} (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (⨆ i, N i).toSubmodule = ⨆ i, (N i).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_iSup
decls.doc: Membership in the supremum of a family of subcomodules.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {N : ι → Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} :
    m ∈ ⨆ i, N i ↔
      ∃ f : ι →₀ M, (∀ i, f i ∈ N i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ x => x) = m

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instCompleteSemilatticeSup
decls.doc: Subcomodules have arbitrary suprema, computed on underlying submodules.
decls.statement: instance instCompleteSemilatticeSup : CompleteSemilatticeSup (Subcomodule R C M)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.sup_finite
decls.doc: The join of finitely generated subcomodules is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem sup_finite (N P : Subcomodule R C M)
    [Module.Finite R N.toSubmodule] [Module.Finite R P.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R (N ⊔ P).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instFiniteSup
decls.doc: The join of finitely generated subcomodules is finitely generated as an `R`-module.
decls.statement:
instance instFiniteSup (N P : Subcomodule R C M)
    [Module.Finite R N.toSubmodule] [Module.Finite R P.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R (N ⊔ P).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.finset_sup_toSubmodule
decls.doc:
The underlying submodule of a finite join of subcomodules is the finite join of the
underlying submodules.
decls.statement:
theorem finset_sup_toSubmodule (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (s.sup N).toSubmodule = s.sup fun i => (N i).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_finset_sup
decls.doc: Membership in a finite join of subcomodules.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_finset_sup {s : Finset ι} {N : ι → Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} :
    m ∈ s.sup N ↔ ∃ μ : ∀ i, (N i).toSubmodule, (∑ i ∈ s, (μ i : M)) = m

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.iSup_finite
decls.doc:
A finite supremum of finitely generated subcomodules is finitely generated as an
`R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem iSup_finite {ι : Sort*} [Finite ι] (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M)
    (hN : ∀ i, Module.Finite R (N i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (⨆ i, N i).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.finset_sup_finite
decls.doc:
A finite join of finitely generated subcomodules is finitely generated as an
`R`-module.
decls.statement:
theorem finset_sup_finite (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M)
    (hN : ∀ i ∈ s, Module.Finite R (N i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (s.sup N).toSubmodule

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_sup
decls.doc: The image of a binary join is the binary join of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem map_sup (f : Comodule.Hom R C M M') (N P : Subcomodule R C M) :
    (N ⊔ P).map f = N.map f ⊔ P.map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_iSup
decls.doc: The image of a supremum is the supremum of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem map_iSup {ι : Sort*} (f : Comodule.Hom R C M M') (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (⨆ i, N i).map f = ⨆ i, (N i).map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_finset_sup
decls.doc: The image of a finite join is the finite join of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem map_finset_sup (s : Finset ι) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M M')
    (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (s.sup N).map f = s.sup fun i => (N i).map f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.le_ker_tensorProduct_mkQ_comp_coact
decls.statement:
theorem le_ker_tensorProduct_mkQ_comp_coact :
    N.toSubmodule ≤
      LinearMap.ker
        ((TensorProduct.map N.toSubmodule.mkQ (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)).comp
          (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.quotientCoact
decls.doc: The coaction induced on the quotient by a subcomodule.
decls.statement: def quotientCoact : M ⧸ N.toSubmodule →ₗ[R] (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule) ⊗[R] C

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.quotientCoact_mk
decls.doc: The quotient coaction applied to a quotient class.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientCoact_mk (m : M) :
    N.quotientCoact (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) =
      TensorProduct.map N.toSubmodule.mkQ (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
        (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.quotientCoact_comp_mkQ
decls.doc: The descended quotient coaction is characterized after precomposition with the quotient map.
decls.statement:
theorem quotientCoact_comp_mkQ :
    N.quotientCoact.comp N.toSubmodule.mkQ =
      (TensorProduct.map N.toSubmodule.mkQ (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)).comp
        (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.tensor_assoc_quotient_coact
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_assoc_quotient_coact (m : M) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule) C C
        (TensorProduct.map
          ((TensorProduct.map N.toSubmodule.mkQ (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)).comp
            (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)))
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
          (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule)
        (TensorProduct.map N.toSubmodule.mkQ (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)
          (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.instComoduleQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient of a right comodule by a subcomodule inherits a right-comodule structure.
decls.statement: instance instComoduleQuotient : Comodule R C (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.quotient_coact
decls.doc: The coaction on the quotient comodule is `Subcomodule.quotientCoact`.
decls.statement:
theorem quotient_coact :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⧸ N.toSubmodule) = N.quotientCoact

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mkQ
decls.doc: The quotient map by a subcomodule as a comodule morphism.
decls.statement: def mkQ : Comodule.Hom R C M (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mkQ_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the quotient comodule morphism is the quotient map.
decls.statement: theorem mkQ_toLinearMap : N.mkQ.toLinearMap = N.toSubmodule.mkQ

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mkQ_apply
decls.doc: The quotient comodule morphism sends a vector to its quotient class.
decls.statement: theorem mkQ_apply (m : M) : N.mkQ m = Submodule.Quotient.mk m

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: The quotient comodule morphism sends exactly the subcomodule to zero.
decls.statement: theorem mkQ_eq_zero_iff (m : M) : N.mkQ m = 0 ↔ m ∈ N

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mkQ_surjective
decls.doc: The quotient comodule morphism is surjective.
decls.statement: theorem mkQ_surjective : Function.Surjective N.mkQ

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.liftQ
decls.doc: A comodule morphism out of `M` that vanishes on `N` descends to the quotient by `N`.
decls.statement:
def liftQ (f : Comodule.Hom R C M P) (hf : N.toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap) :
    Comodule.Hom R C (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule) P

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.liftQ_apply
decls.doc: The descended quotient morphism applied to a quotient class.
decls.statement:
theorem liftQ_apply (f : Comodule.Hom R C M P)
    (hf : N.toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap) (m : M) :
    N.liftQ f hf (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = f m

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.liftQ_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map of the descended quotient morphism is the quotient-module lift.
decls.statement:
theorem liftQ_toLinearMap (f : Comodule.Hom R C M P)
    (hf : N.toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap) :
    (N.liftQ f hf).toLinearMap =
      letI : AddCommGroup P

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.liftQ_mkQ
decls.doc:
Precomposing the descended quotient morphism with the quotient map recovers the original
morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem liftQ_mkQ (f : Comodule.Hom R C M P)
    (hf : N.toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap) :
    (N.liftQ f hf).comp N.mkQ = f

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.hom_ext
decls.doc:
Two morphisms out of a quotient are equal if they agree after precomposition with the
quotient map.
decls.statement:
theorem hom_ext {f g : Comodule.Hom R C (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule) P}
    (h : f.comp N.mkQ = g.comp N.mkQ) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.liftQ_unique
decls.doc: Uniqueness of the morphism descended to a quotient.
decls.statement:
theorem liftQ_unique (f : Comodule.Hom R C M P)
    (hf : N.toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap)
    (g : Comodule.Hom R C (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule) P) (hg : g.comp N.mkQ = f) :
    g = N.liftQ f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ker_mkQ
decls.doc: The kernel of the quotient comodule morphism is the subcomodule being quotiented.
decls.statement: theorem ker_mkQ : Comodule.Hom.ker (R := R) (C := C) N.mkQ = N

decls.name: TauCeti.ElementaryTwoQuotient
decls.doc:
**The maximal elementary-2 quotient `G / G²`** of a commutative group, written additively on
`Additive G`.
decls.title: The maximal elementary-2 quotient `G / G²`
decls.statement: abbrev ElementaryTwoQuotient : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.instFiniteElementaryTwoQuotient
decls.statement: instance [Finite G] : Finite (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMkAdd
decls.doc: The quotient homomorphism `Additive G →+ G/G²`, exposed in the `ModN` additive form.
decls.statement: def elementaryTwoQuotientMkAdd : Additive G →+ ElementaryTwoQuotient G

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk
decls.doc: The class of an element of `G` in the maximal elementary-2 quotient `G / G²`.
decls.statement: def elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g : G) : ElementaryTwoQuotient G

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_mkQ
decls.doc:
The class map `G → G/G²` is the quotient map of the `ModN` model: the class of `g` is the image
of `Additive.ofMul g` under the quotient by the doubling submodule. This exposes the `ModN`
representative so downstream files can match `G/G²` against Mathlib's quotient-by-range API.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_mkQ (g : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk g = Submodule.Quotient.mk (Additive.ofMul g)

decls.name: TauCeti.mem_range_lsmul_two_iff
decls.doc:
An element of `Additive G` lies in the doubling submodule `range (lsmul ℤ _ 2)` iff its
multiplicative form is a square. This is the shared core relating the `ModN`/`lsmul` model of the
quotient to the multiplicative subgroup of squares, used both by the zero-characterization and by
the subgroup identification, and is kept private to the file.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_range_lsmul_two_iff (a : Additive G) :
    a ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ (Additive G) ↑(2 : ℕ)) ↔
      IsSquare (Additive.toMul a)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: An element has trivial class in `G / G²` iff it is a square.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff (g : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk g = 0 ↔ IsSquare g

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientLiftEquiv
decls.doc:
The universal property of `G/G²` for additive homomorphisms: maps out of the quotient are
additive homomorphisms from `Additive G` whose values are killed by `2`.

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientLinearLiftEquiv
decls.doc:
The universal property of `G/G²` for `ZMod 2`-linear maps: linear maps out of the quotient are
additive homomorphisms from `Additive G` whose values are killed by `2`.

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_mul
decls.doc: The class map to `G / G²` sends a product to the sum of the classes.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_mul (g h : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g * h) = elementaryTwoQuotientMk g + elementaryTwoQuotientMk h

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_one
decls.doc: The class map to `G / G²` sends `1` to `0`.
decls.statement: theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_one : elementaryTwoQuotientMk (1 : G) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_inv
decls.doc: The class map to `G / G²` sends inverses to negatives.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_inv (g : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk g⁻¹ = -elementaryTwoQuotientMk g

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_div
decls.doc: The class map to `G / G²` sends quotients to differences.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_div (g h : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g / h) = elementaryTwoQuotientMk g - elementaryTwoQuotientMk h

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_pow
decls.doc: The class map to `G / G²` sends powers to scalar multiples.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_pow (g : G) (n : ℕ) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g ^ n) = n • elementaryTwoQuotientMk g

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_prod
decls.doc: The class map to `G / G²` sends a finite product to the sum of the classes.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_prod {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (g : ι → G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk (∏ i ∈ S, g i) = ∑ i ∈ S, elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g i)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_surjective
decls.doc: Every element of `G / G²` is the class of some element of `G`.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (elementaryTwoQuotientMk : G → ElementaryTwoQuotient G)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_iff
decls.doc: Two elements have the same class in `G / G²` iff they differ by a square.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_iff (g h : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk g = elementaryTwoQuotientMk h ↔ IsSquare (g / h)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMap
decls.doc:
A homomorphism of commutative groups induces a `ZMod 2`-linear map on maximal elementary-2
quotients.
decls.statement:
def elementaryTwoQuotientMap (f : G →* H) :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient G →ₗ[ZMod 2] ElementaryTwoQuotient H

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMap_mk
decls.doc: The induced map on `G/G²` sends the class of `g` to the class of `f g`.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMap_mk (f : G →* H) (g : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMap f (elementaryTwoQuotientMk g) =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMk (f g)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMap_id_apply
decls.doc: The map induced by the identity homomorphism fixes each class in the elementary-2 quotient.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMap_id_apply (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMap (MonoidHom.id G) x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMap_apply_eq_self_of_isSquare_div
decls.doc:
A group endomorphism induces the identity on the maximal elementary-2 quotient if it sends
each element to the same square class.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMap_apply_eq_self_of_isSquare_div (f : G →* G)
    (hf : ∀ g, IsSquare (f g / g)) (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMap f x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMap_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_inv
decls.doc:
A group endomorphism that acts pointwise by inversion induces the identity on the maximal
elementary-2 quotient. This is the abstract step used when quadratic conjugation acts on an ideal
class group by inversion.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMap_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_inv (f : G →* G)
    (hf : ∀ g, f g = g⁻¹) (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMap f x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMap_comp_apply
decls.doc: Induced maps on elementary-2 quotients compose pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMap_comp_apply (f : G →* H) (g : H →* K)
    (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMap (g.comp f) x =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMap g (elementaryTwoQuotientMap f x)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr
decls.doc:
A multiplicative equivalence of commutative groups induces a `ZMod 2`-linear equivalence of
their maximal elementary-2 quotients.
decls.statement:
def elementaryTwoQuotientCongr (e : G ≃* H) :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient G ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] ElementaryTwoQuotient H

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_mk
decls.doc: The induced equivalence on `G/G²` sends the class of `g` to the class of `e g`.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_mk (e : G ≃* H) (g : G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e (elementaryTwoQuotientMk g) = elementaryTwoQuotientMk (e g)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_symm_mk
decls.doc: The inverse induced equivalence on `G/G²` sends the class of `h` to the class of `e.symm h`.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_symm_mk (e : G ≃* H) (h : H) :
    (elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e).symm (elementaryTwoQuotientMk h) =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMk (e.symm h)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_refl_apply
decls.doc: The identity equivalence induces the identity equivalence on the elementary-2 quotient.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_refl_apply (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr (MulEquiv.refl G) x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_trans_apply
decls.doc: Induced equivalences on elementary-2 quotients compose functorially.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_trans_apply (e : G ≃* H) (e' : H ≃* K)
    (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr (e.trans e') x =
      elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e' (elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e x)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_inv
decls.doc:
A multiplicative automorphism that acts pointwise by inversion induces the identity on the
maximal elementary-2 quotient. In genus theory this applies to the action of quadratic
conjugation on `Cl(K)/Cl(K)²`.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_inv (e : G ≃* G)
    (he : ∀ g, e g = g⁻¹) (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient G) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.range_lsmul_two_toAddSubgroup_eq_square_toAddSubgroup
decls.doc:
The doubling subgroup of `Additive G` is the additive form of the subgroup of squares of `G`.
This is the implementation detail relating the `ModN`/`lsmul` model of the quotient to the
multiplicative subgroup of squares, and is kept private to the file.
decls.statement:
theorem range_lsmul_two_toAddSubgroup_eq_square_toAddSubgroup :
    (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ (Additive G) ↑(2 : ℕ))).toAddSubgroup =
      (Subgroup.square G).toAddSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientEquivSquareQuotient
decls.doc:
Mathlib's `ModN (Additive G) 2` model of `G/G²` agrees with the direct quotient by the
additive form of the square subgroup.
decls.statement:
def elementaryTwoQuotientEquivSquareQuotient :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient G ≃+ Additive G ⧸ (Subgroup.square G).toAddSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_index_square
decls.doc: The cardinality of `G/G²` is the index of the subgroup of squares.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_index_square :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = (Subgroup.square G).index

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_card_twoTorsion
decls.doc:
**The maximal elementary-2 quotient and the 2-torsion subgroup have the same cardinality.**
`|G/G²| = |{g | g² = 1}|`. The squaring endomorphism `g ↦ g²` has range `G²` and kernel the
2-torsion; when its kernel has finite index, the index of the range equals the cardinality of the
kernel.
decls.title: The maximal elementary-2 quotient and the 2-torsion subgroup have the same cardinality

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank
decls.doc:
**The 2-rank of a commutative group**: the `ZMod 2`-dimension of the maximal elementary-2
quotient `G / G²` (zero, by convention of `Module.finrank`, when the quotient is
infinite-dimensional).
decls.title: The 2-rank of a commutative group
decls.statement: def twoRank : ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_def
decls.doc: The 2-rank of `G` is the `ZMod 2` dimension of its maximal elementary-2 quotient `G / G²`.
decls.statement:
theorem twoRank_def :
    twoRank G = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank
decls.doc:
The maximal elementary-2 quotient has cardinality `2 ^ twoRank`: it is a finite `𝔽₂`-vector
space of dimension the 2-rank.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank
    [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)] :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 2 ^ twoRank G

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_eq_of_card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow
decls.doc:
Reading the 2-rank off a cardinality computation: if `G/G²` has `2 ^ n` elements, the 2-rank
of `G` is `n`. This is the inversion of
`TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank` used to convert each concrete counting
result into its rank form. The hypothesis already forces `G/G²` to be a finite `ZMod 2`-module,
so no finiteness instance need be supplied.
decls.statement:
theorem twoRank_eq_of_card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow
    {n : ℕ} (h : Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 2 ^ n) : twoRank G = n

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_odd_card
decls.doc:
**A group of odd order has a single square class.** For a finite commutative group of odd
order, squaring is bijective (the exponent `2` is coprime to `|G|`), so `G/G²` is trivial. This
is the odd-order half of the 2-rank computation — the even case genuinely needs more structure
(a cyclic factor); this half holds for any commutative group.
decls.title: A group of odd order has a single square class
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_odd_card (h : Odd (Nat.card G)) :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_of_odd_card
decls.doc: A group of odd order has 2-rank zero.
decls.statement: theorem twoRank_of_odd_card (h : Odd (Nat.card G)) : twoRank G = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_dvd_card
decls.doc:
The cardinality of the maximal elementary-2 quotient of a commutative group divides the group
cardinality.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_dvd_card :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) ∣ Nat.card G

decls.name: TauCeti.two_pow_twoRank_dvd_card
decls.doc:
Rank form of `TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_dvd_card`: when `G / G²` is a finite
`ZMod 2`-vector space, `2 ^ TauCeti.twoRank G` divides `|G|`.
decls.statement:
theorem two_pow_twoRank_dvd_card [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)] :
    2 ^ twoRank G ∣ Nat.card G

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_le_card
decls.doc:
The maximal elementary-2 quotient of a finite commutative group has cardinality at most the
group cardinality.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_le_card :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) ≤ Nat.card G

decls.name: TauCeti.two_pow_twoRank_le_card
decls.doc:
Rank form of `TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_le_card`: for a finite commutative group
`G`, `2 ^ TauCeti.twoRank G` is at most `|G|`.
decls.statement:
theorem two_pow_twoRank_le_card :
    2 ^ twoRank G ≤ Nat.card G

decls.name: TauCeti.finrank_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_of_mulEquiv
decls.doc:
Multiplicatively equivalent commutative groups have elementary-2 quotients with the same
`ZMod 2` finrank.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_of_mulEquiv (e : G ≃* H) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient H)

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_eq_of_mulEquiv
decls.doc: Multiplicatively equivalent commutative groups have the same elementary-2 rank.
decls.statement: theorem twoRank_eq_of_mulEquiv (e : G ≃* H) : twoRank G = twoRank H

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_isCyclic
decls.doc:
**The elementary-2 quotient of a cyclic group has `gcd |G| 2` elements.** For the finite case
the subgroup of squares has index `gcd |G| 2` (Mathlib's `IsCyclic.index_powMonoidHom_range`, read
through `G² = range (powMonoidHom 2)`); the infinite case is `G ≃* Multiplicative ℤ`, whose
elementary-2 quotient is `2 ^ finrank ℤ ℤ = 2 = gcd 0 2`.
decls.title: The elementary-2 quotient of a cyclic group has `gcd |G| 2` elements
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_isCyclic :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = (Nat.card G).gcd 2

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_isCyclic_of_even
decls.doc: A cyclic group of even order has exactly two square classes.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_isCyclic_of_even (h : Even (Nat.card G)) :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_of_isCyclic_of_even
decls.doc: A cyclic group of even order has 2-rank one.
decls.statement: theorem twoRank_of_isCyclic_of_even (h : Even (Nat.card G)) : twoRank G = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.map_range_lsmul_two_additiveMultiplicative
decls.doc:
The doubling submodule of `Additive (Multiplicative A)` corresponds to the doubling submodule
of `A` under the canonical identification, the compatibility fact needed to transport the `ModN`
model of the elementary-2 quotient. Kept private to the file.
decls.statement:
theorem map_range_lsmul_two_additiveMultiplicative :
    (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ (Additive (Multiplicative A)) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))).map
        ((AddEquiv.additiveMultiplicative A).toIntLinearEquiv :
          Additive (Multiplicative A) →ₗ[ℤ] A) =
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ A ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_multiplicative
decls.doc:
**A finite-rank free abelian group has `2 ^ rank` square classes.** For a free `ℤ`-module `A`
of finite rank, the maximal elementary-2 quotient of `Multiplicative A` has cardinality
`2 ^ finrank ℤ A`. This is Mathlib's `ModN.natCard_eq` transported along the identification of
`Additive (Multiplicative A)` with `A`.
decls.title: A finite-rank free abelian group has `2 ^ rank` square classes
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_multiplicative :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient (Multiplicative A)) = 2 ^ Module.finrank ℤ A

decls.name: TauCeti.instFiniteElementaryTwoQuotientMultiplicative
decls.doc:
The elementary-2 quotient of a finite-rank free abelian group is finite. The group is
infinite for positive rank, so the generic `Finite G → Finite (G/G²)` instance does not apply in
general; this instance lets consumers combine the free factor with the `twoRank`-level product and
divisibility lemmas.
decls.statement: instance : Finite (ElementaryTwoQuotient (Multiplicative A))

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_multiplicative
decls.doc:
The 2-rank of a finite-rank free abelian group is its rank:
`twoRank (Multiplicative A) = finrank ℤ A`.
decls.statement: theorem twoRank_multiplicative : twoRank (Multiplicative A) = Module.finrank ℤ A

decls.name: TauCeti.range_lsmul_two_toAddSubgroup_eq_range_nsmul
decls.doc:
The doubling submodule `range (lsmul ℤ _ 2)` of `Additive G`, whose quotient is the `ModN` model
of `G/G²`, is the range of the doubling monoid hom `nsmulAddMonoidHom 2` as an additive subgroup.
This is the identity that matches the `ModN` model against Mathlib's quotient-by-range API.
decls.statement:
theorem range_lsmul_two_toAddSubgroup_eq_range_nsmul (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] :
    (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ (Additive G) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))).toAddSubgroup =
      (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := Additive G) 2).range

decls.name: TauCeti.bridgeModRangeNSMul
decls.doc:
The `ModN` model `G/G²` as the quotient of `Additive G` by the range of the doubling monoid hom
`nsmulAddMonoidHom 2`, matching the shape of Mathlib's product-quotient equivalences.
decls.statement:
def bridgeModRangeNSMul (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient G ≃+ Additive G ⧸ (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := Additive G) 2).range

decls.name: TauCeti.range_lsmul_two_toAddSubgroup_prod_eq
decls.doc:
The doubling submodule of `Additive (G × H)` splits as the product of the doubling ranges of the
factors, matching the shape of `QuotientAddGroup.prodAddEquiv`.
decls.statement:
theorem range_lsmul_two_toAddSubgroup_prod_eq :
    (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ (Additive G × Additive H) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))).toAddSubgroup =
      (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := Additive G) 2).range.prod
        (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := Additive H) 2).range

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientProdAddEquiv
decls.doc:
The product equivalence as an additive equivalence, transported from
`QuotientAddGroup.prodAddEquiv` through the bridge to the `ModN` model on each factor.

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientProdAddEquiv_mk
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientProdAddEquiv_mk (p : G × H) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientProdAddEquiv G H (elementaryTwoQuotientMk p) =
      (elementaryTwoQuotientMk p.1, elementaryTwoQuotientMk p.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
**The elementary-2 quotient of a product is the product of the elementary-2 quotients.** For
commutative groups `G` and `H`, the class map identifies `(G × H)/(G × H)²` with `G/G² × H/H²`
`ZMod 2`-linearly. It is transported from Mathlib's `QuotientAddGroup.prodAddEquiv` through the
identification of the `ModN` model of the quotient with the quotient by the doubling range.
decls.title: The elementary-2 quotient of a product is the product of the elementary-2 quotients

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv_mk
decls.doc: The product equivalence sends the class of `(a, b)` to the pair of classes.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv_mk (G H : Type*) [CommGroup G] [CommGroup H]
    (p : G × H) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv G H (elementaryTwoQuotientMk p) =
      (elementaryTwoQuotientMk p.1, elementaryTwoQuotientMk p.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv_symm_mk
decls.doc: The inverse product equivalence sends a pair of classes to the class of the pair.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv_symm_mk (G H : Type*)
    [CommGroup G] [CommGroup H] (a : G) (b : H) :
    (elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv G H).symm
        (elementaryTwoQuotientMk a, elementaryTwoQuotientMk b) =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMk (a, b)

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_prod
decls.doc:
**The 2-rank is additive over products.** For commutative groups whose elementary-2 quotients
are finite-dimensional, `twoRank (G × H) = twoRank G + twoRank H`.
decls.title: The 2-rank is additive over products
decls.statement:
theorem twoRank_prod (G H : Type*) [CommGroup G] [CommGroup H]
    [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)]
    [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient H)] :
    twoRank (G × H) = twoRank G + twoRank H

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_prod
decls.doc:
The cardinality reading of `TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv`:
`|(G × H)/(G × H)²| = |G/G²| · |H/H²|`.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_prod (G H : Type*) [CommGroup G] [CommGroup H] :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient (G × H)) =
      Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) * Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient H)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientPiAddEquiv
decls.doc:
The indexed-product equivalence as an additive equivalence, transported from
`QuotientAddGroup.addEquivPiModRangeNSMulAddMonoidHom` through the bridge to the `ModN` model on
each factor.
decls.statement:
def elementaryTwoQuotientPiAddEquiv :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient (∀ i, G i) ≃+ ∀ i, ElementaryTwoQuotient (G i)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientPiAddEquiv_mk
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientPiAddEquiv_mk (g : ∀ i, G i) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientPiAddEquiv G (elementaryTwoQuotientMk g) =
      fun i => elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g i)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
**The elementary-2 quotient of an indexed product is the product of the elementary-2
quotients.** For a family of commutative groups `G i` over an arbitrary index, the class map
identifies `(∀ i, G i)/(…)²` with `∀ i, (G i)/(G i)²` `ZMod 2`-linearly. It is transported from
Mathlib's `QuotientAddGroup.addEquivPiModRangeNSMulAddMonoidHom` through the identification of the
`ModN` model of the quotient with the quotient by the doubling range.
decls.statement:
def elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient (∀ i, G i) ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] ∀ i, ElementaryTwoQuotient (G i)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv_mk
decls.doc:
The indexed-product equivalence sends the class of `g` to the family of componentwise
classes.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv_mk (g : ∀ i, G i) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv G (elementaryTwoQuotientMk g) =
      fun i => elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g i)

decls.name: TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse indexed-product equivalence sends a family of componentwise classes to the class
of the assembled family.
decls.statement:
theorem elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv_symm_mk (g : ∀ i, G i) :
    (elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv G).symm (fun i => elementaryTwoQuotientMk (g i)) =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMk g

decls.name: TauCeti.twoRank_pi
decls.doc:
**The 2-rank is additive over finite indexed products.** For a finite family of commutative
groups whose elementary-2 quotients are finite-dimensional,
`twoRank (∀ i, G i) = ∑ i, twoRank (G i)`.
decls.title: The 2-rank is additive over finite indexed products
decls.statement:
theorem twoRank_pi [Fintype ι] [∀ i, Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient (G i))] :
    twoRank (∀ i, G i) = ∑ i, twoRank (G i)

decls.name: TauCeti.card_elementaryTwoQuotient_pi
decls.doc:
The cardinality reading of `TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv`:
`|(∀ i, G i)/(…)²| = ∏ i, |(G i)/(G i)²|`.
decls.statement:
theorem card_elementaryTwoQuotient_pi [Fintype ι] :
    Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient (∀ i, G i)) =
      ∏ i, Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient (G i))

decls.name: TauCeti.freeAbelianCharEquiv
decls.doc:
The universal property of the free abelian group `Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ)`: a homomorphism
to a commutative group `M` is the same data as a family `σ → M`. The forward map reads off the
values on the standard generators `ofAdd (single i 1)`; the inverse extends a family to the
unique homomorphism through `Finsupp.liftAddHom` and the `ℤ`-power homomorphism.
decls.statement:
def freeAbelianCharEquiv :
    (Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ) →* M) ≃* (σ → M)

decls.name: TauCeti.freeAbelianCharEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The forward direction of `freeAbelianCharEquiv` evaluates a character on the standard
generator indexed by `i`.
decls.statement:
theorem freeAbelianCharEquiv_apply (χ : Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ) →* M) (i : σ) :
    freeAbelianCharEquiv χ i = χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (Finsupp.single i 1))

decls.name: TauCeti.freeAbelianCharEquiv_symm_apply_ofAdd_single
decls.doc:
The inverse of `freeAbelianCharEquiv` sends the standard generator indexed by `i` to the
chosen coordinate `c i`.
decls.statement:
theorem freeAbelianCharEquiv_symm_apply_ofAdd_single (c : σ → M) (i : σ) :
    (freeAbelianCharEquiv (M := M)).symm c (Multiplicative.ofAdd (Finsupp.single i 1)) = c i

decls.name: TauCeti.freeAbelianCharEquiv_symm_apply_ofAdd
decls.doc:
The inverse of `freeAbelianCharEquiv` evaluates an arbitrary finitely supported integer
combination as the corresponding product of powers of the chosen coordinates.
decls.statement:
theorem freeAbelianCharEquiv_symm_apply_ofAdd (c : σ → M) (m : σ →₀ ℤ) :
    (freeAbelianCharEquiv (M := M)).symm c (Multiplicative.ofAdd m) =
      m.prod fun i n => c i ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.freeAbelianCharEquiv_comp
decls.doc:
Reading off generator values is natural in the target group: post-composing with a
homomorphism `ψ : M →* N` commutes with `freeAbelianCharEquiv`.
decls.statement:
theorem freeAbelianCharEquiv_comp {N : Type*} [CommGroup N] (ψ : M →* N)
    (χ : Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ) →* M) (i : σ) :
    freeAbelianCharEquiv (ψ.comp χ) i = ψ (freeAbelianCharEquiv χ i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotient
decls.doc:
The normalizer quotient `N(H) / H` of a subgroup `H ≤ G`. Here `H` is viewed as a normal
subgroup of its normalizer, using Mathlib's `Subgroup.normal_in_normalizer` instance.
decls.statement: abbrev normalizerQuotient (H : Subgroup G) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
decls.doc: The canonical quotient map from the normalizer of `H` to `N(H) / H`.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientMk (H : Subgroup G) :
    _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* normalizerQuotient H

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_apply
decls.doc: The canonical quotient map evaluates as the quotient-group constructor.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_apply (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = (g : normalizerQuotient H)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A normalizer element maps to the identity in `N(H) / H` exactly when its underlying
element of `G` lies in `H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_eq_one_iff (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = 1 ↔ (g : G) ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_ker
decls.doc:
The kernel of the quotient map `N(H) →* N(H) / H` is the copy of `H` inside its
normalizer.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_ker (H : Subgroup G) :
    (normalizerQuotientMk H).ker =
      H.subgroupOf (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_surjective
decls.doc: Every element of `N(H) / H` is represented by an element of the normalizer.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_surjective (H : Subgroup G) :
    Function.Surjective (normalizerQuotientMk H)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_range
decls.doc: The canonical map `N(H) →* N(H) / H` has full range.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_range (H : Subgroup G) :
    (normalizerQuotientMk H).range = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift
decls.doc:
The universal property of `N(H) / H`: a homomorphism from the normalizer that sends every
ambient element of `H` to `1` descends to a homomorphism from the normalizer quotient.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientLift (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1) :
    normalizerQuotient H →* M

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_mk
decls.doc: The lift from `N(H) / H` evaluates on representatives as the original homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_mk (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ (normalizerQuotientMk H g) = φ g

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_comp_mk
decls.doc:
The lift from `N(H) / H`, composed with the quotient map, is the original homomorphism
from the normalizer.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_comp_mk (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1) :
    (normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ).comp (normalizerQuotientMk H) = φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_surjective_of_surjective
decls.doc:
A lift from `N(H) / H` is surjective when the original homomorphism from the normalizer is
surjective.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_surjective_of_surjective (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1)
    (hφsurj : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Function.Surjective (normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_injective_iff
decls.doc:
A lift from `N(H) / H` is injective exactly when the only normalizer elements killed by
the original homomorphism are the elements of `H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_injective_iff (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1) :
    Function.Injective (normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ) ↔
      ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), φ g = 1 ↔ (g : G) ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_div_mem
decls.doc:
The quotient equality criterion for representatives in the normalizer, stated in the
ambient group `G`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_div_mem (H : Subgroup G)
    (g k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = normalizerQuotientMk H k ↔ (g : G) / (k : G) ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_exists_mul
decls.doc: A version of the equality criterion using multiplication by an element of `H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_exists_mul (H : Subgroup G)
    (g k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = normalizerQuotientMk H k ↔
      ∃ h ∈ H, h * (k : G) = g

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr
decls.doc:
Equal subgroups have canonically equivalent normalizer quotients, by transporting both the
normalizer and the distinguished subgroup inside it across the equality.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientCongr {H K : Subgroup G} (h : H = K) :
    normalizerQuotient H ≃* normalizerQuotient K

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr_mk
decls.doc:
The equal-subgroup congruence on normalizer quotients sends representatives to the
corresponding representatives under the normalizer congruence.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientCongr_mk {H K : Subgroup G} (h : H = K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientCongr h (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk K (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [h]) g)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse equal-subgroup congruence on normalizer quotients sends representatives to the
corresponding representatives under the inverse normalizer congruence.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientCongr_symm_mk {H K : Subgroup G} (h : H = K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (K : Set G)) :
    (normalizerQuotientCongr h).symm (normalizerQuotientMk K g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [h]) g)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal
decls.doc:
When `H` is normal in `G`, the normalizer quotient maps naturally to the ordinary quotient
`G / H` by forgetting that representatives lie in the normalizer.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal :
    normalizerQuotient H →* G ⧸ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal_mk
decls.doc:
The comparison map from `N(H) / H` to `G / H` sends a normalizer representative to its
ordinary quotient class.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal_mk
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal H (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' H (g : G)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal_comp_mk
decls.doc:
The ordinary quotient map `G →* G / H`, factored through the normalizer under normality,
agrees with the comparison map from `N(H) / H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal_comp_mk :
    (normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal H).comp (normalizerQuotientMk H) =
      (QuotientGroup.mk' H).comp (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)).subtype

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal
decls.doc:
If `H` is normal in `G`, then `N(H) / H` is canonically isomorphic to `G / H`. This is
the algebraic form of the regular-cover specialization from `N(H) / H` to `π₁(X, x₀) / H`.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal :
    normalizerQuotient H ≃* G ⧸ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_mk
decls.doc:
The normal-case equivalence sends a normalizer representative to its ordinary quotient
class in `G / H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_mk
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal H (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' H (g : G)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse normal-case equivalence sends an ordinary quotient representative to the
corresponding representative in the normalizer quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_symm_mk (g : G) :
    (normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal H).symm (QuotientGroup.mk' H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H ⟨g, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap
decls.doc:
A group isomorphism identifies the normalizer of a subgroup with the normalizer of its
image.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerEquivMap (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) :
    _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) ≃*
      _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe
decls.doc: On underlying group elements, `normalizerEquivMap` is the given group isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    (normalizerEquivMap H e g : K) = e (g : G)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying group elements, the inverse of `normalizerEquivMap` is the inverse group
isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    ((normalizerEquivMap H e).symm k : G) = e.symm (k : K)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_refl
decls.doc:
Transporting normalizer representatives along the identity group isomorphism is the identity
on underlying representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerEquivMap_refl (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerEquivMap H (MulEquiv.refl G) g =
      ⟨(g : G), by simp [g.2]⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_trans_apply_coe
decls.doc:
Transporting a normalizer representative through two group isomorphisms has underlying value
`f (e g)`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerEquivMap_trans_apply_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) (f : K ≃* L)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f (normalizerEquivMap H e g) : L) =
      f (e (g : G))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe'
decls.doc:
Rephrasing the inverse of `normalizerEquivMap` as transport along the inverse group
isomorphism sends a representative to its inverse image.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe' (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) e.symm k : G) = e.symm (k : K)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.subgroupOf_map_normalizerEquivMap
decls.doc:
The copy of `H` inside its normalizer maps to the copy of `e(H)` inside the target
normalizer.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupOf_map_normalizerEquivMap (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) :
    (H.subgroupOf (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G))).map
        ((normalizerEquivMap H e :
          _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) ≃*
            _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
          _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →*
            _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) =
      (H.map (e : G →* K)).subgroupOf
        (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap
decls.doc: A group isomorphism induces an isomorphism on normalizer quotients.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) :
    normalizerQuotient H ≃*
      normalizerQuotient (H.map (e : G →* K))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk
decls.doc:
The induced equivalence on normalizer quotients sends a representative to the image
representative.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K))
        (normalizerEquivMap H e g)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse induced equivalence sends a target representative to the inverse-image
representative.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e).symm
        (normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K)) k) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H ((normalizerEquivMap H e).symm k)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk
decls.doc:
After identifying `H.map (MulEquiv.refl G)` with `H`, identity transport on normalizer
quotients fixes representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap H (MulEquiv.refl G) (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk (H.map ((MulEquiv.refl G : G ≃* G) : G →* G))
        ⟨(g : G), by simp [g.2]⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk
decls.doc:
Composing two normalizer-quotient transports sends representatives through the two
successive normalizer transports.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) (f : K ≃* L)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f
        (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g)) =
      normalizerQuotientMk ((H.map (e : G →* K)).map (f : K →* L))
        (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f (normalizerEquivMap H e g))

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk_congr
decls.doc:
After the subgroup equality `H.map id = H`, identity transport on normalizer quotients is
the canonical identity on representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk_congr (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientCongr
        (by rw [MulEquiv.coe_monoidHom_refl, _root_.Subgroup.map_id] :
          H.map ((MulEquiv.refl G : G ≃* G) : G →* G) = H)
      (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H (MulEquiv.refl G) (normalizerQuotientMk H g)) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H g

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk_congr
decls.doc:
After identifying the twice-mapped subgroup with the subgroup mapped by `e.trans f`,
composing normalizer-quotient transports agrees with transport by the composite isomorphism on
representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk_congr (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) (f : K ≃* L)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientCongr
        (by rw [_root_.Subgroup.map_map, ← MulEquiv.coe_monoidHom_trans] :
          (H.map (e : G →* K)).map (f : K →* L) =
            H.map ((e.trans f : G ≃* L) : G →* L))
      (normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f
        (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g))) =
      normalizerQuotientEquivMap H (e.trans f) (normalizerQuotientMk H g)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk'
decls.doc:
Transporting a representative of `H.map e` along `e.symm` gives the stated inverse-image
representative in `(H.map e).map e.symm`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk' (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) e.symm
        (normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K)) k) =
      normalizerQuotientMk ((H.map (e : G →* K)).map (e.symm : K →* G))
        (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) e.symm k)

decls.name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk_coe
decls.doc:
On representatives, `normalizerQuotientEquivMap` applies the original group
isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K))
        ⟨e (g : G), by
          rw [← normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe H e g]
          exact (normalizerEquivMap H e g).2⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.index_powMonoidHom_range_le_of_closure_eq_top
decls.doc:
In a commutative group generated by a finite set `S`, the range of `powMonoidHom n` has
index at most `n ^ S.card` when `n` is nonzero. This applies Mathlib's exponent/rank cardinality
bound to the quotient by the `n`th powers. The public surface of this file is the squaring
specialization `index_square_le_of_closure_eq_top`; this arbitrary-power form is the shared
engine behind it.
decls.statement:
theorem index_powMonoidHom_range_le_of_closure_eq_top {G : Type*} [CommGroup G]
    {S : Finset G} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hS : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) :
    (powMonoidHom n : G →* G).range.index ≤ n ^ S.card

decls.name: TauCeti.square_eq_powMonoidHom_two_range
decls.doc:
In a commutative group, Mathlib's subgroup of squares agrees with the range of the
squaring homomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem square_eq_powMonoidHom_two_range {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] :
    Subgroup.square G = (powMonoidHom 2 : G →* G).range

decls.name: TauCeti.index_square_le_of_closure_eq_top
decls.doc:
In a commutative group generated by a finite set `S`, the subgroup of squares has index at
most `2 ^ S.card`. The quotient by the squares is an elementary abelian `2`-group spanned by
the image of `S`.
decls.statement:
theorem index_square_le_of_closure_eq_top {G : Type*} [CommGroup G]
    {S : Finset G} (hS : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) :
    (Subgroup.square G).index ≤ 2 ^ S.card

decls.name: TauCeti.intEquivZMultiples
decls.doc:
For an element `p` of infinite additive order, the subgroup `zmultiples p` is infinite
cyclic, identified with `ℤ` by `n ↦ n • p`.
decls.statement: def intEquivZMultiples (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p) : ℤ ≃+ zmultiples p

decls.name: TauCeti.intEquivZMultiples_apply
decls.statement:
theorem intEquivZMultiples_apply (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p) (n : ℤ) :
    (intEquivZMultiples hp n : G) = n • p

decls.name: TauCeti.intEquivZMultiples_symm_mk_zsmul
decls.statement:
theorem intEquivZMultiples_symm_mk_zsmul (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p) (n : ℤ) :
    (intEquivZMultiples hp).symm
      ⟨n • p, mem_zmultiples_iff.2 ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ = n

decls.name: TauCeti.intEquivZMultiples_symm_zsmul
decls.statement:
theorem intEquivZMultiples_symm_zsmul (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p) (a : zmultiples p) :
    ((intEquivZMultiples hp).symm a) • p = (a : G)

decls.name: TauCeti.finite_compl_fixedBy_of_eventually_eq_self
decls.doc: Constructor for Mathlib's finite-support predicate from an eventual fixedness bound.
decls.statement:
theorem finite_compl_fixedBy_of_eventually_eq_self {π : Equiv.Perm ℕ}
    (hπ : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → π n = n) : (MulAction.fixedBy ℕ π)ᶜ.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.finite_compl_fixedBy_eventually_eq_self
decls.doc: A permutation of `ℕ` with finite Mathlib support fixes every sufficiently large index.
decls.statement:
theorem finite_compl_fixedBy_eventually_eq_self {π : Equiv.Perm ℕ}
    (hπ : (MulAction.fixedBy ℕ π)ᶜ.Finite) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → π n = n

decls.name: TauCeti.finite_compl_fixedBy_iff_eventually_eq_self
decls.doc: A permutation of `ℕ` is finitely supported iff it fixes all sufficiently large indices.
decls.statement:
theorem finite_compl_fixedBy_iff_eventually_eq_self {π : Equiv.Perm ℕ} :
    (MulAction.fixedBy ℕ π)ᶜ.Finite ↔ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → π n = n

decls.name: TauCeti.finite_compl_fixedBy_conj
decls.doc:
Conjugating a group element preserves Mathlib's finite-support predicate
`(MulAction.fixedBy α ·)ᶜ.Finite`; in particular this applies to conjugation of permutations.

decls.name: Equiv.Perm.exists_compl_fixedBy_subset_apply_eq
decls.doc:
**A pair of embeddings from a finite type is realised by a permutation supported on their
ranges.** For `f g : ι ↪ β` with `ι` finite there is a permutation of `β` carrying each `f i` to
`g i` and fixing every point outside `Set.range f ∪ Set.range g`.

That union is finite, so `Set.Finite.subset` turns the containment into finite support in the sense
of `(MulAction.fixedBy β σ)ᶜ.Finite`.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_compl_fixedBy_subset_apply_eq {ι β : Type*} [Finite ι] (f g : ι ↪ β) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm β,
      (MulAction.fixedBy β σ)ᶜ ⊆ Set.range f ∪ Set.range g ∧ ∀ i, σ (f i) = g i

decls.name: Equiv.Perm.exists_finite_compl_fixedBy_apply_eq
decls.doc:
Finite-support form of `Equiv.Perm.exists_compl_fixedBy_subset_apply_eq`: for `f g : ι ↪ β`
with `ι` finite there is a permutation of `β` carrying each `f i` to `g i` whose support is finite.

This is the shape consumers of finitely supported reindexing want, `(MulAction.fixedBy β σ)ᶜ.Finite`
being Mathlib's finite-support predicate.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_finite_compl_fixedBy_apply_eq {ι β : Type*} [Finite ι] (f g : ι ↪ β) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm β, (MulAction.fixedBy β σ)ᶜ.Finite ∧ ∀ i, σ (f i) = g i

decls.name: TauCeti.fixingSubgroup_univ
decls.doc: For a faithful action, the subgroup fixing the whole space pointwise is trivial.
decls.statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_univ {G α : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G α] [FaithfulSMul G α] :
    _root_.fixingSubgroup G (Set.univ : Set α) = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.eq_of_bot_orbitRel
decls.statement:
lemma eq_of_bot_orbitRel {x y : X}
    (h : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel (⊥ : Subgroup G) X x y) : x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv
decls.doc: Quotienting a group action by the trivial subgroup gives back the original space.
decls.statement:
def orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv :
    _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (⊥ : Subgroup G) X ≃ X

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv_mk
decls.doc: The bottom-subgroup quotient equivalence sends a class to its representative.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv_mk (x : X) :
    orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv
        (G := G) (X := X) (Quotient.mk'' x :
          _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (⊥ : Subgroup G) X) = x

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse bottom-subgroup quotient equivalence sends a point to its quotient class.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv_symm_apply (x : X) :
    (orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X)).symm x =
      (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (⊥ : Subgroup G) X)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientBot_mk_eq_iff
decls.doc: Equality of bottom-subgroup orbit classes is equality of representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientBot_mk_eq_iff (x y : X) :
    (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (⊥ : Subgroup G) X) =
        Quotient.mk'' y ↔
      x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le
decls.doc: Orbit relations are monotone in the acting subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le {H K : Subgroup G} (hHK : H ≤ K) :
    _root_.MulAction.orbitRel H X ≤ _root_.MulAction.orbitRel K X

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq
decls.doc:
The map from the bottom-subgroup quotient to the `H`-quotient is the `H`-orbit class map
under the bottom quotient equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq (H : Subgroup G) :
    Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ H)) =
      (fun x : X => (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X)) ∘
        orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Equality in an `H`-orbit quotient can be checked after choosing representatives through
the bottom-subgroup quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq_iff (H : Subgroup G)
    (x y : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (⊥ : Subgroup G) X) :
    Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ H)) x =
        Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X)
          (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ H)) y ↔
      orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X) x ∈
        _root_.MulAction.orbit H (orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X) y)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_mul_inv_mem
decls.doc:
In a cancellative action, two translates have the same subgroup-orbit quotient class
exactly when the translators differ on the right by an element of the subgroup. This holds
for an arbitrary subgroup; the normal-subgroup criterion
`orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_normalizerQuotientMk_inv_eq` follows from it.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_mul_inv_mem [IsCancelSMul G X] (H : Subgroup G)
    (x : X) (g k : G) :
    (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
        Quotient.mk'' (k • x) ↔
      g * k⁻¹ ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_base_iff
decls.doc:
In a cancellative action, a translate has the same subgroup-orbit quotient class as the
base point exactly when the translating group element belongs to the subgroup.
