decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_base_iff [IsCancelSMul G X] (H : Subgroup G) (g : G) (x : X) :
    (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
        Quotient.mk'' x ↔
      g ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_normalizerQuotientMk_inv_eq
decls.doc:
In a cancellative action by `G`, equality of two translates in the quotient by a normal
subgroup `H` is equality of the corresponding inverse representatives in the normalizer
quotient `N(H) / H`.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_normalizerQuotientMk_inv_eq [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x : X) (g k : G) :
    (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
        Quotient.mk'' (k • x) ↔
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
          ⟨g⁻¹, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩ =
        Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
          ⟨k⁻¹, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup_symm_mk
decls.doc:
Mathlib's subgroup-orbit quotient equivalence sends the coset of `g` back to the orbit
class of `g⁻¹ • x`. This records the representative convention once, so later lemmas can
rewrite through a named theorem rather than relying directly on definitional equality.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup_symm_mk
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) (x : X) (g : G) :
    (MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup x H).symm
        (QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) g) =
      (Quotient.mk'' (g⁻¹ • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup_apply_smul
decls.doc:
The subgroup-orbit quotient equivalence sends the orbit class of `g • x` to the coset
of `g⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup_apply_smul
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X] (H : Subgroup G) (x : X) (g : G) :
    MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup x H
        (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) g⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_mk
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_mk {H K : Subgroup G} (hHK : H ≤ K) (x : X) :
    Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X) hHK)
        (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient K X)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup_mapOfLE
decls.doc: The subgroup-orbit quotient equivalence is natural in subgroup inclusions.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup_mapOfLE
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X] {H K : Subgroup G} (hHK : H ≤ K) (x₀ : X)
    (x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) :
    Subgroup.quotientMapOfLE hHK
        (MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup x₀ H x) =
      MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup x₀ K
        (Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X) hHK) x)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizer_smul_mem_orbit
decls.statement:
lemma normalizer_smul_mem_orbit (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G))
    {x y : X} (hxy : x ∈ _root_.MulAction.orbit H y) :
    (g : G) • x ∈ _root_.MulAction.orbit H ((g : G) • y)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap
decls.doc: A normalizer representative acts on the quotient by `H`-orbits.

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap_apply
decls.doc: The normalizer action on an orbit quotient sends a class to the class of its translate.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap_apply (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (x : X) :
    normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap H g
        (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      Quotient.mk'' ((g : G) • x)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap_one
decls.doc: The normalizer representative `1` acts trivially on the orbit quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap_one (H : Subgroup G) :
    normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap (X := X) H ⟨1, by simp⟩ = id

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap_mul
decls.doc: Normalizer representatives act by composition on the orbit quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap_mul (H : Subgroup G)
    (g k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap (X := X) H (g * k) =
      normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap H g ∘ normalizerOrbitRelQuotientMap H k

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv
decls.doc: A normalizer representative acts on the orbit quotient by a permutation.

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv_apply
decls.doc: A normalizer representative permutes orbit classes by translating representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv_apply (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (x : X) :
    normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv H g
        (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      Quotient.mk'' ((g : G) • x)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse normalizer permutation translates representatives by the inverse element.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv_symm_apply (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (x : X) :
    (normalizerOrbitRelQuotientEquiv H g).symm
        (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      Quotient.mk'' ((g : G)⁻¹ • x)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom
decls.doc: The normalizer action on the orbit quotient as a permutation representation.

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom_apply
decls.doc: The normalizer permutation homomorphism sends representatives to their translates.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom_apply (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (x : X) :
    normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom (X := X) H g
        (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      Quotient.mk'' ((g : G) • x)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom_eq_one_of_mem
decls.doc:
Any normalizer representative whose underlying group element lies in `H` acts trivially
on the quotient by `H`-orbits.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom_eq_one_of_mem
    (H : Subgroup G) (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (hg : (g : G) ∈ H) :
    normalizerOrbitRelQuotientPermHom (X := X) H g = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotientPermHom
decls.doc: The action of the normalizer on an orbit quotient descends to `N(H) / H`.

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotientPermHom_mk_apply
decls.doc:
The descended normalizer-quotient action sends a normalizer representative to the
corresponding translate on orbit classes.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotientPermHom_mk_apply (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (x : X) :
    normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotientPermHom (X := X) H
        (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H g)
        (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      Quotient.mk'' ((g : G) • x)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotientMulAction
decls.doc: The normalizer quotient `N(H) / H` acts on the quotient by `H`-orbits.
decls.statement:
def normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotientMulAction (H : Subgroup G) :
    MulAction (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (_root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X)

decls.doc:
A normalizer-quotient representative acts on the orbit quotient by translating
representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientOrbitRelQuotient_smul_mk (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) (x : X) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
decls.doc:
In a free transitive action, quotienting by a normal subgroup `H` identifies the
`H`-orbit quotient with the normalizer quotient `N(H) / H`. The representative convention is
the same as Mathlib's `equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup`: the class of `g • x` corresponds to
the class of `g⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
def orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x : X) :
    _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X ≃ Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
decls.doc:
The normal-subgroup orbit quotient equivalence, followed by the normalizer quotient's
normal-case comparison, is Mathlib's equivalence to `G ⧸ H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x₀ : X)
    (x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal H
        (orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H x₀ x) =
      MulAction.equivSubgroupOrbitsQuotientGroup x₀ H x

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse normal-subgroup orbit-quotient equivalence sends a normalizer representative
to the orbit class of its inverse acting on the base point.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_symm_mk
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x : X)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    (orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H x).symm
        (g : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) =
      (Quotient.mk'' ((g : G)⁻¹ • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X)

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_apply_smul
decls.doc:
The normal-subgroup orbit-quotient equivalence sends the class of `g • x` to the
normalizer-quotient class of `g⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_apply_smul
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x : X) (g : G) :
    orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H x
        (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
        ⟨g⁻¹, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_map_smul_eq_mul_inv
decls.doc:
Under the normal-subgroup orbit-quotient equivalence, the descended normalizer-quotient
action is right multiplication by the inverse.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_map_smul_eq_mul_inv

    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x₀ : X)

decls.doc:

multiplication by `a⁻¹` is the same as acting by `a` on the orbit quotient.

decls.doc:

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.algHom_comp_antipode_mul_self
decls.doc:
Postcomposing the antipode convolution identity `LinearMap.antipode_mul_id` with an algebra
homomorphism `f`: the map `f ∘ₗ antipode` is a left convolution inverse of `f`.
decls.statement:
lemma algHom_comp_antipode_mul_self {D : Type w} [Semiring D] [Algebra R D]
    (f : C →ₐ[R] D) :
    (toConv (f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R) : WithConv (C →ₗ[R] D)) *
        toConv f.toLinearMap = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.antipode_comul_antidistrib
decls.doc:
The antipode reverses comultiplication: after comultiplication, swap the tensor factors
and apply the antipode to each of them. This is the coalgebraic counterpart of
`HopfAlgebra.antipode_mul_antidistrib`.
decls.statement:
theorem antipode_comul_antidistrib :
    Coalgebra.comul ∘ₗ antipode R =
      TensorProduct.map (antipode R) (antipode R) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.comm R C C).toLinearMap ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.antipode_comul_antidistrib_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of `antipode_comul_antidistrib`.
decls.statement:
theorem antipode_comul_antidistrib_apply (c : C) :
    Coalgebra.comul (antipode R c) =
      TensorProduct.map (antipode R) (antipode R)
        ((TensorProduct.comm R C C) (Coalgebra.comul c))

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorProduct.antipode_tmul
decls.doc: The antipode on a tensor product of Hopf algebras acts componentwise on pure tensors.
decls.statement:
lemma antipode_tmul (b : B) (a : A) :
    antipode S (A := B ⊗[R] A) (b ⊗ₜ[R] a) =
      antipode S b ⊗ₜ[R] antipode R a

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.baseChange_antipode_tmul
decls.doc:
The antipode on the base-changed Hopf algebra `K ⊗[k] A` sends a pure tensor
`s ⊗ a` to `s ⊗ S a`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_antipode_tmul {k K A : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [CommSemiring K]
    [Semiring A] [Algebra k K] [_root_.HopfAlgebra k A] (s : K) (a : A) :
    antipode K (A := K ⊗[k] A) (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s ⊗ₜ[k] antipode k a

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.antipode_convMul_id
decls.doc:
The antipode is a left convolution inverse of the identity in the convolution ring of
linear maps: `S * id = 1`. This is a restatement of the antipode axiom
`HopfAlgebra.mul_antipode_rTensor_comul`.
decls.statement:
lemma antipode_convMul_id :
    (toConv (antipode R) : WithConv (H →ₗ[R] H)) * toConv LinearMap.id = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.id_convMul_antipode
decls.doc:
The antipode is a right convolution inverse of the identity in the convolution ring of
linear maps: `id * S = 1`. This is a restatement of the antipode axiom
`HopfAlgebra.mul_antipode_lTensor_comul`.
decls.statement:
lemma id_convMul_antipode :
    (toConv LinearMap.id : WithConv (H →ₗ[R] H)) * toConv (antipode R) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.toAlgHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The algebra-hom projection of a bialgebra hom has the same underlying linear map as the
bialgebra hom itself.
decls.statement:
lemma toAlgHom_toLinearMap (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B).toLinearMap = φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.toCoalgHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The coalgebra-hom projection of a bialgebra hom has the same underlying linear map as the
bialgebra hom itself.
decls.statement:
lemma toCoalgHom_toLinearMap (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (φ.toCoalgHom : A →ₗ[R] B) = φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.coe_coalgHom_toLinearMap
decls.doc:
The coalgebra-hom coercion of a bialgebra hom has the same underlying linear map as the
bialgebra hom itself.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_coalgHom_toLinearMap (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    ((φ : A →ₗc[R] B) : A →ₗ[R] B) = φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.algHom_comp_convMul_ofConv
decls.doc:
Applying an algebra homomorphism to a convolution product, oriented so it rewrites the
`WithConv.ofConv` shape arising from bialgebra morphism composition.
decls.statement:
lemma algHom_comp_convMul_ofConv (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (f g : A →ₗ[R] A) :
    (toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp f) *
          toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp g)).ofConv =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp (toConv f * toConv g).ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.convMul_comp_coalgHom_ofConv
decls.doc:
Precomposing a convolution product with a coalgebra homomorphism, oriented so it rewrites
the `WithConv.ofConv` shape arising from bialgebra morphism composition.
decls.statement:
lemma convMul_comp_coalgHom_ofConv (f g : B →ₗ[R] B) (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (toConv (f.comp φ.toLinearMap) *
          toConv (g.comp φ.toLinearMap)).ofConv =
      (toConv f * toConv g).ofConv.comp φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.algHom_comp_antipode_id_ofConv
decls.doc:
Applying a bialgebra homomorphism to the convolution product `S * id`, in the exact
normal form used in the antipode-preservation proof.
decls.statement:
lemma algHom_comp_antipode_id_ofConv (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A))) *
          toConv φ.toLinearMap).ofConv =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp
        (toConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)) * toConv LinearMap.id).ofConv

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.id_antipode_comp_coalgHom_ofConv
decls.doc:
Precomposing the convolution product `id * S` with a bialgebra homomorphism, in the
exact normal form used in the antipode-preservation proof.
decls.statement:
lemma id_antipode_comp_coalgHom_ofConv (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (toConv φ.toLinearMap *
          toConv ((HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)).comp φ.toLinearMap)).ofConv =
      (toConv LinearMap.id * toConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B))).ofConv.comp
        φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.toLinearMap_comp_antipode
decls.doc:
A bialgebra morphism between Hopf algebras commutes with the antipodes, as a statement
about underlying linear maps.
decls.statement:
theorem toLinearMap_comp_antipode (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    φ.toLinearMap.comp (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)) =
      (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)).comp φ.toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHom.map_antipode
decls.doc: A bialgebra morphism between Hopf algebras commutes with the antipodes, pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem map_antipode (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (a : A) :
    φ (HopfAlgebra.antipode R a) = HopfAlgebra.antipode R (φ a)

decls.name: TauCeti.BialgHomClass.map_antipode
decls.doc: A bialgebra-hom-like map between Hopf algebras commutes with the antipodes, pointwise.
decls.statement:
theorem map_antipode (φ : F) (a : A) :
    φ (HopfAlgebra.antipode R a) = HopfAlgebra.antipode R (φ a)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal
decls.doc:
The image of an ideal `I ≤ H` under the left inclusion `H → H ⊗[R] H`, representing
`I ⊗ H` inside the tensor product algebra.
decls.statement: def leftTensorIdeal (I : Ideal H) : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal
decls.doc:
The image of an ideal `I ≤ H` under the right inclusion `H → H ⊗[R] H`, representing
`H ⊗ I` inside the tensor product algebra.
decls.statement: def rightTensorIdeal (I : Ideal H) : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_def
decls.statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_def (I : Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I =
      Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_def
decls.statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_def (I : Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I =
      Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal
decls.doc: The left tensor inclusion sends elements of `I` into `I ⊗ H`.
decls.statement:
theorem includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal
decls.doc: The right tensor inclusion sends elements of `I` into `H ⊗ I`.
decls.statement:
theorem includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H) x ∈
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.tmul_mem_leftTensorIdeal
decls.doc: A pure tensor `x ⊗ₜ y` with `x ∈ I` lies in `I ⊗ H`.
decls.statement:
theorem tmul_mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) (y : H) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] y ∈ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.tmul_mem_rightTensorIdeal
decls.doc: A pure tensor `x ⊗ₜ y` with `y ∈ I` lies in `H ⊗ I`.
decls.statement:
theorem tmul_mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} (x : H) {y : H} (hy : y ∈ I) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] y ∈ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_leftTensorIdeal
decls.statement:
theorem mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H ⊗[R] H} :
    x ∈ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      x ∈ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_rightTensorIdeal
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H ⊗[R] H} :
    x ∈ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      x ∈ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_le_iff
decls.doc: The order universal property for `I ⊗ H`.
decls.statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_le_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_le_iff
decls.doc: The order universal property for `H ⊗ I`.
decls.statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_le_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_mono
decls.doc: The construction `I ↦ I ⊗ H` is monotone.
decls.statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_mono
decls.doc: The construction `I ↦ H ⊗ I` is monotone.
decls.statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_iSup
decls.doc: The construction `I ↦ I ⊗ H` distributes over arbitrary suprema of ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ i, I i) =
      ⨆ i, leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I i)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_iSup
decls.doc: The construction `I ↦ H ⊗ I` distributes over arbitrary suprema of ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ i, I i) =
      ⨆ i, rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I i)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_sup
decls.doc: The construction `I ↦ I ⊗ H` distributes over joins of ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_sup (I J : Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I ⊔ J) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_sup
decls.doc: The construction `I ↦ H ⊗ I` distributes over joins of ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_sup (I J : Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I ⊔ J) =
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_restrictScalars_eq_range
decls.doc:
TauCeti's `leftTensorIdeal I` (`I ⊗ H`), viewed as an `R`-submodule, is the range of
`rTensor H (I.restrictScalars R).subtype`. This is Mathlib's `Ideal.map_includeLeft_eq`.
decls.statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_restrictScalars_eq_range (I : Ideal H) :
    (leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I).restrictScalars R =
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor H (I.restrictScalars R).subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_restrictScalars_eq_range
decls.doc:
TauCeti's `rightTensorIdeal I` (`H ⊗ I`), viewed as an `R`-submodule, is the range of
`lTensor H (I.restrictScalars R).subtype`. This is Mathlib's `Ideal.map_includeRight_eq`.
decls.statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_restrictScalars_eq_range (I : Ideal H) :
    (rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I).restrictScalars R =
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lTensor H (I.restrictScalars R).subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comul_mem_sup_restrictScalars_eq_range
decls.doc:
The bridge to Mathlib's coideal target: TauCeti's `I ⊗ H + H ⊗ I` (a sup of ideals of
`H ⊗[R] H`), viewed as an `R`-submodule, equals `range (lTensor …) ⊔ range (rTensor …)`.
decls.statement:
theorem comul_mem_sup_restrictScalars_eq_range (I : Ideal H) :
    (leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I).restrictScalars R =
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lTensor H (I.restrictScalars R).subtype) ⊔
        LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor H (I.restrictScalars R).subtype)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal
decls.doc:
A Hopf ideal in a Hopf algebra over a commutative semiring.

The comultiplication condition is stated in the ambient tensor product algebra as
`Δ(I) ⊆ I ⊗ H + H ⊗ I`. Over a commutative ring, the bridge instances
`HopfIdeal.instIsCoideal` and `HopfIdeal.instIsHopfIdeal` below let Mathlib endow the
quotient `H ⧸ I.toIdeal` with its Hopf-algebra structure.
decls.statement: structure HopfIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instSetLike
decls.statement: instance : SetLike (HopfIdeal R H) H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instAddSubmonoidClass
decls.statement: instance : AddSubmonoidClass (HopfIdeal R H) H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instSMulMemClass
decls.statement: instance : SMulMemClass (HopfIdeal R H) H H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instPartialOrder
decls.statement: instance : PartialOrder (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.toIdeal
decls.doc: The underlying ideal of a Hopf ideal.
decls.statement: def toIdeal (I : HopfIdeal R H) : Ideal H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instIsTwoSidedToIdeal
decls.statement: instance (I : HopfIdeal R H) : I.toIdeal.IsTwoSided

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_carrier
decls.statement: theorem mem_carrier {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} : x ∈ I.carrier ↔ x ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_toIdeal
decls.statement: theorem mem_toIdeal {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} : x ∈ I.toIdeal ↔ x ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.toIdeal_carrier
decls.statement: theorem toIdeal_carrier (I : HopfIdeal R H) : I.toIdeal = I.carrier

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.le_def
decls.statement: theorem le_def {I J : HopfIdeal R H} : I ≤ J ↔ ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I → x ∈ J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.toIdeal_le_toIdeal
decls.statement:
theorem toIdeal_le_toIdeal {I J : HopfIdeal R H} :
    I.toIdeal ≤ J.toIdeal ↔ I ≤ J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ext
decls.doc: Two Hopf ideals are equal when they contain the same elements.
decls.statement: theorem ext {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (h : ∀ x : H, x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ J) : I = J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ofIdeal
decls.doc: Constructor from an ideal and the three Hopf-ideal closure conditions.
decls.statement:
def ofIdeal (I : Ideal H) [I.IsTwoSided]
    (hcomul :
      ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I →
        Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
          leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I)
    (hcounit : ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I → Coalgebra.counit (R := R) x = 0)
    (hantipode : ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I → HopfAlgebra.antipode R x ∈ I) :
    HopfIdeal R H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ofIdeal_carrier
decls.statement:
theorem ofIdeal_carrier (I : Ideal H) [I.IsTwoSided] (hcomul hcounit hantipode) :
    (ofIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I hcomul hcounit hantipode).carrier = I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_ofIdeal
decls.statement:
theorem mem_ofIdeal {I : Ideal H} [I.IsTwoSided] {hcomul hcounit hantipode} {x : H} :
    x ∈ ofIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I hcomul hcounit hantipode ↔ x ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comul_mem
decls.doc: The comultiplication of an element of a Hopf ideal lies in `I ⊗ H + H ⊗ I`.
decls.statement:
theorem comul_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.counit_eq_zero
decls.doc: The counit vanishes on a Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
theorem counit_eq_zero (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.antipode_mem
decls.doc: The antipode preserves a Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
theorem antipode_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    HopfAlgebra.antipode R x ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mul_mem_right
decls.doc: A Hopf ideal absorbs multiplication on the right as well as on the left.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_mem_right (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) (y : H) :
    x * y ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instBot
decls.doc: The zero ideal as a Hopf ideal.
decls.statement: instance instBot : Bot (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.bot_toIdeal
decls.statement: theorem bot_toIdeal : (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal = (⊥ : Ideal H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_bot
decls.statement: theorem mem_bot {x : H} : x ∈ (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) ↔ x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instOrderBot
decls.doc: The zero Hopf ideal is contained in every Hopf ideal.
decls.statement: instance : OrderBot (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instMax
decls.doc: The sum of two Hopf ideals is a Hopf ideal.
decls.statement: instance instMax : Max (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.sup_toIdeal
decls.doc:
The underlying ideal of the join of two Hopf ideals is the join of their underlying
ideals.
decls.statement: theorem sup_toIdeal (I J : HopfIdeal R H) : (I ⊔ J).toIdeal = I.toIdeal ⊔ J.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_sup
decls.doc: Membership in the join of two Hopf ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sup {I J : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} :
    x ∈ I ⊔ J ↔ ∃ y ∈ I, ∃ z ∈ J, y + z = x

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instSemilatticeSup
decls.doc:
Hopf ideals form a semilattice under ideal sum, with `⊔` given by the sum
construction.
decls.statement: instance instSemilatticeSup : SemilatticeSup (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instSupSet
decls.doc:
The supremum of a set of Hopf ideals has underlying ideal the supremum of the underlying
ideals. The four proof obligations are the implementation of this construction, so they are
discharged inline rather than as standalone lemmas.
decls.statement: instance instSupSet : SupSet (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.sSup_toIdeal
decls.doc:
The underlying ideal of a supremum of a set of Hopf ideals is the supremum of the
underlying ideals indexed by that set.
decls.statement:
theorem sSup_toIdeal (S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)) :
    (sSup S).toIdeal = ⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_sSup
decls.doc: Membership in the supremum of a set of Hopf ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)} {x : H} :
    x ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ H, (∀ I : S, f I ∈ (I : HopfIdeal R H)) ∧ f.sum (fun _ y => y) = x

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.iSup_toIdeal
decls.doc:
The underlying ideal of a supremum of a family of Hopf ideals is the supremum of the
underlying ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem iSup_toIdeal {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → HopfIdeal R H) :
    (⨆ i, I i).toIdeal = ⨆ i, (I i).toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_iSup
decls.doc: Membership in the supremum of a family of Hopf ideals.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {I : ι → HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} :
    x ∈ ⨆ i, I i ↔ ∃ f : ι →₀ H, (∀ i, f i ∈ I i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ y => y) = x

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instCompleteSemilatticeSup
decls.doc: Hopf ideals have arbitrary suprema, computed on underlying ideals.
decls.statement: instance instCompleteSemilatticeSup : CompleteSemilatticeSup (HopfIdeal R H)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instIsCoideal
decls.doc:
A `HopfIdeal` gives Mathlib's coideal structure on the underlying `R`-submodule, so that
Mathlib's quotient `Coalgebra`/`Bialgebra` instances fire on `H ⧸ I.toIdeal`.
decls.statement:
instance instIsCoideal (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    (I.toIdeal.restrictScalars R).IsCoideal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.instIsHopfIdeal
decls.doc:
A `HopfIdeal` gives Mathlib's `Ideal.IsHopfIdeal`, so that Mathlib's quotient
`HopfAlgebra` instance fires on `H ⧸ I.toIdeal`.
decls.statement: instance instIsHopfIdeal (I : HopfIdeal R H) : I.toIdeal.IsHopfIdeal R

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap
decls.doc:
The inverse image of a Hopf ideal along a surjective bialgebra morphism.

It is defined as the kernel of the composite `H → K → K/I`; its underlying ideal is the
ordinary ideal comap of `I.toIdeal`.
decls.statement:
def comap (I : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : HopfIdeal R H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_toIdeal
decls.doc: The underlying ideal of `I.comap f hf` is the ordinary ideal-theoretic inverse image.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_toIdeal (I : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I.comap f hf).toIdeal = Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_comap
decls.doc: Membership in the inverse-image Hopf ideal is membership after applying the morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_comap {I : HopfIdeal R K} {f : H →ₐc[R] K} {hf : Function.Surjective f}
    {h : H} : h ∈ I.comap f hf ↔ f h ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_mono
decls.doc: Inverse image of Hopf ideals is monotone.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_mono (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R K} (hIJ : I ≤ J) : I.comap f hf ≤ J.comap f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.le_of_comap_le_comap_of_surjective
decls.doc: For a surjective morphism, inverse image of Hopf ideals reflects containment.

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective
decls.doc:
For a surjective morphism, containment after inverse image is equivalent to containment
before inverse image.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    I.comap f hf ≤ J.comap f hf ↔ I ≤ J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_eq_comap_iff_of_surjective
decls.doc: For a surjective morphism, inverse image of Hopf ideals reflects equality.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_eq_comap_iff_of_surjective (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    I.comap f hf = J.comap f hf ↔ I = J

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_bot
decls.doc: The inverse image of the zero Hopf ideal is the kernel Hopf ideal.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_bot (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (⊥ : HopfIdeal R K).comap f hf = ker f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.exists_finsupp_map_eq
decls.doc:
A finitely supported family over `K` lifts along a surjective bialgebra morphism to a
finitely supported family over `H` that agrees with it pointwise and has the same total sum.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_finsupp_map_eq {ι : Type*} (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : ι →₀ K) :
    ∃ t : ι →₀ H, (∀ i, f (t i) = s i) ∧
      f (t.sum fun _ y => y) = s.sum fun _ y => y

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_iSup_le
decls.doc:
The inverse image of a supremum of Hopf ideals is contained in the supremum of the inverse
images: the nontrivial inclusion of `comap_iSup_of_surjective`.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_iSup_le {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (I : ι → HopfIdeal R K)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (⨆ i, I i).comap f hf ≤ ⨆ i, (I i).comap f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_iSup_of_surjective
decls.doc: Surjective inverse image of Hopf ideals preserves nonempty suprema of families.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_iSup_of_surjective {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (I : ι → HopfIdeal R K)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (⨆ i, I i).comap f hf = ⨆ i, (I i).comap f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_sup_of_surjective
decls.doc: Surjective inverse image of Hopf ideals preserves joins.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_sup_of_surjective (I J : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I ⊔ J).comap f hf = I.comap f hf ⊔ J.comap f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_sSup_of_surjective
decls.doc: Surjective inverse image of Hopf ideals preserves nonempty suprema of sets.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_sSup_of_surjective (S : Set (HopfIdeal R K)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (sSup S).comap f hf = sSup ((fun I => I.comap f hf) '' S)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_id
decls.doc: Pulling a Hopf ideal back along the identity morphism leaves it unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_id (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I.comap (BialgHom.id R H) (by rw [BialgHom.coe_id]; exact Function.surjective_id) = I

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_comap
decls.doc: Inverse image of Hopf ideals is compatible with composition of surjective morphisms.
decls.statement:
theorem comap_comap (I : HopfIdeal R L) (g : K →ₐc[R] L) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I.comap g hg).comap f hf =
      I.comap (g.comp f) (by rw [BialgHom.coe_comp]; exact hg.comp hf)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comul_mem_tensor_map_ker
decls.doc:
The tensor-square map sends the comultiplication of an element in the kernel of a
bialgebra morphism to zero.
decls.statement:
theorem comul_mem_tensor_map_ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K) {x : H}
    (hx : x ∈ RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
      RingHom.ker
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (f : H →ₐ[R] K)).toRingHom

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.tensor_map_ker_eq_left_sup_right
decls.doc: The tensor-kernel exactness theorem in the tensor-ideal notation used by `HopfIdeal`.
decls.statement:
theorem tensor_map_ker_eq_left_sup_right (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K))

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker
decls.doc: The kernel of a surjective bialgebra morphism, as a Hopf ideal.
decls.statement: def ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) : HopfIdeal R H

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_toIdeal
decls.doc: The underlying ideal of the kernel Hopf ideal is the ring-hom kernel.
decls.statement:
theorem ker_toIdeal (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (ker f hf).toIdeal = RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_ker
decls.doc: Membership in the kernel Hopf ideal is vanishing under the bialgebra morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) {x : H} :
    x ∈ ker f hf ↔ f x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_eq_bot_iff
decls.doc: The kernel Hopf ideal is bottom exactly when the morphism is injective.
decls.statement:
theorem ker_eq_bot_iff (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ker f hf = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom
decls.doc:
The bialgebra morphism induced from a surjective morphism on the quotient by its
Hopf-ideal kernel.
decls.statement:
def kerLiftBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal →ₐc[R] K

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom_mk
decls.doc: The kernel quotient lift evaluates on quotient classes as the original morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_mk (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (h : H) :
    kerLiftBialgHom f hf (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (ker f hf).toIdeal h) = f h

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom
decls.doc: The kernel quotient lift composed with the quotient map is the original morphism.
decls.statement:
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerLiftBialgHom f hf).comp (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom (ker f hf).toIdeal) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom_bijective
decls.doc:
The quotient by the Hopf-ideal kernel of a surjective morphism maps bijectively to the
codomain.
decls.statement:
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_bijective (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Bijective (kerLiftBialgHom f hf)

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgEquiv
decls.doc:
The quotient by the Hopf-ideal kernel of a surjective morphism is bialgebra-equivalent to
the codomain.
decls.statement:
def kerLiftBialgEquiv (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) ≃ₐc[R] K

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The kernel quotient equivalence applies as the kernel quotient lift.
decls.statement:
theorem kerLiftBialgEquiv_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (q : H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) :
    kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf q = kerLiftBialgHom f hf q

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgEquiv_toBialgHom
decls.doc:
The bialgebra morphism underlying the kernel quotient equivalence is the kernel quotient
lift.
decls.statement:
theorem kerLiftBialgEquiv_toBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf : H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal →ₐc[R] K) = kerLiftBialgHom f hf

decls.name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_mkBialgHom
decls.doc: The Hopf-ideal kernel of the quotient morphism by `I` is `I`.
decls.statement:
theorem ker_mkBialgHom (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    ker (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective = I

decls.name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.antipodeHom
decls.doc:
The antipode of the symmetric-algebra Hopf algebra: the `R`-algebra map sending each
generator `ι x` to `-ι x`.
decls.statement:
def antipodeHom :
    _root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] _root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M

decls.name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.antipodeHom_ι
decls.statement:
theorem antipodeHom_ι (x : M) :
    antipodeHom R M (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) =
      -(_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.instHopfAlgebra
decls.doc:
The symmetric algebra over a commutative ring is a Hopf algebra: its antipode sends each
generator `ι x` to `-ι x`.
decls.statement: instance instHopfAlgebra : HopfAlgebra R (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.antipode_ι
decls.doc: The Hopf-algebra antipode on a symmetric algebra sends each generator `ι x` to `-ι x`.
decls.statement:
theorem antipode_ι (x : M) :
    antipode R (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) = -(_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.lift_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse of the symmetric-algebra lift evaluates an algebra map at a generator: it sends
`H` to the linear map `x ↦ H (ι x)`.
decls.statement:
theorem lift_symm_apply (H : _root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A) (x : M) :
    _root_.SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm H x = H (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

decls.name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.convMul_apply_ι
decls.doc:
The convolution product of two points of a symmetric algebra is, on each generator, the sum
of their values: `(F * G)(ι x) = F(ι x) + G(ι x)`.
decls.statement:
theorem convMul_apply_ι (F G : WithConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) (x : M) :
    (F * G).ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) =
      F.ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) +
        G.ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

decls.name: TauCeti.centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv
decls.doc:
The center of a product of nonzero matrix algebras over a field consists of the tuples of
scalar matrices, so it is the algebra of functions on the index.
decls.statement:
def centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv [∀ i, NeZero (d i)] :
    Subalgebra.center k (Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k) ≃ₐ[k] (ι → k)

decls.name: TauCeti.algebraMap_centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
`centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv` reads off the scalar of each component: the `i`-th component of a
central tuple is the scalar matrix on the `i`-th value of the corresponding function.
decls.statement:
theorem algebraMap_centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv_apply [∀ i, NeZero (d i)]
    (x : Subalgebra.center k (Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k)) (i : ι) :
    algebraMap k (Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k) (centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv k d x i) =
      (x : Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k) i

decls.name: TauCeti.centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The inverse of `centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv` assembles a function on the index into the tuple of the
corresponding scalar matrices.
decls.statement:
theorem centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv_symm_apply_coe [∀ i, NeZero (d i)] (f : ι → k) (i : ι) :
    ((centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv k d).symm f : Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k) i =
      algebraMap k (Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k) (f i)

decls.name: TauCeti.finrank_pi_matrix
decls.doc: The dimension of a finite product of matrix algebras is the sum of the squares of the sizes.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_pi_matrix :
    Module.finrank k (Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k) = ∑ i, d i ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.finrank_center_pi_matrix
decls.doc:
The center of a finite product of nonzero matrix algebras over a field has dimension the number
of factors.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_center_pi_matrix [∀ i, NeZero (d i)] :
    Module.finrank k (Subalgebra.center k (Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) k)) =
      Fintype.card ι

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.coeff_injOn_natDegree_le
decls.doc:
The coefficient map `f ↦ (f.coeff i)ᵢ` into `Fin (d + 1) → R` is injective on the polynomials
of degree at most `d`: such a polynomial is determined by its first `d + 1` coefficients. This is
the shared injection behind both the count and the finiteness of the bounded-coefficient family.
decls.statement:
theorem coeff_injOn_natDegree_le (d : ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (fun (f : R[X]) (i : Fin (d + 1)) => f.coeff i) {f | f.natDegree ≤ d}

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.ncard_natDegree_le_coeff_mem_le
decls.doc:
The polynomials of degree at most `d` whose coefficients all lie in a finite set `U` number
at most `#U ^ (d + 1)`: such a polynomial is determined by the `d + 1` coefficients
`coeff 0, …, coeff d`, each ranging over `U`, so the coefficient map injects the set into the
`(d + 1)`-fold product `Fin (d + 1) → U`.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_natDegree_le_coeff_mem_le (d : ℕ) (U : Finset R) :
    {f : R[X] | f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, f.coeff i ∈ U}.ncard ≤ U.card ^ (d + 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.finite_setOf_natDegree_le_coeff_mem
decls.doc:
The polynomials of degree at most `d` whose coefficients all lie in a finite set `U` form a
finite set: the same coefficient map that gives the count above injects them into the finite
product `Fin (d + 1) → U`. Finiteness needs no computable finset data, so `U` is an arbitrary
finite `Set`. (Mathlib proves this only inline, inside `Polynomial.bUnion_roots_finite`.)
decls.statement:
theorem finite_setOf_natDegree_le_coeff_mem (d : ℕ) {U : Set R} (hU : U.Finite) :
    {f : R[X] | f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, f.coeff i ∈ U}.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.setOf_abs_intCoeff_le_eq
decls.doc:
Bounding an integer coefficient by `B` in absolute value is membership in the interval
`[-B, B]`, so the two spellings of the bounded-degree, bounded-coefficient family agree.

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.ncard_natDegree_le_abs_intCoeff_le
decls.doc:
The integer polynomials of degree at most `d` all of whose coefficients are bounded by `B` in
absolute value number at most `(2 * B + 1) ^ (d + 1)`: each of the `d + 1` coefficients
`coeff 0, …, coeff d` ranges over the `2 * B + 1` integers in `[-B, B]`.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_natDegree_le_abs_intCoeff_le (d B : ℕ) :
    {f : ℤ[X] | f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, |f.coeff i| ≤ (B : ℤ)}.ncard ≤ (2 * B + 1) ^ (d + 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.finite_setOf_natDegree_le_abs_intCoeff_le
decls.doc:
The integer polynomials of degree at most `d` all of whose coefficients are bounded by `B` in
absolute value form a finite set: their coefficients range over the finite interval `[-B, B]`.
decls.statement:
theorem finite_setOf_natDegree_le_abs_intCoeff_le (d B : ℕ) :
    {f : ℤ[X] | f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, |f.coeff i| ≤ (B : ℤ)}.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.ncard_biUnion_roots_natDegree_le_coeff_mem_le
decls.doc:
The roots in a domain `S` of all polynomials of degree at most `d` with every coefficient in a
finite set `U`, mapped along a ring hom `m : R →+* S`, number at most `#U ^ (d + 1) · d`: there are
at most `#U ^ (d + 1)` such polynomials, and each, having degree at most `d`, has at most `d` roots
in `S`. This is the explicit cardinality of the set whose finiteness is
`Polynomial.bUnion_roots_finite`.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_biUnion_roots_natDegree_le_coeff_mem_le (m : R →+* S) (d : ℕ) (U : Finset R) :
    (⋃ (f : R[X]) (_ : f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, f.coeff i ∈ U),
        ((f.map m).roots.toFinset : Set S)).ncard ≤ U.card ^ (d + 1) * d

decls.name: TauCeti.Polynomial.ncard_biUnion_roots_natDegree_le_abs_intCoeff_le
decls.doc:
The integer specialisation: the roots in a domain `S` of all integer polynomials of degree at
most `d` with every coefficient bounded by `B` in absolute value number at most
`(2 · B + 1) ^ (d + 1) · d`. Each of the `2 · B + 1` integers in `[-B, B]` is an allowed
coefficient, and a degree-`≤ d` polynomial has at most `d` roots. This is the counting input named
by the Layer-2 effective Hermite–Minkowski target.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_biUnion_roots_natDegree_le_abs_intCoeff_le (m : ℤ →+* S) (d B : ℕ) :
    (⋃ (f : ℤ[X]) (_ : f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, |f.coeff i| ≤ (B : ℤ)),
        ((f.map m).roots.toFinset : Set S)).ncard ≤ (2 * B + 1) ^ (d + 1) * d

decls.name: Squarefree.not_isSquare
decls.doc: A squarefree non-unit of a monoid is not a square.
decls.statement:
theorem Squarefree.not_isSquare {R : Type*} [Monoid R] {a : R}
    (ha : Squarefree a) (hu : ¬ IsUnit a) : ¬ IsSquare a

decls.name: Squarefree.neg
decls.doc: Negation preserves squarefreeness in any monoid with distributive negation.
decls.statement:
theorem Squarefree.neg {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [HasDistribNeg R] {n : R}
    (hn : Squarefree n) : Squarefree (-n)

decls.name: not_isSquare_intCast_of_squarefree_of_ne_one
decls.doc: A squarefree integer other than `1` is not a rational square.
decls.statement:
theorem not_isSquare_intCast_of_squarefree_of_ne_one {n : ℤ}
    (hsf : Squarefree n) (hne : n ≠ 1) : ¬ IsSquare ((n : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.map_center_eq_center
decls.doc: An algebra equivalence carries the center onto the center.
decls.statement:
theorem map_center_eq_center (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    (Subalgebra.center R A).map (e : A →ₐ[R] B) = Subalgebra.center R B

decls.name: TauCeti.centerCongr
decls.doc: The center of an algebra, transported along an algebra equivalence.
decls.statement:
def centerCongr (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    Subalgebra.center R A ≃ₐ[R] Subalgebra.center R B

decls.name: TauCeti.centerCongr_apply_coe
decls.statement:
theorem centerCongr_apply_coe (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) (x : Subalgebra.center R A) :
    (centerCongr e x : B) = e (x : A)

decls.name: TauCeti.centerCongr_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc: The inverse of `centerCongr e` transports the center back along `e.symm`.
decls.statement:
theorem centerCongr_symm_apply_coe (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) (y : Subalgebra.center R B) :
    ((centerCongr e).symm y : A) = e.symm (y : B)

decls.name: TauCeti.centerPiAlgEquiv
decls.doc: The center of a product of algebras is the product of their centers.
decls.statement:
def centerPiAlgEquiv :
    Subalgebra.center R (Π i, S i) ≃ₐ[R] Π i, Subalgebra.center R (S i)

decls.name: TauCeti.centerPiAlgEquiv_apply_coe
decls.statement:
theorem centerPiAlgEquiv_apply_coe (x : Subalgebra.center R (Π i, S i)) (i : ι) :
    (centerPiAlgEquiv x i : S i) = (x : Π i, S i) i

decls.name: TauCeti.centerPiAlgEquiv_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc: The inverse of `centerPiAlgEquiv` assembles a tuple of central elements componentwise.
decls.statement:
theorem centerPiAlgEquiv_symm_apply_coe (y : Π i, Subalgebra.center R (S i)) (i : ι) :
    (centerPiAlgEquiv.symm y : Π i, S i) i = (y i : S i)

decls.name: TauCeti.centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral
decls.doc: The center of a central algebra is the base field.
decls.statement: def centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral : Subalgebra.center K D ≃ₐ[K] K

decls.name: TauCeti.coe_centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral_symm
decls.doc: The inverse of `centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral` is the structure map of the algebra.
decls.statement:
theorem coe_centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral_symm (r : K) :
    ((centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral K D).symm r : D) = algebraMap K D r

decls.name: TauCeti.algebraMap_centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral
decls.doc: `centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral` sends a central element to the scalar it is the image of.
decls.statement:
theorem algebraMap_centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral (x : Subalgebra.center K D) :
    algebraMap K D (centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral K D x) = (x : D)

decls.name: TauCeti.finrank_center_of_isCentral
decls.doc: A central algebra has a one-dimensional center.
decls.statement: theorem finrank_center_of_isCentral : Module.finrank K (Subalgebra.center K D) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.isCentral_iff_surjective_algebraMap
decls.doc:
A commutative `K`-algebra is central over `K` exactly when its structure map is surjective: the
center of a commutative algebra is all of it, so demanding that the center be the image of `K`
demands that everything be in the image of `K`.

This is the precise sense in which centrality is a strong condition on a field extension: `L / K` is
central only when `L = K`.
decls.statement:
theorem isCentral_iff_surjective_algebraMap (K D : Type*) [CommSemiring K] [CommSemiring D]
    [Algebra K D] : Algebra.IsCentral K D ↔ Function.Surjective (algebraMap K D)
